dossier.claim: Negation, comparison, explanation, and dependency sometimes point in the wrong direction. The English can retain the main nouns while changing how the ideas relate.
dossier.sourcePattern: Knowing crests is presented as the route to understanding mages, Projection extends Strengthening, and a Master’s wish is not unrelated to a Servant. Elsewhere the Japanese contrasts two possible reasons for a journey or reports two states that have not yet occurred.
dossier.englishEffect: Shirou is said already to understand what he is about to learn. Strengthening becomes the extension of Projection. A relevant wish becomes irrelevant, and the explicitly rejected absence of a purpose becomes the reason for the journey. The Grail’s two present negatives become a conditional guarantee against breaking.
dossier.limits: A reordered observation and conjecture do not automatically reverse causality. A causal relation can survive across adjacent sentences, and explanatory free indirect narration is not necessarily an invented universal rule. The examples concern relations that the English actually changes, rather than requiring every Japanese connective to appear as a separate English word.
dossier.diagnostic: 1,053 findings in this category; 8 cited passages.

findings.explanation: The rescue number’s failure to qualify someone as a hero becomes barely qualifying.

contexts.japanese: そんな数では“英雄”と呼ばれる事もない
contexts.english: This is barely qualification as a hero with such a small number

findings.description: Choosing Caster’s Master would be wiser becomes Caster’s Master being more clever.
findings.sourceReading: The conditional sets up a comparative judgment of ally selection: that would still be the wiser choice.
findings.explanation: Choosing Caster’s Master would be wiser becomes Caster’s Master being more clever.

contexts.japanese: 協力者を選ぶというのなら、まだキャスターのマスターの方が賢い
contexts.english: If you are to choose an ally, Caster's Master is more clever.

findings.description: Saber’s tactic of intercepting a pursuing enemy becomes the enemy’s tactic of pursuing a retreating target.
findings.sourceReading: She retreats to sword range expecting to counter the opponent when he follows. The surprise is that he does not close the distance.
findings.explanation: Saber’s tactic of intercepting a pursuing enemy becomes the enemy’s tactic of pursuing a retreating target.

contexts.japanese: 追ってくる敵を迎え撃つのが定石
contexts.english: It is a basic, established tactic to pursue a retreating target.

findings.description: People he could do without become the least necessary people. His conclusion that none of the ten could be spared remains.
findings.sourceReading: He sought to kill those among ten slaves whose absence would be acceptable, then found none expendable.
findings.explanation: People he could do without become the least necessary people. His conclusion that none of the ten could be spared remains.

contexts.japanese: “いなくともよい”モノを殺そうとした
contexts.english: attempted to kill the least necessary.

findings.description: An exclamation about excessive force becomes a usual technical limit on converting curses.
findings.sourceReading: 実力行使にも程がある is the reaction that even using force has its limits: she has overdone turning a leisurely curse into an immediate attack.
findings.explanation: An exclamation about excessive force becomes a usual technical limit on converting curses.

contexts.japanese: 実力行使にも程がある
contexts.english: There's usually a limit to how much force one can use to turn a slow curse into an immediate curse.

findings.description: A denied stare-down becomes an actual exchange of glares.
findings.sourceReading: 再度睨みあう—なんて余裕はない denies time for the envisaged stare-down and immediately sends Shirou back into the hall.
findings.explanation: A denied stare-down becomes an actual exchange of glares.

contexts.japanese: 再度睨みあう—なんて余裕はない
contexts.english: We glare at each other again... But I have to...!

findings.description: A mind so blank that he wants to believe he is dreaming becomes a mind blank because he wants that belief.
findings.sourceReading: 思いこみたくなるぐらい、真っ白だった makes the wish to believe this is a post-death dream a measure/result of his terrifying blankness.
findings.explanation: A mind so blank that he wants to believe he is dreaming becomes a mind blank because he wants that belief.

contexts.japanese: 思いこみたくなるぐらい、真っ白だった
contexts.english: my mind is now blank from wanting to believe

findings.description: The first impossible block’s failure of a chance explanation becomes improbability of repeated coincidences.
findings.sourceReading: The paragraph moves from how often chance can continue to the stronger problem that even the first undodgeable head attack could never be blocked by chance.
findings.explanation: The first impossible block’s failure of a chance explanation becomes improbability of repeated coincidences.

contexts.japanese: 決して偶然などでは防げない
contexts.english: There's no way that coincidence is lining up this much...

findings.description: More cooperation is made to increase the probability of an inevitable fight.
findings.sourceReading: The source says however much partial cooperation accumulates, what waits at the end is unavoidable battle; it frames his dread of attachment against that endpoint.
findings.explanation: More cooperation is made to increase the probability of an inevitable fight.

contexts.japanese: 最後に待っているのは避けられない戦いだけ
contexts.english: the greater the likelihood that there will be an inevitable fight

findings.description: Rin reacting as though it were her own affair becomes anger for a different reason.
findings.sourceReading: 我がコトのように marks personally invested anger about his reckless disclosure.
findings.explanation: Rin reacting as though it were her own affair becomes anger for a different reason.

contexts.japanese: 我がコトのように怒り出す
contexts.english: She gets mad for an entirely different reason.

findings.description: Rin’s impulse to prod him becomes having to teach him a lesson.
findings.sourceReading: つい and つっつきたくなった present an impulsive desire to poke/chastise him, with hesitant wording.
findings.explanation: Rin’s impulse to prod him becomes having to teach him a lesson.

contexts.japanese: つい灸を据えるっていうか、つっつきたくなった
contexts.english: I had to teach you a lesson!

findings.description: Recognizing their shared panic is replaced with blaming her for dragging him in.
findings.sourceReading: パニクったのは俺も同じ recognizes that he too panicked at the sudden situation, before calling her one-sided glare unfair.
findings.explanation: Recognizing their shared panic is replaced with blaming her for dragging him in.

contexts.japanese: いきなりのコトでパニクったのは俺も同じ
contexts.english: You're the one who dragged me in like that.

findings.description: Sella liking this ordinary fare becomes a generic statement about common tastes.
findings.sourceReading: こういう庶民の味、好きだから gives Sella’s liking this kind of fare as the reason in the cake reply.
findings.explanation: Sella liking this ordinary fare becomes a generic statement about common tastes.

contexts.japanese: セラ、こういう庶民の味、好きだから
contexts.english: And Sella has common tastes.

findings.description: A question already asked becomes a hypothetical question she might ask.
findings.sourceReading: 問われた時 and なかった look back at the second why question and his inability to answer it.
findings.explanation: A question already asked becomes a hypothetical question she might ask.

contexts.japanese: 問われた時、俺には返す答えがなかった
contexts.english: If she asked me why I admired them, I would have nothing to say in response.

findings.description: Nobody being able to accomplish the ideal becomes nobody going to do it.
findings.sourceReading: 誰も成し得ない states inability to achieve it, preceding his taking up the inherited aspiration.
findings.explanation: Nobody being able to accomplish the ideal becomes nobody going to do it.

contexts.japanese: 誰も成し得ないのなら
contexts.english: if no one's going to

findings.description: Excessive ease of gathering becomes excessive quantity collected.
findings.sourceReading: 集まり易すぎる describes being too easy to gather/accumulate, leaving the phenomenon’s exact meaning unspoken.
findings.explanation: Excessive ease of gathering becomes excessive quantity collected.

contexts.japanese: 集まり易すぎる
contexts.english: collecting way too much

contexts.japanese: 集まり易すぎる
contexts.english: Collecting way too much

findings.description: One of two alternative activation conditions disappears.
findings.sourceReading: 破ったり破るヤツに出会ったら includes breaking Caster’s rules oneself or encountering someone who breaks them.
findings.explanation: One of two alternative activation conditions disappears.

contexts.japanese: 三か条”を破ったり破るヤツに出会ったら
contexts.english: If they come across someone who breaks her three rules

findings.description: Outshining the other heroines becomes taking one heroine role.
findings.sourceReading: 他のヒロインをくっちゃう is the metatheatrical idea of stealing the show from the other heroines by helping Shirou.
findings.explanation: Outshining the other heroines becomes taking one heroine role.

contexts.japanese: 他のヒロインをくっちゃう
contexts.english: take one of the heroine roles.

findings.description: Enduring it so things soon return becomes supposing eventual normality.
findings.sourceReading: 我慢すればすぐ元通り is her hopeful condition: if she bears it, normality will soon return.
findings.explanation: Enduring it so things soon return becomes supposing eventual normality.

contexts.japanese: 我慢すればすぐ元通りですから
contexts.english: I suppose things will return to normal eventually.

findings.description: The one-sided beating qualifier disappears before Saber’s defensive response.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou corrects match to a unilateral beating; Saber then stammers that Taiga advised severity and denies being personally angry.
findings.explanation: The one-sided beating qualifier disappears before Saber’s defensive response.

contexts.japanese: 一方的なタコ殴りだった
contexts.english: We had a match since you told me that I was slacking off for coming home late.

contexts.japanese: たるんでるってコトで手合わせしただろ
contexts.english: Actually, it was less of a match and more of a one-sided beatdown.

findings.description: A conditional town-wide-control deduction becomes an asserted capability.
findings.sourceReading: The narrator reasons if she can accomplish this remote control, would it not mean she can manipulate the town from here?
findings.explanation: A conditional town-wide-control deduction becomes an asserted capability.

contexts.japanese: という事ではないのか
contexts.english: But Caster can manipulate anybody in town without moving from here

contexts.japanese: 成し得るというのなら
contexts.english: She can control my body from more than a few kilometers away

findings.description: Caster's continuing maintenance of living victims becomes a wish that they live. Her purpose of extracting all their magical energy remains explicit.
findings.sourceReading: Caster describes continually keeping people alive without killing them so that she can extract their energy to the last drop.
findings.explanation: Caster's continuing maintenance of living victims becomes a wish that they live. Her purpose of extracting all their magical energy remains explicit.

contexts.japanese: 殺さない程度に生かし続けて
contexts.english: I wish for them to live

findings.description: Learning proper extraction degree becomes maximal efficiency.
findings.sourceReading: 加減がつかない followed by ほどよく marks initial inability to calibrate the amount and present appropriate collection.
findings.explanation: Learning proper extraction degree becomes maximal efficiency.

contexts.japanese: 今はほどよく集められる
contexts.english: now I can gather it most efficiently.

findings.description: A coincidence excuse becomes a denial of presence.
findings.sourceReading: たまたまそこにいた concedes being in the woods but explains it as coincidental, insufficient to prove involvement.
findings.explanation: A coincidence excuse becomes a denial of presence.

contexts.japanese: たまたまそこにいたと言われたら
contexts.english: if he just says he wasn't there.

findings.description: Rare tools become doubting that such a tool exists.
findings.sourceReading: 少ないでしょう gives rarity as the reason she thinks there probably is no Master using one.
findings.explanation: Rare tools become doubting that such a tool exists.

contexts.japanese: 道具なんて少ないでしょう
contexts.english: I doubt there's such a convenient tool

findings.description: Cleverness as grounds for pardon becomes in lieu of cleverness.
findings.sourceReading: 賢さに免じて gives his cleverness as the reason she overlooks the insult.
findings.explanation: Cleverness as grounds for pardon becomes in lieu of cleverness.

contexts.japanese: その賢さに免じて
contexts.english: in lieu of your cleverness.

findings.description: Archer’s only-when vow becomes a preference for likely kills.
findings.sourceReading: He asserts taking the sword only when victory is assured and he has sworn to kill; this is his articulated policy, not independently certified behavior.
findings.explanation: Archer’s only-when vow becomes a preference for likely kills.

contexts.japanese: 必殺を誓った時のみだ
contexts.english: most preferably when I can ensure a kill.

findings.description: Not yet trying to escape becomes inability to escape.
findings.sourceReading: He explicitly says the initial retreat is not an attempt to flee: his powerless legs move backward only to prevent collapse. Conscious flight begins two pages later.
findings.explanation: Not yet trying to escape becomes inability to escape.

contexts.japanese: 逃げよう、としての事じゃない
contexts.english: I can't even flee.

findings.description: Beyond speed and sharpness becomes too swift and deadly.
findings.sourceReading: The narrator says the technique is no longer a matter of being fast or sharp at his modest level of understanding.
findings.explanation: Beyond speed and sharpness becomes too swift and deadly.

contexts.japanese: もはや速いだの鋭いだのといった次元の問題ではなかった
contexts.english: It's too swift and deadly.

findings.description: “Only” changes the relation between will and death. The Japanese says that without his will, only death remains; the English says death occurs only when the will is gone. The following page preserves the original reasoning.
findings.sourceReading: Once his remaining will disappears, nothing remains for him but death.
findings.explanation: “Only” changes the relation between will and death. The Japanese says that without his will, only death remains; the English says death occurs only when the will is gone. The following page preserves the original reasoning.

contexts.japanese: 意思がなくなれば死ぬだけ
contexts.english: One only dies when their will is gone.

findings.description: Not having a particular shop becomes a shop being optional.
findings.sourceReading: Rin denies a target shop but insists she has planned the destination, then names the park.
findings.explanation: Not having a particular shop becomes a shop being optional.

contexts.japanese: 目当ての店ってわけじゃない
contexts.english: It's not like it has to be there

findings.description: Prior protective cleanliness becomes impurity in place of the field.
findings.sourceReading: 結界に守られていた分 explains why even a small contamination now makes the air feel heavy: it had been protected by the field.
findings.explanation: Prior protective cleanliness becomes impurity in place of the field.

contexts.japanese: 結界に守られていた分
contexts.english: a small amount of impurity in place of the Bounded Field.

findings.description: Two grounds for choosing to fight become capability implying duty.
findings.sourceReading: He chose to fight because it was something he could do, and because he believed it something he had to do: two parallel grounds.
findings.explanation: Two grounds for choosing to fight become capability implying duty.

contexts.japanese: 自分に出来る事だから、やらなくてはいけない事だと信じたから
contexts.english: I believed that since it was something I could do, it was something I must do.

findings.description: Past protection replaces the strengthened reason to remain responsible.
findings.sourceReading: If this pain means Saber was saving him until now, he is all the more involved: 尚更 refers to his rebuttal that he does have a stake in her fate.
findings.explanation: Past protection replaces the strengthened reason to remain responsible.

contexts.japanese: 今までセイバーによって助けられていたっていうのなら尚更だ
contexts.english: This pain is proof that I've been saved by Saber until now.

findings.description: Not only scissors becomes a cause involving many scissors.
findings.sourceReading: ハサミばかりか adds needles and thread beyond scissors.
findings.explanation: Not only scissors becomes a cause involving many scissors.

contexts.japanese: ハサミばかりか
contexts.english: It might be because there's this many scissors

findings.description: Given that he became a Master becomes as long as he became one.
findings.sourceReading: なった以上 supplies the already-established ground for his initial motive.
findings.explanation: Given that he became a Master becomes as long as he became one.

contexts.japanese: マスターになった以上は
contexts.english: as long as I became a Master

findings.description: The kingship motive attaches to a different action.
findings.sourceReading: The man who wanted her earlier acts subsequently discards her to gain the throne.
findings.explanation: The kingship motive attaches to a different action.

contexts.japanese: 王の座を得る為に、魔女など妻にできぬと彼女を捨てた
contexts.english: who wished for that in order to become the king cast her aside

findings.description: Walking from the station becomes walking to it.
findings.sourceReading: 駅前から is the starting point of the twenty-minute walk to the church.
findings.explanation: Walking from the station becomes walking to it.

contexts.japanese: 駅前から歩くこと二十分
contexts.english: I walk to the train station for twenty minutes.

findings.description: Outside Kuzuki’s range becomes simply at a distance.
findings.sourceReading: Rin can attack from beyond his reach while Shirou holds him.
findings.explanation: Outside Kuzuki’s range becomes simply at a distance.

contexts.japanese: 葛木を射程外から打ち倒せる
contexts.english: shoot him from a distance

findings.description: Shirou treats the hero's conduct as another reason for outrage. English turns that grievance into an unfinished 'even if' concession.
findings.sourceReading: The final も adds another object of Shirou's inability to forgive: a hero embodying his ideal turns out to be such a man.
findings.explanation: Shirou treats the hero's conduct as another reason for outrage. English turns that grievance into an unfinished 'even if' concession.

contexts.japanese: 理想とも言える英雄が、あんな男だという事も
contexts.english: Even if the hero that saved many people and embodies my ideals is a man like that

findings.description: An inferior copy becomes an equal shadow.
findings.sourceReading: 真物より落ちる explicitly qualifies the otherwise identical image as inferior to the original.
findings.explanation: An inferior copy becomes an equal shadow.

contexts.japanese: 其は真物より落ちる同一の影
contexts.english: It is an equal shadow cast by the true object.

findings.description: Kuzuki's effort to prevent either protagonist escaping becomes a shared intention to hold one another in place.
findings.sourceReading: Kuzuki maintains the standoff to prevent either Shirou or Rin from escaping.
findings.explanation: Kuzuki's effort to prevent either protagonist escaping becomes a shared intention to hold one another in place.

contexts.japanese: どちらかを逃がさない為
contexts.english: so that we don't let each other go.

findings.description: Pride sustains Saber but English keeps her at bay.
findings.sourceReading: 誇りが彼女を保たせていた keeps her holding on despite fading reason.
findings.explanation: Pride sustains Saber but English keeps her at bay.

contexts.japanese: 誇りが彼女を保たせていた
contexts.english: her pride are keeping her at bay.

findings.description: Bad timing becomes pure bad luck.
findings.sourceReading: 間の悪さ explains arrival at the wrong time; the next advice postpones the otherwise correct church visit.
findings.explanation: Bad timing becomes pure bad luck.

contexts.japanese: ズバリ間の悪さ
contexts.english: pure bad luck.

findings.description: The explanation loses Caster's wounded condition and the limitation of her magical defense. Her decision to shield Kuzuki with her body remains.
findings.sourceReading: The narrator conjectures that Caster recognizes her inability, in her wounded condition, to block the attack with her own magical power.
findings.explanation: The explanation loses Caster's wounded condition and the limitation of her magical defense. Her decision to shield Kuzuki with her body remains.

contexts.japanese: 傷ついた自身の魔力では防げない
contexts.english: she wouldn't be able to block the attack.

findings.description: Caster's smile affirms that Kuzuki's very unresponsiveness suited her. The English makes her only perhaps content because of him, weakening that specific relationship.
findings.sourceReading: Caster corrects mere acceptance of Kuzuki's unresponsiveness: precisely his being that kind of person made him right for her.
findings.explanation: Caster's smile affirms that Kuzuki's very unresponsiveness suited her. The English makes her only perhaps content because of him, weakening that specific relationship.

contexts.japanese: そんな相手だからこそ良かった
contexts.english: perhaps she's content because of this man.

findings.description: Not only Projection becomes not from Projection.
findings.sourceReading: だけじゃない keeps Projection strain as one cause alongside the incantation shock.
findings.explanation: Not only Projection becomes not from Projection.

contexts.japanese: 投影を乱用した負荷だけじゃない
contexts.english: It's not from the burden of Projecting too many weapons.

findings.description: No reason to fight Kuzuki becomes no reason for Kuzuki to fight.
findings.sourceReading: 葛木と戦う considers the observers’ justification for fighting him.
findings.explanation: No reason to fight Kuzuki becomes no reason for Kuzuki to fight.

contexts.japanese: 葛木と戦う理由など何処にもない
contexts.english: any more reasons for Kuzuki to keep fighting

findings.description: Insufficient strength becomes barely sufficient strength.
findings.sourceReading: She has not even enough strength left to face him.
findings.explanation: Insufficient strength becomes barely sufficient strength.

contexts.japanese: 俺を相手にする力さえ残っていない
contexts.english: she barely has enough strength to even face me.

findings.description: The cost of life-preserving magic becomes the cost of performing miracles generally.
findings.sourceReading: The magic specifically kept him alive up to this point.
findings.explanation: The cost of life-preserving magic becomes the cost of performing miracles generally.

contexts.japanese: おまえをここまで生かしてきた魔術の代償
contexts.english: paying the price for performing miracles until this point

findings.description: Contractual subordination and entrusted fate become creation.
findings.sourceReading: The body is under the summoner; the summoner’s fate rests in the sword.
findings.explanation: Contractual subordination and entrusted fate become creation.

contexts.japanese: 汝の身は我が下に、我が命運は汝の剣に
contexts.english: My will creates your body, and your sword creates my destiny!

findings.description: Self-destruction becomes probable nonsurvival.
findings.sourceReading: Archer states that projecting the sacred sword would destroy him.
findings.explanation: Self-destruction becomes probable nonsurvival.

contexts.japanese: 聖剣など投影しては自滅する
contexts.english: I probably won't survive after Projecting a sacred sword.

findings.description: A probable conclusion is recast as a malformed causal clause.
findings.sourceReading: おそらく、これで最後なのだ independently states that this is probably the last time.
findings.explanation: A probable conclusion is recast as a malformed causal clause.

contexts.japanese: おそらく、これで最後なのだ
contexts.english: It's probably because, this is the last.

findings.description: The relation between stopping the Grail and defeating Gilgamesh is reversed.
findings.sourceReading: Saber asks whether stopping the Grail therefore means they must defeat Gilgamesh.
findings.explanation: The relation between stopping the Grail and defeating Gilgamesh is reversed.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯を止める、という事はギルガメッシュを倒すという事ではないのですか
contexts.english: defeating Gilgamesh does not automatically equate to stopping the Holy Grail.

findings.description: Master status becomes a numerical two-Master threshold for bypassing the boundary.
findings.sourceReading: Rin and Shirou, the two people who are Masters, are unaffected by the temple's barrier.
findings.explanation: Master status becomes a numerical two-Master threshold for bypassing the boundary.

contexts.japanese: マスターである二人なら、柳洞寺の結界も意味はない
contexts.english: Ryudou Temple's Bounded Field means little if there are two Masters.

findings.description: Rin's fine/very-not-fine self-contradiction becomes a forecast that tea together would not work out.
findings.sourceReading: She first says it is fine, then immediately admits it is extremely not fine; the contradiction exposes her displeasure.
findings.explanation: Rin's fine/very-not-fine self-contradiction becomes a forecast that tea together would not work out.

contexts.japanese: まあいいけど
contexts.english: Whatever.

contexts.japanese: すごくよくないけど
contexts.english: I really didn't think that would work out.

findings.description: A counterfactual lifelong loss of face becomes a belief that he had overslept plus an imagined violent scolding.
findings.sourceReading: Had he carelessly slept too long and been shaken awake by Rin, he would never have been able to hold his head up before her again.
findings.explanation: A counterfactual lifelong loss of face becomes a belief that he had overslept plus an imagined violent scolding.

contexts.japanese: うっかり寝過ごし、遠坂にたたき起こされでもしたら一生頭が上がらなくなってたところだ
contexts.english: I for sure thought I would've overslept. I feel embarassed just thinking how Tohsaka would violently wake me up and give me a scolding.

findings.description: Rin's mana plus all Shirou's circuits becomes all of both people's circuits.
findings.sourceReading: The Reality Marble requires Rin's magical energy and Shirou's complete circuit set.
findings.explanation: Rin's mana plus all Shirou's circuits becomes all of both people's circuits.

contexts.japanese: 私の魔力と士郎の全魔術回路を使って初めて
contexts.english: when we fully exert all of our Magic Circuits.

findings.description: Rin refusing to let Shirou apologize becomes refusing to apologize herself.
findings.sourceReading: ごめん、なんて言わせない makes Shirou the prospective apologizer.
findings.explanation: Rin refusing to let Shirou apologize becomes refusing to apologize herself.

contexts.japanese: ごめん、なんて言わせないわ
contexts.english: don't expect me to apologize.

findings.description: A momentary repulsion of the mud becomes a fast repulsion.
findings.sourceReading: ほんの僅かな時間ではあるが limits how long the arrows keep the black mud away.
findings.explanation: A momentary repulsion of the mud becomes a fast repulsion.

contexts.japanese: ほんの僅かな時間ではあるが、黒い泥は弾かれ
contexts.english: In just a short time the black mud is repelled

findings.description: Rin's magical energy receiving her cry becomes magical energy replying to it.
findings.sourceReading: Her mana catches/carries the shouted plea, enabling Saber to answer with the holy sword.
findings.explanation: Rin's magical energy receiving her cry becomes magical energy replying to it.

contexts.japanese: 叫ぶ声を、彼女の魔力が受け止める
contexts.english: Her magical energy replies to the screaming voice.

findings.description: Calling the matching weapon to hand becomes reeling in one already at hand.
findings.sourceReading: The moment Shirou sees a Noble Phantasm, he draws/calls the same thing into his grasp.
findings.explanation: Calling the matching weapon to hand becomes reeling in one already at hand.

contexts.japanese: 手元に同じモノをたぐり寄せ
contexts.english: I reel in the same one that I have at hand

findings.description: Shirou gripping the chain so he will not let go becomes the chain refusing to release him.
findings.sourceReading: He deliberately reverses his prior resistance, winds the chain deeply, and grips it so the two cannot separate.
findings.explanation: Shirou gripping the chain so he will not let go becomes the chain refusing to release him.

contexts.japanese: 決して離れないよう鎖を掴み
contexts.english: I grab onto the chain so that it won't let me go.

findings.description: The sky's color comparison is reversed.
findings.sourceReading: The sky is closer to ash/gray than black, recalling the scene ten years earlier.
findings.explanation: The sky's color comparison is reversed.

contexts.japanese: 黒というより灰に近い空
contexts.english: The sky is closer to black than gray

findings.description: Archer's prior and present defense against the spear becomes dodging.
findings.sourceReading: He completely defended against Lancer's spear on the earlier night and has survived this far now by using that knowledge to parry or contain it.
findings.explanation: Archer's prior and present defense against the spear becomes dodging.

contexts.japanese: あの夜防ぎきったランサーの槍を、アーチャーは捌ききれない。
contexts.english: Archer cannot handle Lancer's attacks that he was able to dodge that night.

contexts.japanese: それをここまで防ぎきったのは、前回の戦いでランサーの槍を知ったからだ。
contexts.english: He was able to dodge this much because he knew Lancer's spear from the last battle.

findings.description: Archer's long-standing disadvantage is reversed into an advantage.
findings.sourceReading: Archer has long been on the losing side and will not last several more exchanges, yet he has still received Lancer's full-force spear.
findings.explanation: Archer's long-standing disadvantage is reversed into an advantage.

contexts.japanese: とうに劣勢、あと数合も保つまいが
contexts.english: He has been at an advantage and should not last a few more blows

findings.description: Lancer's question about the point of getting serious in this particular exchange becomes a general question about serious battle. His subsequent reasoning survives, but its opening distinction is blurred.
findings.sourceReading: Lancer asks what getting serious in this kind of combat would accomplish, before distinguishing ordinary exchanges from using a fatal Noble Phantasm.
findings.explanation: Lancer's question about the point of getting serious in this particular exchange becomes a general question about serious battle. His subsequent reasoning survives, but its opening distinction is blurred.

contexts.japanese: このような戦闘で本気になったところで何がある。
contexts.english: What is there in a serious battle?

findings.description: The thrown Gáe Bolg is twice changed into a thrust.
findings.sourceReading: After explicitly saying Lancer will not thrust, the narration describes the spear's property when released or thrown and the legend of its scattering arrowheads when cast at an enemy.
findings.explanation: The thrown Gáe Bolg is twice changed into a thrust.

contexts.japanese: 大きく振りかぶった腕には“放てば必ず心臓を貫く”魔槍。
contexts.english: He holds up the magical spear that "always pierces the heart once it is thrust."

contexts.japanese: その槍は、敵に放てば無数の鏃をまき散らしたという。
contexts.english: That spear scatters numerous arrowheads once it is thrust into the enemy.

findings.description: The spear's impossibility of both evasion and defense becomes two statements about evasion.
findings.sourceReading: Gáe Bolg cannot be evaded and cannot be blocked; the absolute claim sets up the dramatic contradiction of Rho Aias stopping it.
findings.explanation: The spear's impossibility of both evasion and defense becomes two statements about evasion.

contexts.japanese: 躱す事も出来ず、防ぐ事も出来ない。
contexts.english: It cannot be avoided nor dodged.

findings.description: The English repeats Shirou's inability to dodge instead of explaining that he cannot initiate a defense against fists he cannot see.
findings.sourceReading: Unable to see Kuzuki's fists, Shirou cannot initiate a defense himself; this follows a separate statement about his inability to evade narrowly.
findings.explanation: The English repeats Shirou's inability to dodge instead of explaining that he cannot initiate a defense against fists he cannot see.

contexts.japanese: 見えていないんだから、自分から防ぐ事など不可能だ。
contexts.english: I can't see them, so it's impossible to even dodge them.

findings.description: The English makes the manner of Kuzuki's advance mysterious; the Japanese says Shirou does not even notice the advance itself.
findings.sourceReading: Kuzuki closes the distance without Shirou even noticing his forward movement.
findings.explanation: The English makes the manner of Kuzuki's advance mysterious; the Japanese says Shirou does not even notice the advance itself.

contexts.japanese: 前進した事も気づかせないまま間合いを詰める葛木。
contexts.english: Kuzuki closes in, without revealing how he advanced.

findings.description: “At an advantage” reverses Rin's position. The Japanese places her under pressure alongside Shirou, with the added burden of understanding how badly she is outmatched.
findings.sourceReading: Rin is at a disadvantage too; understanding the disparity in strength makes her burden greater than Shirou's.
findings.explanation: “At an advantage” reverses Rin's position. The Japanese places her under pressure alongside Shirou, with the added burden of understanding how badly she is outmatched.

contexts.japanese: 劣勢であるのは彼女も同じだった。
contexts.english: Tohsaka is also at an advantage.

findings.description: Rin completely blocking Caster's attacks becomes dodging them.
findings.sourceReading: Caster praises Rin for completely defending against the spells, then explains that guarding only herself would preserve the jewels.
findings.explanation: Rin completely blocking Caster's attacks becomes dodging them.

contexts.japanese: あら、綺麗に防ぎきるのね。
contexts.english: Oh, you dodge them well.

findings.description: A pronoun makes protected Kuzuki the exception to his own protection.
findings.sourceReading: Kuzuki is presumably protected by Caster, while Shirou alone is the exception and would burn if Rin let the area spell activate.
findings.explanation: A pronoun makes protected Kuzuki the exception to his own protection.

contexts.japanese: 葛木はキャスターによって護られているだろうが、彼だけは例外なのだ。
contexts.english: Kuzuki should be protected by Caster, but he is an exception.

findings.description: The fourth jewel is presented as an additional consumption after three jewels.
findings.sourceReading: Rin releases three jewels—numbers five, three, and four—and uses the treasured number four within that set to layer the forbidden synergy.
findings.explanation: The fourth jewel is presented as an additional consumption after three jewels.

contexts.japanese: 加えて虎の子の四番を用いて、禁呪である相乗さえ重ねた。
contexts.english: Additionally, she uses her treasured fourth jewel to add a synergistic effect.

findings.description: Refusing to turn his back on Kiritsugu’s final trust becomes not looking away from the moment.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou cannot turn his back on Kiritsugu’s end and what the relieved final words entrusted to him.
findings.explanation: Refusing to turn his back on Kiritsugu’s final trust becomes not looking away from the moment.

contexts.japanese: その最期に、背を向ける事はできない。
contexts.english: I can't look away from his final moment.

findings.description: A mirror comparison becomes a purpose clause.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou denies Archer just as Archer refuses to acknowledge the former Emiya Shirou; the two rejections mirror one another.
findings.explanation: A mirror comparison becomes a purpose clause.

contexts.japanese: あいつがかつての衛宮士郎を認めないように。
contexts.english: So that he doesn't approve of the former Shirou Emiya.

findings.description: Archer's metaphorical prior death becomes a possibility that Shirou may die now.
findings.sourceReading: If recognizing death is the criterion, Archer has long been dead; Shirou became as good as dead when he recognized that condition.
findings.explanation: Archer's metaphorical prior death becomes a possibility that Shirou may die now.

contexts.japanese: 死ぬというのなら、あの男はとうに死んでいる。
contexts.english: I might die, but he's long dead.

findings.description: No mental room to worry about death becomes a judgment that such gloom has no point.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou feels no fear because his recognition of Archer's condition leaves him no余裕—no room or capacity—to concern himself with his own death.
findings.explanation: No mental room to worry about death becomes a judgment that such gloom has no point.

contexts.japanese: 自身の死をどうだのと憂いる余裕などない
contexts.english: There's no longer any point in feeling gloomy about my own death.

findings.description: Lancer's continuing promise not to intervene becomes a report that he has not harmed Rin so far.
findings.sourceReading: Lancer says he is keeping the agreement: he himself will not lay a hand on Rin, whatever others do.
findings.explanation: Lancer's continuing promise not to intervene becomes a report that he has not harmed Rin so far.

contexts.japanese: おまえとの約束は守っている。オレは手出しはせん。
contexts.english: I kept my promise to you. I haven't harmed her.

findings.description: People whose side the hero took become people he had already decided to save.
findings.sourceReading: A hero of justice can save only the people whose side he takes; the claim concerns partiality created by siding with one party.
findings.explanation: People whose side the hero took become people he had already decided to save.

contexts.japanese: 正義の味方が助けられるのは、味方をした人間だけ。
contexts.english: A hero of justice can only save the people he's decided to save.

findings.description: Sacrificing one to save more becomes making the minimum sacrifice.
findings.sourceReading: The doctrine declares it right to sacrifice one thing/person in order to rescue a greater number.
findings.explanation: Sacrificing one to save more becomes making the minimum sacrifice.

contexts.japanese: 一つを犠牲にして、より多くのモノを助け出す事こそが正しい
contexts.english: Saving as many people as you can with the minimum sacrifice is the right choice.

findings.description: A hypothetical death that cannot erase the original becomes the temporal claim that he has been unable to erase it ever since dying.
findings.sourceReading: Even if this summoned Archer dies, the original Emiya in the Throne outside the cycle will not disappear.
findings.explanation: A hypothetical death that cannot erase the original becomes the temporal claim that he has been unable to erase it ever since dying.

contexts.japanese: ヤツは死んだところで輪の外にある“座”に在るエミヤ本体は消え去らない。
contexts.english: However, ever since he died, he can't erase the original Emiya that exists in a place outside of the time axis.

findings.description: Archer's explicit abandonment of results becomes a denial that he expects saving grace.
findings.sourceReading: After waiting for this moment through his service, Archer says that at this late stage he seeks no result; what follows is merely displaced anger.
findings.explanation: Archer's explicit abandonment of results becomes a denial that he expects saving grace.

contexts.japanese: いまさら結果など求めていない。
contexts.english: I'm not about to have any sudden hope for a saving grace.

findings.description: Archer says Shirou should never have become a hero of justice; English says he should never have tried.
findings.sourceReading: Archer corrects 'I' to 'you' and condemns becoming that role, whose completed outcome he has just described.
findings.explanation: Archer says Shirou should never have become a hero of justice; English says he should never have tried.

contexts.japanese: おまえは、正義の味方になぞなるべきではなかった
contexts.english: you never should have tried to be a hero of justice.

findings.description: Shirou refusing to retreat for the sake of what he lost becomes refusing despite what he lost.
findings.sourceReading: Precisely because he lost more than he gained, he cannot retreat, including for the sake of the things left behind along the way.
findings.explanation: Shirou refusing to retreat for the sake of what he lost becomes refusing despite what he lost.

contexts.japanese: その、落としてきた物の為にも、衛宮士郎は退けない。
contexts.english: Shirou Emiya won't back down, not even for what he's lost.

findings.description: Kotomine's regret at losing a capable apprentice becomes an absence of criticism toward a less capable one. The change obscures how his appraisal of Rin accompanies the threat to her life.
findings.sourceReading: A less capable apprentice would give Kotomine no cause for regret at losing her; the deathbed image and Rin's recognition of her fate specify the stakes.
findings.explanation: Kotomine's regret at losing a capable apprentice becomes an absence of criticism toward a less capable one. The change obscures how his appraisal of Rin accompanies the threat to her life.

contexts.japanese: もう少し出来の悪い弟子ならば、惜しむ事もないのだが
contexts.english: I would have no criticisms of you at all if you were only a slightly less capable apprentice.

findings.description: Kotomine says his mentor was easy to betray because of their relationship. The English instead emphasizes his effort in betraying him, losing the taunt about exploiting that bond.
findings.sourceReading: Kotomine says the teacher relationship made his treacherous attack easy.
findings.explanation: Kotomine says his mentor was easy to betray because of their relationship. The English instead emphasizes his effort in betraying him, losing the taunt about exploiting that bond.

contexts.japanese: 恩師であったからな。騙し討ちは容易かった
contexts.english: He was my master whom I owed a great deal. I spared no effort in betraying him.

findings.description: Waiting until Archer and Saber disappear becomes choosing now to eliminate them.
findings.sourceReading: Kotomine says that once Archer and Saber are gone, the timing will finally be right; meanwhile Rin must be processed quickly before resistance reduces her magical freshness.
findings.explanation: Waiting until Archer and Saber disappear becomes choosing now to eliminate them.

contexts.japanese: アーチャーとセイバーが消えればいい加減頃合いだ。
contexts.english: This would be an opportune time to eliminate Archer and Saber.

findings.description: Lancer still brushes off Rin's thanks, but he now attributes the rescue to personal inclination instead of how events unfolded. This changes his stated explanation, without settling his underlying motives.
findings.sourceReading: Lancer brushes aside thanks by saying the rescue followed from how events unfolded.
findings.explanation: Lancer still brushes off Rin's thanks, but he now attributes the rescue to personal inclination instead of how events unfolded. This changes his stated explanation, without settling his underlying motives.

contexts.japanese: ま、成り行きだからな。
contexts.english: I just felt like it.

findings.description: A partially successful evasion becomes a failed attempt to evade.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou twists away, but not by a mere paper-thin margin: the nonfatal cut still slices flesh and may become fatal.
findings.explanation: A partially successful evasion becomes a failed attempt to evade.

contexts.japanese: 身をひねって躱すも、薄皮一枚とはいかない。
contexts.english: I desperately try to avoid the strike, but I can't.

findings.description: A heart close to breaking but insisting it has not broken becomes a broken heart pretending to be whole.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou's nearly broken heart bluffs that it is not broken yet, allowing the body to demand continued resistance.
findings.explanation: A heart close to breaking but insisting it has not broken becomes a broken heart pretending to be whole.

contexts.japanese: 折れかかった心が、まだ折れていないと強がっている。
contexts.english: I've just been playing tough, pretending that my broken heart is whole.

findings.description: A Berserker-like blow becomes a comparison to Shirou's earlier encounter with Berserker.
findings.sourceReading: The force that sends Shirou flying is one even Berserker might have delivered.
findings.explanation: A Berserker-like blow becomes a comparison to Shirou's earlier encounter with Berserker.

contexts.japanese: バーサーカーもかくやという一撃は、たやすく衛宮士郎の体を弾き飛ばす。
contexts.english: I sail through the air, not unlike during the encounter with Berserker.

findings.description: Using unbroken parts of a broken body becomes using broken weapons as they are.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou reasons that if he is broken, he must use whatever part remains unbroken, then reach into still-untouched inner territory.
findings.explanation: Using unbroken parts of a broken body becomes using broken weapons as they are.

contexts.japanese: 壊れているなら壊れていないところを使えばいい。
contexts.english: If my weapons are broken, I'll just use them as they are.

findings.description: Kiritsugu saying the dream cannot come true becomes Shirou promising to make it come true.
findings.sourceReading: The fragment 'It won't come true' introduces Kiritsugu, who saved Shirou as a child and died leaving the dream behind sadly.
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu saying the dream cannot come true becomes Shirou promising to make it come true.

contexts.japanese: 叶わないと。
contexts.english: I'll make the dream come true.

findings.description: Attack and defense failing to mesh becomes mental gears failing to turn.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou's determined blow and Archer's defense, which should arrive in time, fail to interlock; even Archer does not know why he failed to parry.
findings.explanation: Attack and defense failing to mesh becomes mental gears failing to turn.

contexts.japanese: その歯車はかみ合わないまま
contexts.english: the gears never turn in his head

findings.description: Saber's comparison of the Masters' methods becomes a question about whether they were the same person. Gilgamesh's following answer concerns taking energy from others, which fits the Japanese comparison.
findings.sourceReading: Saber begins comparing Gilgamesh's Master with Rider's Master; the reply supplies the relevant similarity, taking energy from others.
findings.explanation: Saber's comparison of the Masters' methods becomes a question about whether they were the same person. Gilgamesh's following answer concerns taking energy from others, which fits the Japanese comparison.

contexts.japanese: 貴方のマスターは、ライダーのマスターと同じように
contexts.english: is your Master the same person Rider was contracted to?

findings.description: The Grail producing a weapon from Servants becomes the Grail summoning Servants.
findings.sourceReading: Saber asks whether the thing the Grail produces by means of Servants is a weapon.
findings.explanation: The Grail producing a weapon from Servants becomes the Grail summoning Servants.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯が、サーヴァントをもって生み出すモノが兵器だというのか
contexts.english: Do you say that because it can summon Servants

findings.description: Rin arguing that a king is meaningless without any humans becomes saying one death does not matter to a king.
findings.sourceReading: She attacks Gilgamesh's extermination plan: if not a single human remains, the very meaning of being king disappears.
findings.explanation: Rin arguing that a king is meaningless without any humans becomes saying one death does not matter to a king.

contexts.japanese: 人間が一人もいなくなったら、それこそ王様の意味なんてないじゃない！
contexts.english: It doesn't matter to a king whether one person dies or not!?

findings.description: The discomfort of swarming matter overwhelming Shinji more than the pain becomes two equal causes.
findings.sourceReading: His reason collapses because he cannot bear the packed, writhing presence inside him; this disgust exceeds even the pain of endless growth and death.
findings.explanation: The discomfort of swarming matter overwhelming Shinji more than the pain becomes two equal causes.

contexts.japanese: 痛みより、自身の中にびっしりと蠢き回る“何か”の不快感に耐えられず
contexts.english: unable to withstand the discomfort of something wriggling inside him and the pain

findings.description: A later Grail-destroying use made at the risk of disappearance becomes a sword use after which Saber will disappear.
findings.sourceReading: If Saber spends her one safe use on Gilgamesh, destroying the Grail will require another use undertaken with disappearance accepted as the cost.
findings.explanation: A later Grail-destroying use made at the risk of disappearance becomes a sword use after which Saber will disappear.

contexts.japanese: 消滅する事を覚悟の上で、彼女に聖剣を使ってもらう事になる
contexts.english: She's prepared to use the sacred sword knowing that she'll disappear afterward.

findings.description: Rin and Shirou arriving in time to confront Gilgamesh becomes arriving while Saber is already fighting him.
findings.sourceReading: Saber must hurry because otherwise the pair will catch up to the Gilgamesh battle; in the worst case they confront him before she even reaches the precincts.
findings.explanation: Rin and Shirou arriving in time to confront Gilgamesh becomes arriving while Saber is already fighting him.

contexts.japanese: 急がなければ、ふたりはギルガメッシュとの戦いに間に合ってしまう。
contexts.english: Unless she hurries, her allies will arrive while she's fighting Gilgamesh.

findings.description: The Grail being active but neither complete nor broken becomes a rule that it cannot break until it returns to its original form.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says there is still time because the Grail has activated, but has neither reached its proper wish-machine form nor yet broken apart.
findings.explanation: The Grail being active but neither complete nor broken becomes a rule that it cannot break until it returns to its original form.

contexts.japanese: 願望機っていう本来の姿になってなければ壊れてもいない。
contexts.english: it won't break as long as it doesn't return to its original wish-granting form.

findings.description: His refusal to allow objections becomes reluctance to make an offer. The surrounding threat and short reprieve remain.
findings.sourceReading: Gilgamesh ordinarily allows no objection or say in the matter; this time he grants a short reprieve.
findings.explanation: His refusal to allow objections becomes reluctance to make an offer. The surrounding threat and short reprieve remain.

contexts.japanese: 本来なら有無を言わせぬが
contexts.english: Normally, I would never suggest this

findings.description: A one-meter difference in fighting range becomes a one-meter distance between the fighters. This obscures the reach advantage that Saber must overcome.
findings.sourceReading: Their effective fighting ranges differ by one meter, a gap Saber cannot close while Assassin controls her approach.
findings.explanation: A one-meter difference in fighting range becomes a one-meter distance between the fighters. This obscures the reach advantage that Saber must overcome.

contexts.japanese: セイバーとアサシンの間合いの差は一メートル。
contexts.english: There's one meter between Saber and Assassin.

findings.description: Not flinching from some injury becomes not showing that she sustained scratches.
findings.sourceReading: Saber calculates that if she accepts a wound to an arm or leg without faltering, Assassin gets no second strike.
findings.explanation: Not flinching from some injury becomes not showing that she sustained scratches.

contexts.japanese: 多少の傷に怯まなければ二撃目はない。
contexts.english: If she doesn't show she's sustained a few scratches, there won't be another attack.

findings.description: The moment Saber breaks distance being her death becomes the present moment being her end.
findings.sourceReading: She cannot release force and disengage: that instant would trigger Assassin's killing technique.
findings.explanation: The moment Saber breaks distance being her death becomes the present moment being her end.

contexts.japanese: その瞬間こそが彼女の終わりだ。
contexts.english: This very moment is her end.

findings.description: Rin’s challenging glare becomes treating Shirou as a challenge she must surmount.
findings.sourceReading: She glares with a confrontational, challenging attitude after realizing he lacks awareness.
findings.explanation: Rin’s challenging glare becomes treating Shirou as a challenge she must surmount.

contexts.japanese: 挑むような態度で、遠坂は睨んできた。
contexts.english: Tohsaka glares at me as if I'm a challenge to surmount.

findings.description: Projection as an extension of Strengthening is reversed into Strengthening as an extension of Projection.
findings.sourceReading: Rin calls Shirou’s method nonsense because he skips both full and abbreviated procedures and attempts Projection by extending his Strengthening process.
findings.explanation: Projection as an extension of Strengthening is reversed into Strengthening as an extension of Projection.

contexts.japanese: 強化の延長で投影をしようなんていう貴方
contexts.english: if you think Strengthening is an extension of Projection.

findings.description: Rin’s command to master an achieved result becomes a claim that any success proves reproduction at will.
findings.sourceReading: Whether yesterday’s success was accident or necessity, Rin orders Shirou to make it his own now that he has once accomplished it.
findings.explanation: Rin’s command to master an achieved result becomes a claim that any success proves reproduction at will.

contexts.japanese: 出来た以上は偶然だろうが必然だろうがモノにしなさい！
contexts.english: whether on purpose or not, it means you're capable of doing it at will!

findings.description: Shirou’s plan to send Rin home before she does anything extra loses its preventive condition.
findings.sourceReading: Once she returns, he will finish their business and drive her home before she can do anything unnecessary.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s plan to send Rin home before she does anything extra loses its preventive condition.

contexts.japanese: 余計なコトする前に家にたたき帰す
contexts.english: I'm going to send her home right away!

findings.description: Rin seeming to want Shirou to ask becomes seeming to want to ask him something.
findings.sourceReading: Sensing that she wants the opening, Shirou prompts her to say what the conversation is about.
findings.explanation: Rin seeming to want Shirou to ask becomes seeming to want to ask him something.

contexts.japanese: なんとなく聞かれたがってるな
contexts.english: I felt like she wanted to ask me something

findings.description: Rin wondering whether Shirou is all right as he is becomes reassuring him that he need not learn differently and is fine as he is.
findings.sourceReading: The unusual house makes her reflect on others and question whether Shirou can safely remain in his present condition.
findings.explanation: Rin wondering whether Shirou is all right as he is becomes reassuring him that he need not learn differently and is fine as he is.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮くんはそのままでもいいのかなって、ふと思った
contexts.english: maybe you don't have to learn like that. I suppose, well, it might be you're just fine the way you are.

findings.description: Rin presenting her inference as obvious becomes Shirou endorsing it as the natural conclusion.
findings.sourceReading: Rin assumes that Shirou must also have enjoyed training; the narration marks her manner as taking that conclusion for granted before Shirou cannot agree.
findings.explanation: Rin presenting her inference as obvious becomes Shirou endorsing it as the natural conclusion.

contexts.japanese: 当然のように遠坂は言う。
contexts.english: I suppose that would be the natural conclusion.

findings.description: The numb half growing heavier becomes sensation itself getting stronger.
findings.sourceReading: Although he cannot feel the left side, Shirou thinks it is becoming heavy; the paradox deepens his concern.
findings.explanation: The numb half growing heavier becomes sensation itself getting stronger.

contexts.japanese: 感じないクセに重くなってきた気がする
contexts.english: the sensation is getting stronger, like everything is heavier.

findings.description: Archer’s specific causal accusation about Shirou’s misconception becomes the broader insult that he does not know what he is doing.
findings.sourceReading: Because Shirou mistakenly treats circuits as something made each time, the circuits meant for use were abandoned and left dormant.
findings.explanation: Archer’s specific causal accusation about Shirou’s misconception becomes the broader insult that he does not know what he is doing.

contexts.japanese: そのような勘違いをしているから、本来使われる筈の回路が放棄され、眠っていたのだ。
contexts.english: Since you don't know what you're doing, the circuit that is supposed to be used has been neglected and is dormant.

findings.description: Shirou’s denial that the rapid turn of events causes his agitation becomes saying disorientation is only one contributing cause.
findings.sourceReading: He explicitly says the pounding heart is not because events have suddenly accelerated; what startles him most is waking with Rin directly before him.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s denial that the rapid turn of events causes his agitation becomes saying disorientation is only one contributing cause.

contexts.japanese: 事態が急展開を迎えているから、って訳じゃない。
contexts.english: This isn't just because I'm disoriented from everything else.

findings.description: Shirou’s declared reason for entering the war is replaced by an assertion that he had no real choice.
findings.sourceReading: Above all, Shirou recalls that he said he would fight precisely because he cannot leave the conflict and its danger alone.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s declared reason for entering the war is replaced by an assertion that he had no real choice.

contexts.japanese: 俺はこの戦いが放っておけないからこそ戦うと口にした。
contexts.english: I said that I would fight. Not that I had any real choice.

findings.description: The other participants’ designs or motives become their expectations.
findings.sourceReading: Whatever intentions bring someone into the war, participation requires displacing rivals to survive.
findings.explanation: The other participants’ designs or motives become their expectations.

contexts.japanese: どのような思惑だろうと
contexts.english: No matter what your expectations are

findings.description: Stopping ruthless contestants even by force becomes doing everything possible to stop them, echoing their unrestricted methods.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou distinguishes his end from winning: he will stop, by force if necessary, anyone trying to win by using any means.
findings.explanation: Stopping ruthless contestants even by force becomes doing everything possible to stop them, echoing their unrestricted methods.

contexts.japanese: どんな手を使っても勝ち残ろうとするヤツを、力ずくでも止める事。

contexts.japanese: 出すわよ！
contexts.english: She already has!

findings.description: Shirou excluding death-as-salvation from his agreement becomes denying that Rin says it.
findings.sourceReading: 死が救いになる、という事ではなく limits Shirou's own assessment: correct in saving lives, not in death being salvation.
findings.explanation: Shirou excluding death-as-salvation from his agreement becomes denying that Rin says it.

contexts.japanese: 死が救いになる、という事ではなく
contexts.english: She isn't saying that death would save Sakura

findings.description: Long denial with hidden acceptance becomes habitual acceptance with hidden denial.
findings.sourceReading: ずっと否定してきて followed by 心の奥で受け入れていた distinguishes outward rejection from inward acceptance.
findings.explanation: Long denial with hidden acceptance becomes habitual acceptance with hidden denial.

contexts.japanese: ずっと否定してきて、心の奥で、受け入れていた
contexts.english: I've always accepted, but always wanted to deny deep down.

findings.description: Breaking a fixed window out of necessity becomes accidentally breaking glass.
findings.sourceReading: 嵌め殺し explains why she had no choice but to break it to escape; 仕方なく is necessity, not accident.
findings.explanation: Breaking a fixed window out of necessity becomes accidentally breaking glass.

contexts.japanese: 仕方なく窓ガラスを割ったのだろう
contexts.english: She might have accidentally broken the glass.

findings.description: Disclosure being the right outcome becomes being fine with the preceding unrealized separation.
findings.sourceReading: これで良かった says the present revelation was good; それだと describes the counterfactual continued suffering had she stayed undiscovered.
findings.explanation: Disclosure being the right outcome becomes being fine with the preceding unrealized separation.

contexts.japanese: けど、俺はこれで良かったと信じている
contexts.english: I'm sure I would have been fine with that.

contexts.japanese: それだと、俺はずっと桜を泣かし続けたままだった
contexts.english: so I kept her crying all this time.

findings.description: Present pleasure making recollection too much effort becomes a remembered pleasure from the earlier episode.
findings.sourceReading: 思い出すことも億劫なほどに気持ちが良い explains why he does not try to recall; it is current sensation.
findings.explanation: Present pleasure making recollection too much effort becomes a remembered pleasure from the earlier episode.

contexts.japanese: 思い出すことも億劫なほどに気持ちが良い
contexts.english: All I recall is how unsettlingly good it felt.

findings.description: Malfunction when energy is insufficient becomes a grotesque body that always craves energy.
findings.sourceReading: 魔力が足りないとおかしくなる gives a deficiency condition and abnormal reaction, not constant craving or a description of bodily appearance as grotesque.
findings.explanation: Malfunction when energy is insufficient becomes a grotesque body that always craves energy.

contexts.japanese: 魔力が足りないとおかしくなる身体
contexts.english: this grotesque body that always craves magical energy.

findings.description: Thinking only about relief through blood becomes only being able to feel good when drinking blood.
findings.sourceReading: 楽になることしか考えない is her self-accusation of obsessive thought, not an exclusive physiological pleasure mechanism.
findings.explanation: Thinking only about relief through blood becomes only being able to feel good when drinking blood.

contexts.japanese: 血を吸って楽になることしか考えない
contexts.english: who only feels good when she drinks your blood

findings.description: Refusing the one help he can give becomes hating him for that help.
findings.sourceReading: してやれる唯一のことを嫌がられたら is aversion to the offered act itself.
findings.explanation: Refusing the one help he can give becomes hating him for that help.

contexts.japanese: 俺にしてやれる唯一のことを嫌がられたら
contexts.english: if you hated me for the one thing I can do to help you.

findings.description: Cannot be awake becomes unable to get up.
findings.sourceReading: 起きている筈はない is a state-of-consciousness premise proving the proximity must be a dream, not a claim of immobility.
findings.explanation: Cannot be awake becomes unable to get up.

contexts.japanese: 起きている筈はない
contexts.english: I shouldn't be able to get up

findings.description: Both creation and collapse being catharsis becomes catharsis for both participants.
findings.sourceReading: どちらも refers to the two processes in the immediately preceding sentence, not Shirou and Sakura.
findings.explanation: Both creation and collapse being catharsis becomes catharsis for both participants.

contexts.japanese: どちらもカタルシスには違いない
contexts.english: It's cathartic for both sides.

findings.description: Inexperience becomes being not just experienced.
findings.sourceReading: 未熟 is inexperience/immaturity, further qualified by the defective teaching explanation.
findings.explanation: Inexperience becomes being not just experienced.

contexts.japanese: 未熟って言っても
contexts.english: you aren't just experienced.

findings.description: Rin originally uses Shirou's assurance that the treatment is not his concern to press him onward. “You don't want the procedure? Well, too bad” makes her dismiss an objection instead.
findings.sourceReading: Rin checks that the rough treatment itself is not his objection, echoing his explicit statement two pages earlier, and tells him to submit to it.
findings.explanation: Rin originally uses Shirou's assurance that the treatment is not his concern to press him onward. “You don't want the procedure? Well, too bad” makes her dismiss an objection instead.

contexts.japanese: 荒療治はイヤじゃないんでしょ
contexts.english: You don't want the procedure?

findings.description: Hostage constraints on helping freely become inability to help on short notice.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura’s being with Shinji is the obstacle to easy intervention, resolved by Shirou first recovering her.
findings.explanation: Hostage constraints on helping freely become inability to help on short notice.

contexts.japanese: わたしもおいそれと手は貸せない
contexts.english: I can't help you on such short notice.

findings.description: Conditional reciprocation of sincerity becomes rewarding already demonstrated loyalty.
findings.sourceReading: おまえが誠意を見せるなら僕も応える makes Shinji’s response conditional on a further show of sincerity.
findings.explanation: Conditional reciprocation of sincerity becomes rewarding already demonstrated loyalty.

contexts.japanese: おまえが誠意を見せるなら僕も応える
contexts.english: I'll reward that loyalty.

findings.description: The Japanese explains that intimidating pressure scales with sensed magical energy. The English instead says magical energy causes skin-crawling, losing the relation behind Shirou's comparison of Rider's strength.
findings.sourceReading: A Servant's intimidating presence varies in proportion to the magical energy perceptible through bodily sensation, supporting Shirou's assessment that Rider has changed.
findings.explanation: The Japanese explains that intimidating pressure scales with sensed magical energy. The English instead says magical energy causes skin-crawling, losing the relation behind Shirou's comparison of Rider's strength.

contexts.japanese: 魔力量に比例する
contexts.english: The raw magical energy that Servants give off is enough to make my skin crawl.

findings.description: Rin’s recalled no/not particularly answer becomes an additive Also.
findings.sourceReading: 別に answers Shirou’s question whether his answer was wrong in14p2; the recalled reply denies that premise.
findings.explanation: Rin’s recalled no/not particularly answer becomes an additive Also.

contexts.japanese: —別に。
contexts.english: ...Also,

findings.description: The Makiri history that should have ended becomes one that actually ended.
findings.sourceReading: 終わる筈だった sets up the reversal: they did not give up and adopted Sakura.
findings.explanation: The Makiri history that should have ended becomes one that actually ended.

contexts.japanese: そこで終わる筈だった
contexts.english: came to an end.

findings.description: Refusing to presume her pain becomes inability even to imagine it.
findings.sourceReading: おいそれと推測していいものじゃない is an ethical/epistemic limit on claiming easy understanding despite his lesser experience.
findings.explanation: Refusing to presume her pain becomes inability even to imagine it.

contexts.japanese: おいそれと推測していいものじゃない
contexts.english: could never even imagine the depths of her pain.

findings.description: Assent to the war through delegating Rider becomes assent to delegation alone.
findings.sourceReading: ライダーを預ける事で戦いに賛同 makes the delegation the way she continued to count as consenting to battle.
findings.explanation: Assent to the war through delegating Rider becomes assent to delegation alone.

contexts.japanese: ライダーを預ける事で戦いに賛同していた
contexts.english: she had consented to letting Shinji Matou command Rider.

findings.description: The condition to fight as a Master becomes a condition not to fight.
findings.sourceReading: マスターとして戦え names the coercive command to fight, and says starvation harms her even apart from it.
findings.explanation: The condition to fight as a Master becomes a condition not to fight.

contexts.japanese: マスターとして戦えなんて条件
contexts.english: the condition not to fight as a Master.

findings.description: A priest relying only on the Grail/miracle looking bad becomes seeking a divine miracle sullying his image.
findings.sourceReading: 聖杯にのみ頼る contains only: the objection is exclusive reliance instead of doing his own restorative work.
findings.explanation: A priest relying only on the Grail/miracle looking bad becomes seeking a divine miracle sullying his image.

contexts.japanese: にのみ頼る
contexts.english: a priest seeking a divine miracle.

findings.description: Predicting success in mental restoration becomes defining what he will consider success.
findings.sourceReading: 精神の呼び戻しだけならば、とりあえずは成功するだろう forecasts provisional success of the limited mental restoration, distinct from comprehensive treatment.
findings.explanation: Predicting success in mental restoration becomes defining what he will consider success.

contexts.japanese: とりあえずは成功するだろう
contexts.english: If I can revive her mind, I will consider it a success.

findings.description: Whether all Masters must be killed becomes whether they must kill each other.
findings.sourceReading: 全員 asks whether every Master must die, motivating the precise spare-one-or-two answer.
findings.explanation: Whether all Masters must be killed becomes whether they must kill each other.

contexts.japanese: マスターは、全員殺さなければいけない
contexts.english: Do the Masters have to kill each other?

findings.description: Rin feared another person had lured him becomes a rhetorical claim no one else would invite him.
findings.sourceReading: わたし以外の誰かが誘き出したのかと思った reports her brief mistaken interpretation of threat before seeing her own note.
findings.explanation: Rin feared another person had lured him becomes a rhetorical claim no one else would invite him.

contexts.japanese: わたし以外の誰かが、衛宮くんを誘き出したのかと思った
contexts.english: Who else besides me would invite you out here?

findings.description: Not being close enough for a proper personal letter becomes not writing something formal.
findings.sourceReading: 親しくなってない supplies relationship distance as the reason she wrote only business.
findings.explanation: Not being close enough for a proper personal letter becomes not writing something formal.

contexts.japanese: ちゃんとした手紙を送れるほど親しくなってない
contexts.english: it's not like I'd write something formal to you

findings.description: The maximum energy usable at once becomes a general limit on what accumulated energy can do.
findings.sourceReading: 一度に使える魔力の最大量 is the instantaneous throughput ceiling opposed to stockpiled reserves.
findings.explanation: The maximum energy usable at once becomes a general limit on what accumulated energy can do.

contexts.japanese: 一度に使える魔力の最大量
contexts.english: there's only so much they can do with it

findings.description: A peak energy-use ceiling becomes a generic limit on what stored energy can do.
findings.sourceReading: 一度に使える魔力の最大量 contrasts maximum energy usable at once against growing stockpiles.
findings.explanation: A peak energy-use ceiling becomes a generic limit on what stored energy can do.

contexts.japanese: 一度に使える魔力の最大量
contexts.english: there's only so much they can do with it

findings.description: Illya avoiding being disliked becomes a general aversion to forcing people.
findings.sourceReading: したくないコトさせたら嫌われちゃうから locates the feared consequence in other people disliking her.
findings.explanation: Illya avoiding being disliked becomes a general aversion to forcing people.

contexts.japanese: したくないコトさせたら嫌われちゃうから
contexts.english: I don't like forcing people to do things.

findings.description: Wait without expecting much becomes do not wait for me.
findings.sourceReading: 期待しないで待ってて asks him to wait with low expectations after her conditional tomorrow offer.
findings.explanation: Wait without expecting much becomes do not wait for me.

contexts.japanese: 期待しないで待ってて
contexts.english: Don't wait for me, though.

findings.description: Sakura being unwell and Shinji being away become Shinji’s absence causing her illness.
findings.sourceReading: 調子悪そうだし followed by 慎二は家を空けてばっかりだから gives separate reasons to keep people around her.
findings.explanation: Sakura being unwell and Shinji being away become Shinji’s absence causing her illness.

contexts.japanese: 桜、最近調子悪そうだし。慎二は家を空けてばっかりだから
contexts.english: It's probably because Shinji's never home.

findings.description: A week allowing surrounding events to settle becomes everyone liking the proposed duration.
findings.sourceReading: それだけあれば links elapsed time to 周りも落ち着いている, his predicted easing of circumstances.
findings.explanation: A week allowing surrounding events to settle becomes everyone liking the proposed duration.

contexts.japanese: それだけあれば周りも落ち着いていると思う
contexts.english: I think everyone will feel better about that.

findings.description: Sooner is better becomes this method being faster.
findings.sourceReading: こういうのは早い方がいい is why he should bring up the matter immediately.
findings.explanation: Sooner is better becomes this method being faster.

contexts.japanese: こういうのは早い方がいい
contexts.english: It's faster this way.

findings.description: Shirou's request to give the defeated Taiga another loss becomes a request to cheer her up. This removes the teasing intention that prompts Sakura's objection and his change of game.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou jokes that Sakura should follow Taiga's defeat by Saber with another defeat at cards. Sakura objects, and he switches to shogi, where Taiga excels.
findings.explanation: Shirou's request to give the defeated Taiga another loss becomes a request to cheer her up. This removes the teasing intention that prompts Sakura's objection and his change of game.

contexts.japanese: トランプか何かで追い討ちを頼む
contexts.english: cheer her up with a card game or something.

findings.description: An ethical prohibition on deceiving family becomes a preference not to tell untruths.
findings.sourceReading: 偽るような真似はしちゃいけない expresses must not, explaining why he cannot replace withheld truth with a lie.
findings.explanation: An ethical prohibition on deceiving family becomes a preference not to tell untruths.

contexts.japanese: 言葉で偽るような真似はしちゃいけない
contexts.english: I'd rather not tell her anything that's untrue.

findings.description: Unable to hold his sword becomes simply lacking a weapon.
findings.sourceReading: 長刀を持つ事もならない locates inability in his ruined body, denying even suicide.
findings.explanation: Unable to hold his sword becomes simply lacking a weapon.

contexts.japanese: もはや長刀を持つ事もならない
contexts.english: Without a weapon

findings.description: Far beyond eye candy becomes not eye candy.
findings.sourceReading: 目の毒なんてもんじゃない intensifies a distracting/tempting sight beyond that inadequate expression, not denies visual temptation.
findings.explanation: Far beyond eye candy becomes not eye candy.

contexts.japanese: 目の毒なんてもんじゃない
contexts.english: This isn't eye candy.

findings.description: Limiting tonight to patrol becomes holding off patrolling.
findings.sourceReading: 巡回に留めて proposes doing only patrol while delaying temple investigation until they have more information.
findings.explanation: Limiting tonight to patrol becomes holding off patrolling.

contexts.japanese: 今夜は巡回に留めて
contexts.english: hold off patrolling tonight

findings.description: If the temple Master caused the comas becomes stopping that Master from causing more comas.
findings.sourceReading: 昏睡事件を起こしているのなら is still conditional, following his explicit uncertainty over Rin’s account.
findings.explanation: If the temple Master caused the comas becomes stopping that Master from causing more comas.

contexts.japanese: 柳洞寺のマスターが昏睡事件を起こしているのなら
contexts.english: stop the Master from putting any more townspeople into comas

findings.description: A blindfold would stop him opening his eyes becomes a claim he never opened them.
findings.sourceReading: 目隠しなら誘惑に負けて目蓋を開けることもない describes a counterfactual benefit of the blindfold he lacked.
findings.explanation: A blindfold would stop him opening his eyes becomes a claim he never opened them.

contexts.japanese: 目隠しなら誘惑に負けて目蓋を開けることもない
contexts.english: Not once did I give into temptation and open them until my work was done.

findings.description: Only moans escaping his melted throat becomes inability even to moan.
findings.sourceReading: 呻きしか漏れない excludes every sound except moaning; his throat has already melted.
findings.explanation: Only moans escaping his melted throat becomes inability even to moan.

contexts.japanese: 喉はもう溶けて、呻きしか漏れない
contexts.english: It floods my throat, and I can't even moan.

findings.description: An impossible audible voice becomes a voice that does not belong.
findings.sourceReading: 食いついたままで、聞こえるはずのない声 ties the impossibility to a mouth still biting him.
findings.explanation: An impossible audible voice becomes a voice that does not belong.

contexts.japanese: 聞こえるはずのない声が聞こえる
contexts.english: I hear a voice that doesn't belong.

findings.description: Shirou rejecting apparent appeasement becomes Saber not being in the mood.
findings.sourceReading: ご機嫌をうかがっているようで嫌 locates reluctance in his own dislike of seeming to curry favor while they are fighting.
findings.explanation: Shirou rejecting apparent appeasement becomes Saber not being in the mood.

contexts.japanese: ご機嫌をうかがっているようで嫌
contexts.english: she didn't look like she was in the mood

findings.description: He has only compromised a little becomes merely feeling like potato salad.
findings.sourceReading: 負けたワケではない ... 少し日和っただけ is a comic hairsplitting admission of accommodation after declaring he will not appease Saber.
findings.explanation: He has only compromised a little becomes merely feeling like potato salad.

contexts.japanese: 単に少し日和っただけ
contexts.english: I just felt like making potato salad.

findings.description: Pushing despite poor health becomes pushing because of poor health.
findings.sourceReading: 体調が悪いっていうのに無理しようとした marks the illness as the reason not to exert himself, overridden by Sakura.
findings.explanation: Pushing despite poor health becomes pushing because of poor health.

contexts.japanese: 体調が悪いっていうのに無理しようとした
contexts.english: pushing yourself because you haven't been feeling well.

findings.description: The collision does not seem due to carelessness becomes it surely was carelessness, right.
findings.sourceReading: 不注意 ... というわけじゃなさそう rejects the easy explanation and leads to his question about a collapse.
findings.explanation: The collision does not seem due to carelessness becomes it surely was carelessness, right.

contexts.japanese: 不注意……というわけじゃなさそう
contexts.english: Surely, that accident happened because she wasn't paying attention...right?

findings.description: Saber's possible reasons for attacking become possible reasons for Caster's silence, introducing the suggestion that Caster has been caught red-handed.
findings.sourceReading: The narrator wonders whether Saber takes Caster's failure to react as an opportunity or an insult, immediately before describing Saber's advance.
findings.explanation: Saber's possible reasons for attacking become possible reasons for Caster's silence, introducing the suggestion that Caster has been caught red-handed.

contexts.japanese: 好機と取ったのか、侮辱と取ったのか
contexts.english: because we've caught her by surprise, or because she was caught red-handed?

findings.description: A soul-like thing that formed Caster becomes a soul modeled after Caster.
findings.sourceReading: キャスターを象っていた魂とも言えるもの is the soul-like thing that constituted/shaped the Servant, not a copy patterned on an already separate Caster.
findings.explanation: A soul-like thing that formed Caster becomes a soul modeled after Caster.

contexts.japanese: キャスターを象っていた魂とも言えるもの
contexts.english: The soul modeled after the Servant Caster

findings.description: Sakura having no option except going to Emiya’s becomes merely being able to go there.
findings.sourceReading: 帰るしかない supports Shirou’s confident but unverified inference that she has already gone ahead.
findings.explanation: Sakura having no option except going to Emiya’s becomes merely being able to go there.

contexts.japanese: 衛宮邸に帰るしかない
contexts.english: Sakura can just go home to my house.

findings.description: Inability to stop his momentum becomes deliberately preserving it.
findings.sourceReading: 勢いを殺せず describes failed braking as he tumbles out, subsequently hurting all over.
findings.explanation: Inability to stop his momentum becomes deliberately preserving it.

contexts.japanese: 勢いを殺せず
contexts.english: preserving my momentum.

findings.description: Cannot pull it out becomes Fool.
