findings.sourceReading: 抜ケ、ヌ is Assassin’s interrupted report that he cannot extract the lodged dagger; the next narration names that attempt.
findings.explanation: Cannot pull it out becomes Fool.

contexts.japanese: 抜ケ、ヌ
contexts.english: Fool—ngh!?

findings.description: Deferring thanks until breakfast becomes going to have breakfast.
findings.sourceReading: 朝メシの時にしよう carries forward the preceding plan to thank Saber: do it at breakfast because she is probably asleep now.
findings.explanation: Deferring thanks until breakfast becomes going to have breakfast.

contexts.japanese: 朝メシの時にしよう
contexts.english: so I'll go have breakfast.

findings.description: Severe nausea at the time impaired memory becomes thinking about it now causing nausea.
findings.sourceReading: 吐き気が酷くてよく覚えていない explains indistinct recollection through the earlier physical illness; he has just stated he feels well now.
findings.explanation: Severe nausea at the time impaired memory becomes thinking about it now causing nausea.

contexts.japanese: 吐き気が酷くてよく覚えていない
contexts.english: the thought gives me so much nausea that I can't remember.

findings.description: Sakura’s unfinished I, to Saber becomes Saber didn’t.
findings.sourceReading: わたし、セイバーさんに resumes Sakura’s guilt over her own words directed at Saber.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s unfinished I, to Saber becomes Saber didn’t.

contexts.japanese: わたし、セイバーさんに
contexts.english: Saber didn't—

findings.description: Shirou and Sakura caring for each other becomes both caring for Saber.
findings.sourceReading: 二人とも互いを気遣って means the two act out of consideration for one another.
findings.explanation: Shirou and Sakura caring for each other becomes both caring for Saber.

contexts.japanese: 二人とも互いを気遣って
contexts.english: your mutual way of being considerate to me.

findings.description: Normalizing longstanding hazards becomes claiming unprecedented current safety.
findings.sourceReading: He calls those incidents ordinary and argues that, if they mean danger, he has been in danger all along.
findings.explanation: Normalizing longstanding hazards becomes claiming unprecedented current safety.

contexts.japanese: そんなの全然普通じゃんか。それで危ないってんなら、今までずっと危なかったよ俺は
contexts.english: Well, I'm doing just fine. If anything, I'm safer now then I've ever been before.

findings.description: Hesitating over words becomes saying a wrong word.
findings.sourceReading: 下手に言い淀めば makes stalled disclosure the risk in Rin’s dangerous mood.
findings.explanation: Hesitating over words becomes saying a wrong word.

contexts.japanese: 下手に言い淀めば
contexts.english: if he says one wrong word.

findings.description: Disclosing why he became a Master becomes explaining how he did it.
findings.sourceReading: マスターになった理由 is the motive that feels like death to reveal; the interrupted thought resumes after Rin supplies his status-seeking motive.
findings.explanation: Disclosing why he became a Master becomes explaining how he did it.

contexts.japanese: マスターになった理由を明かす事
contexts.english: if he tells her how he became a Master.

contexts.japanese: なんでマスターになんてなったのよ
contexts.english: How'd you become a Master, then?

findings.description: Only being able to watch her leave becomes being unable even to see her.
findings.sourceReading: 去っていく遠坂凛を見つめる事しかできない describes his immobilized watching, with the next sentence explaining why he cannot attack.
findings.explanation: Only being able to watch her leave becomes being unable even to see her.

contexts.japanese: 去っていく遠坂凛を見つめる事しかできない
contexts.english: can't even see the departing Rin anymore.

findings.description: Rin's explanation loses the excessive self-love that she says produces Shinji's contempt. The contrast with her preceding description of self-hatred is consequently less explicit.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says excessive love of himself led Shinji to look down on others, whose superiority then trapped him in inferiority. This follows her description of a disposition involving self-hatred.
findings.explanation: Rin's explanation loses the excessive self-love that she says produces Shinji's contempt. The contrast with her preceding description of self-hatred is consequently less explicit.

contexts.japanese: 自分が好きなあまり周りを下に見たものの
contexts.english: You scorn everything around you

findings.description: Saber's condition—face Assassin alone or expose the Master to the first attack—becomes a statement of Assassin's preference. Her protective purpose remains clear from the door and surrounding warnings.
findings.sourceReading: Saber says that unless she faces Assassin one-on-one, the Master will be attacked first.
findings.explanation: Saber's condition—face Assassin alone or expose the Master to the first attack—becomes a statement of Assassin's preference. Her protective purpose remains clear from the door and surrounding warnings.

contexts.japanese: 一騎打ちで望まなければ、先にマスターを叩かれてしまう
contexts.english: Assassin prefers to kill Masters first, rather than duel other Servants!

findings.description: Daggers and retreat both meant to prevent closeness become actions under opposite conditions.
findings.sourceReading: 接近されては勝負にならぬ explains the throws because he would lose at close range; 接近されまい explains retreat to prevent her approaching.
findings.explanation: Daggers and retreat both meant to prevent closeness become actions under opposite conditions.

contexts.japanese: 接近されては勝負にならぬと踏んだからこその投擲、接近されまいとするからこその後退だ
contexts.english: If she closes in, he throws daggers to prevent her from finishing the fight, and if she doesn't close in, that gives him a chance to retreat.

findings.description: Asking whether she saw the daggers becomes asserting she saw them.
findings.sourceReading: おまえには見えていたのか is the question answered by her denial of seeing their actual forms and explanation of reading trajectories.
findings.explanation: Asking whether she saw the daggers becomes asserting she saw them.

contexts.japanese: おまえには見えていたのか
contexts.english: but you saw them nonetheless.

findings.description: Prey he meant to lure in becomes prey he has lured out.
findings.sourceReading: 誘いこむ筈の獲物 marks his intended draw into the trap, thwarted for now by a ranged weapon.
findings.explanation: Prey he meant to lure in becomes prey he has lured out.

contexts.japanese: 誘いこむ筈の獲物
contexts.english: the prey he lured out

findings.description: That was your mistake becomes that is certainly true.
findings.sourceReading: それが間違い rejects her one-on-one premise before contrasting her one with their two.
findings.explanation: That was your mistake becomes that is certainly true.

contexts.japanese: そう、それが間違いだ
contexts.english: That's certainly true.

findings.description: An arm unable even to strike becomes an arm only able to strike.
findings.sourceReading: 相手を殴りつける事さえできまい is the initial judgment of the apparently nonfunctional folded limb, before it unfolds.
findings.explanation: An arm unable even to strike becomes an arm only able to strike.

contexts.japanese: 相手を殴りつける事さえできまい
contexts.english: All it can do is dumbly strike his opponent.

findings.description: The necessity to carry duty through becomes merely still having something to do.
findings.sourceReading: やるべき事を、やり通さなければ insists on finishing what he must do despite loss of his means.
findings.explanation: The necessity to carry duty through becomes merely still having something to do.

contexts.japanese: やるべき事を、やり通さなければ
contexts.english: But I still have something to do.

findings.description: Having never said he would withdraw becomes having said nothing about fighting or forfeiting.
findings.sourceReading: まだ戦うつもりも何も dismisses the question of still fighting because he never said he was quitting.
findings.explanation: Having never said he would withdraw becomes having said nothing about fighting or forfeiting.

contexts.japanese: まだ戦うつもりも何も、降りるなんて言った覚えはないからだ
contexts.english: I still haven't said anything about fighting or forfeiting the war.

findings.description: An abrupt departure story becomes an urgent event forcing her to leave.
findings.sourceReading: 急な話だけど comments on the sudden news before saying she went home and will not return.
findings.explanation: An abrupt departure story becomes an urgent event forcing her to leave.

contexts.japanese: 急な話だけど、あいつは帰った
contexts.english: Something urgent came up, so she had to leave.

findings.description: How he ought to respond now becomes how he repaid her before.
findings.sourceReading: 何をもって応えるべきなのか asks what he should offer in response to the six days she was his sword.
findings.explanation: How he ought to respond now becomes how he repaid her before.

contexts.japanese: 俺は何をもって応えるべきなのか
contexts.english: how did I repay her?

findings.description: Having reclaimed something becomes having taken something from Shirou.
findings.sourceReading: 奪い返した is taking back, with no expressed object or source-person in this sentence.
findings.explanation: Having reclaimed something becomes having taken something from Shirou.

contexts.japanese: 奪い返したという事実
contexts.english: What she took from him.

findings.description: Wanting pleasure even at the expense of protection becomes wanting to waste his protection.
findings.sourceReading: それを無駄にしてもよろこびを得たい makes pleasure the goal, even if his protective efforts are made futile.
findings.explanation: Wanting pleasure even at the expense of protection becomes wanting to waste his protection.

contexts.japanese: それを無駄にしてもよろこびを得たい
contexts.english: wanting to waste his efforts to protect her.

findings.description: Self-reproach cooling the arousal-like heat becomes awakening it.
findings.sourceReading: 熱を覚まして is cooling here, fixed by preceding25 cooling through contrition and the immediate26 next line saying 熱が冷めても.
findings.explanation: Self-reproach cooling the arousal-like heat becomes awakening it.

contexts.japanese: 自責の念が、どこか昂奮に似た熱を覚ましていった
contexts.english: Her guilty conscience awakened a fever that was somehow like arousal.

contexts.japanese: 熱が冷めても
contexts.english: Even though the fever has cooled

findings.description: Killing leading to perplexity over crime and punishment is rearranged as unenjoyable suffering causing them to lose their way.
findings.sourceReading: 人が人を屠らばつまらぬ罪罰で迷おう says people killing people become troubled by crime and punishment, followed by his separate distaste for that suffering.
findings.explanation: Killing leading to perplexity over crime and punishment is rearranged as unenjoyable suffering causing them to lose their way.

contexts.japanese: 人が人を屠らばつまらぬ罪罰で迷おう。その手の苦しみは楽しくもないからな
contexts.english: There is nothing to enjoy about such suffering, and so they lose their way.

findings.description: Seeking the same thing from the Grail becomes seeking the same Grail.
findings.sourceReading: 聖杯に求めるものは同じ is Gilgamesh’s inference of a shared desired result despite differing motives.
findings.explanation: Seeking the same thing from the Grail becomes seeking the same Grail.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯に求めるものは同じ
contexts.english: we seek the same grail.

findings.description: Gilgamesh's announcement that he will act freely becomes permission for Kirei to do so.
findings.sourceReading: After accepting Kirei's inaction, Gilgamesh announces that he will act as he pleases and disappears.
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh's announcement that he will act freely becomes permission for Kirei to do so.

contexts.japanese: せいぜい好きにさせてもらうぞ
contexts.english: Do as you please.

findings.description: The father's assurance that Shirou can go alone becomes the mother's order that the father must not go alone. Speaker, addressee, and instruction all change.
findings.sourceReading: His father asks or affirms that the child can go alone, then tells him to wait outside.
findings.explanation: The father's assurance that Shirou can go alone becomes the mother's order that the father must not go alone. Speaker, addressee, and instruction all change.

contexts.japanese: お父さんはひとりでいけるな、といった
contexts.english: She told Dad not to go on his own.

findings.description: Everything being inverted becomes everything being crazy and merely comparatively normal.
findings.sourceReading: あべこべ and 逆 join reversed heat/cold to acceptance of a black sun at night.
findings.explanation: Everything being inverted becomes everything being crazy and merely comparatively normal.

contexts.japanese: だって何もかもあべこべだったのだ
contexts.english: After all, everything was crazy.

contexts.japanese: それぐらい、逆になっていて当然
contexts.english: It felt normal next to everything that was going on.

findings.description: A joke about urgent laundry protecting Shirou's household standing becomes a joke about purification and choosing silence. The feared social consequence changes.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou imagines urgently bleaching and spin-drying the evidence to avoid losing his standing to speak in the household.
findings.explanation: A joke about urgent laundry protecting Shirou's household standing becomes a joke about purification and choosing silence. The feared social consequence changes.

contexts.japanese: すみやかに漂白・脱水しなくては今後の発言権に支障をきたす
contexts.english: My first priority is to purify myself and then exercise my right to silence.

findings.description: Doing something that could transmit the cold becomes deliberately trying to transfer it.
findings.sourceReading: 風邪が移るような真似しちゃったの teases about intimate conduct whose consequence could be catching the cold.
findings.explanation: Doing something that could transmit the cold becomes deliberately trying to transfer it.

contexts.japanese: 桜ちゃんの風邪が移るような真似しちゃったの
contexts.english: did you try to transfer Sakura's cold over?

findings.description: Sakura's explanation that she receives meals here becomes a promise to feed Shirou. Cleaning changes from reciprocating hospitality to another part of caring for him.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura describes receiving hospitality: she spends mornings here and gets to eat dinner here, so cleaning is a reasonable contribution.
findings.explanation: Sakura's explanation that she receives meals here becomes a promise to feed Shirou. Cleaning changes from reciprocating hospitality to another part of caring for him.

contexts.japanese: ここで朝を過ごして、夕方もご飯を食べさせてもらってる
contexts.english: I spent the morning here, and I'm going to feed you dinner, too.

findings.description: Nursing even against her dislike becomes nursing despite awkward feelings.
findings.sourceReading: どんなに嫌がられても says he would persist even if she did not want the care.
findings.explanation: Nursing even against her dislike becomes nursing despite awkward feelings.

contexts.japanese: どんなに嫌がられても看病する
contexts.english: no matter how awkward it makes you feel.

findings.description: Finding unused rooms already tended becomes us tending them without thinking.
findings.sourceReading: 気がつけば手入れされていて gives Shirou’s discovery of the upkeep that the next paragraph attributes especially to Sakura.
findings.explanation: Finding unused rooms already tended becomes us tending them without thinking.

contexts.japanese: 使わない部屋も気がつけば手入れされていて
contexts.english: we've been tending to the unused rooms without even really thinking about it

findings.description: A feared possibility of contract termination becomes a certain result.
findings.sourceReading: 契約解除をしかねない says she might actually terminate it if he explains badly; this is Shirou’s apprehension.
findings.explanation: A feared possibility of contract termination becomes a certain result.

contexts.japanese: 本気で契約解除をしかねない
contexts.english: result in nothing less than Saber calling our contract null and void.

findings.description: Splitting leftovers or giving them to someone with room becomes a single halves-for-anyone plan.
findings.sourceReading: 半分にして分けるか、余裕のあるヤツに食べてもらう offers two alternatives for the remainder.
findings.explanation: Splitting leftovers or giving them to someone with room becomes a single halves-for-anyone plan.

contexts.japanese: 残ったのは半分にして分けるか、余裕のあるヤツに食べてもらう
contexts.english: split the rest into halves that anyone can help themselves too.

findings.description: Shirou's thought that Sakura is welcome to eat becomes a statement about her appetite, removing his reassurance that she need not hold back.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou thinks Sakura need not hold back: he has no objection to her eating the dorayaki.
findings.explanation: Shirou's thought that Sakura is welcome to eat becomes a statement about her appetite, removing his reassurance that she need not hold back.

contexts.japanese: どら焼きの一つや二つ、いくら食べても構わない
contexts.english: She's always ready for a dorayaki or two.

findings.description: Failure to fulfill a return promise becomes discovery of an already existing lie.
findings.sourceReading: そろそろ戻らないと嘘つきさんになってしまう says not returning soon would make him a liar about the note’s deadline.
findings.explanation: Failure to fulfill a return promise becomes discovery of an already existing lie.

contexts.japanese: そろそろ戻らないと嘘つきさんになってしまう
contexts.english: they'll know I was lying.

findings.description: Applying magical energy becomes clashing their two magical energies.
findings.sourceReading: 魔力をぶつけただけ describes a binding from simply directing magical energy at him.
findings.explanation: Applying magical energy becomes clashing their two magical energies.

contexts.japanese: 魔力をぶつけただけの呪縛
contexts.english: clash our magical energies to bind you in a curse.

findings.description: Her refusal to forgive him becomes a prohibition on talking to him.
findings.sourceReading: 話せるのは楽しいけど、やっぱり許してなんてあげない contrasts enjoyable conversation with her own continued unforgiving hostility.
findings.explanation: Her refusal to forgive him becomes a prohibition on talking to him.

contexts.japanese: やっぱり許してなんてあげない
contexts.english: It's fun talking to you, but I'm not supposed to.

findings.description: Being unable to choose either impulse becomes having to choose one.
findings.sourceReading: どっちかを取るなんてできない explicitly denies her ability to choose between talking and hostility.
findings.explanation: Being unable to choose either impulse becomes having to choose one.

contexts.japanese: どっちかを取るなんてできない
contexts.english: I have to choose one.

findings.description: Even specialists do not use transfer offensively becomes an exception allowing specialists.
findings.sourceReading: わたしや遠坂の魔術師でさえ、攻撃になんて使わない includes Illya and Tohsaka specialists in those avoiding offensive use because success is too low.
findings.explanation: Even specialists do not use transfer offensively becomes an exception allowing specialists.

contexts.japanese: 転移を得意とするわたしや遠坂の魔術師でさえ、攻撃になんて使わない
contexts.english: most mages wouldn't use it offensively, unless they're specialists like me or the Tohsakas.

findings.description: Stimulation while consciousness is transferred becomes stimulation before the transfer is done.
findings.sourceReading: 意識が転移先に移っている最中 covers the period it is at its destination, with bodily stimulus forcing recall.
findings.explanation: Stimulation while consciousness is transferred becomes stimulation before the transfer is done.

contexts.japanese: 意識が転移先に移っている最中
contexts.english: before the transfer is done

findings.description: Fear he will dislike her if forced becomes her disliking coercion as a principle.
findings.sourceReading: したくないコトさせたら嫌われちゃう gives her fear of being disliked as the reason to leave despite not wanting to.
findings.explanation: Fear he will dislike her if forced becomes her disliking coercion as a principle.

contexts.japanese: したくないコトさせたら嫌われちゃう
contexts.english: I don't like forcing people to do things.

findings.description: Illya being a girl as an additional reason to soften becomes simply her being a kid.
findings.sourceReading: 俺は年上 and イリヤは女の子 supply separate age and gender rationales in Shirou’s thought.
findings.explanation: Illya being a girl as an additional reason to soften becomes simply her being a kid.

contexts.japanese: イリヤは女の子な訳だし
contexts.english: Illya's just a kid.

findings.description: Questioning his own lack of anger becomes knowing better than to say it.
findings.sourceReading: 自分でもどうかと思うけど doubts the appropriateness of his not being angry.
findings.explanation: Questioning his own lack of anger becomes knowing better than to say it.

contexts.japanese: 自分でもどうかと思うけど、怒ってない
contexts.english: I should know better than to say this, but I'm not mad.

findings.description: Having been caught by her becomes having her here.
findings.sourceReading: こうして捕まってしまった以上 makes Shirou the caught party conceding to the chat she wants.
findings.explanation: Having been caught by her becomes having her here.

contexts.japanese: こうして捕まってしまった以上
contexts.english: As long as I've got her here

findings.description: Wait without expectations becomes do not wait.
findings.sourceReading: 期待しないで待っててね asks him to wait while not expecting her, matching the deliberately coy conditional offer.
findings.explanation: Wait without expectations becomes do not wait.

contexts.japanese: 期待しないで待っててね
contexts.english: Don't wait for me, though.

findings.description: Caster’s comparative elegance becomes impressive work.
findings.sourceReading: 醜悪さ being worse grounds 上品だった as more refined or genteel by comparison.
findings.explanation: Caster’s comparative elegance becomes impressive work.

contexts.japanese: キャスターは上品だった
contexts.english: Caster's work was impressive

findings.description: Repeating the projectile attack being fatal to the attacker becomes his life being available to take.
findings.sourceReading: 二度とはするな and 何よりおまえにとっちゃ命取り link the repeated action to its lethal consequence for the opponent.
findings.explanation: Repeating the projectile attack being fatal to the attacker becomes his life being available to take.

contexts.japanese: 何よりおまえにとっちゃ命取りだ
contexts.english: it's yours that's ripe for the taking.

findings.description: Pain failing to stop him becomes pain driving him into flight.
findings.sourceReading: 痛みで止まらねえんなら explains why a disabling cut would have been preferable: pain does not immobilize him.
findings.explanation: Pain failing to stop him becomes pain driving him into flight.

contexts.japanese: 痛みで止まらねえんなら
contexts.english: if I'd known the pain would drive him into flight.

findings.description: Disabling the limbs acquires an all-four requirement.
findings.sourceReading: 四肢の無力化 is limb disablement in contrast with bleeding; the next example considers disabling a single arm.
findings.explanation: Disabling the limbs acquires an all-four requirement.

contexts.japanese: これが四肢の無力化になると話は別だが
contexts.english: if one were to cripple all four limbs

findings.description: The full-rune defense failing even to delay becomes barely slowing the encroachment.
findings.sourceReading: 足止めにさえならない denies even a delaying effect despite the defense’s Noble Phantasm resistance.
findings.explanation: The full-rune defense failing even to delay becomes barely slowing the encroachment.

contexts.japanese: 足止めにさえならない
contexts.english: they barely even manage to slow the thing down.

findings.description: Feigning indifference until sensing an enemy becomes feigning helplessness to lure one out.
findings.sourceReading: 敵の気配を察するまでは無関心を装う keeps a collective indifferent appearance until detecting enemy presence.
findings.explanation: Feigning indifference until sensing an enemy becomes feigning helplessness to lure one out.

contexts.japanese: 敵の気配を察するまでは無関心を装おう
contexts.english: I'll act helpless until we lure out an enemy.

findings.description: The explanation that distance gives him no safe zone is omitted.
findings.sourceReading: 今の貴方の実力では間合いの外も内もない explains why withdrawing out of reach cannot justify relaxation at his current ability.
findings.explanation: The explanation that distance gives him no safe zone is omitted.

contexts.japanese: 今の貴方の実力では間合いの外も内もない
contexts.english: You must not let your guard down just because you've retreated out of your opponent's reach.

findings.description: That is precisely why disappears from her answer to his anger denial.
findings.sourceReading: だから、です follows his I’m angry and makes that lively anger part of why he looked happy; 自分で気付いてない then names his unawareness.
findings.explanation: That is precisely why disappears from her answer to his anger denial.

contexts.japanese: ……だから、です。先輩、自分で気付いてない
contexts.english: You didn't notice, then.

findings.description: Conditional obedience to a return order becomes an unconditional promise to come home.
findings.sourceReading: 帰れっていうのなら、帰ります offers return only if he tells her to, while begging him to stop before Shirou.
findings.explanation: Conditional obedience to a return order becomes an unconditional promise to come home.

contexts.japanese: 帰れっていうのなら、帰ります
contexts.english: I'll come home, I promise.

findings.description: A flushed face with fever not apparently much higher becomes a worsening fever with other body parts unchanged.
findings.sourceReading: 顔は熱で上気したまま and 熱自体はそう上がってはいなさそう distinguish continuing facial flush from apparent fever degree.
findings.explanation: A flushed face with fever not apparently much higher becomes a worsening fever with other body parts unchanged.

contexts.japanese: 顔は熱で上気したままだったが、熱自体はそう上がってはいなさそうだ
contexts.english: The fever appears to have worsened, though the rest of her body doesn't feel any warmer.

findings.description: Shirou's meal as repayment for the morning porridge becomes porridge with an accompaniment, removing the stated return of care.
findings.sourceReading: After putting the feverish Sakura to bed, Shirou must make something in return for the morning porridge.
findings.explanation: Shirou's meal as repayment for the morning porridge becomes porridge with an accompaniment, removing the stated return of care.

contexts.japanese: 朝のお粥のお返しを作らないといけない
contexts.english: make okayu and something to accompany it.

findings.description: The offer loses its specific reason: Sakura may be wide awake after resting so much. Shirou still offers her companionship.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou offers conversation if all her resting has left Sakura wide awake.
findings.explanation: The offer loses its specific reason: Sakura may be wide awake after resting so much. Shirou still offers her companionship.

contexts.japanese: 寝てばっかりで目が冴えてるんなら
contexts.english: If you want someone to talk to before you go back to bed

findings.description: The English keeps the broken-VCR joke but changes “I'd sooner fix that” into “this is like fixing that,” softening the heater's exaggerated difficulty.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou had complained that he would sooner repair Taiga's bisected VCR than tackle the heater.
findings.explanation: The English keeps the broken-VCR joke but changes “I'd sooner fix that” into “this is like fixing that,” softening the heater's exaggerated difficulty.

contexts.japanese: あんなの直すぐらいなら藤ねえが真っ二つにしたビデオデッキを直すぞ
contexts.english: This is like asking me to fix the VCR that Fuji-nee cut in half!

findings.description: Sakura’s remorse for her own action becomes asking Shirou to realize he was out of line.
findings.sourceReading: 迷惑をかけてばかりですけど……反省したんですよ continues her first-person acknowledgment of troubling him and reflecting she truly did something bad earlier.
findings.explanation: Sakura’s remorse for her own action becomes asking Shirou to realize he was out of line.

contexts.japanese: さっきのは、ほんとに悪いコトをしたんだなあって反省したんですよ
contexts.english: I hope you realize that you were out of line earlier.

findings.description: An unresolved search for the meaning of his solitary survival becomes an achieved sense of purpose through helping others. This changes why Shirou says he kept himself constantly occupied.
findings.sourceReading: He ran around town searching for meaning in having been the only one saved.
findings.explanation: An unresolved search for the meaning of his solitary survival becomes an achieved sense of purpose through helping others. This changes why Shirou says he kept himself constantly occupied.

contexts.japanese: 一人だけ助かった意味を探して
contexts.english: found meaning in helping as many people as I could

findings.description: Being liable to mistake her for a model student despite knowing her nature becomes immunity to being fooled because he knows.
findings.sourceReading: 本性を知ってるのに、優等生だって騙されかねない says the disguise is so convincing it might fool even him.
findings.explanation: Being liable to mistake her for a model student despite knowing her nature becomes immunity to being fooled because he knows.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂の本性を知ってるのに、優等生だって騙されかねない
contexts.english: I know who you really are, so you can't fool me with that overachiever image.

findings.description: Knowing why she is insecure becomes feeling the same negative judgment.
findings.sourceReading: 貴方とて判っている筈 says he should understand the evident reason she is about to explain.
findings.explanation: Knowing why she is insecure becomes feeling the same negative judgment.

contexts.japanese: 貴方とて判っている筈
contexts.english: Surely, you must feel the same way.

findings.description: His actions containing much wasted motion becomes spending time on trivial matters.
findings.sourceReading: 貴方の行動は無駄が多い criticizes inefficiency before the overdue morning greeting.
findings.explanation: His actions containing much wasted motion becomes spending time on trivial matters.

contexts.japanese: 貴方の行動は無駄が多い
contexts.english: You waste time on trivial matters.

findings.description: A recalled question about Sakura’s happiness becomes Sakura observing Shirou’s happiness.
findings.sourceReading: The quoted 嬉しいかって is the question he asked about her feeling at Rin’s stay, identified by31 and repeated to her in32.
findings.explanation: A recalled question about Sakura’s happiness becomes Sakura observing Shirou’s happiness.

contexts.japanese: 姉さんがここで寝泊りするようになって嬉しいかって
contexts.english: I said that you looked happy when she decided to sleep over.

contexts.japanese: 桜にとって今の状況がどんなものなのか、それを聞いていたんだっけ
contexts.english: I was listening to Sakura talk about our current living situation.

findings.description: Feeling blamed by her sister and herself becomes being scolded by her sister regardless of either’s actions.
findings.sourceReading: Both 姉さんにも自分にも are perceived sources of accusation; 気がして preserves Sakura’s feeling rather than authenticating Rin’s blame.
findings.explanation: Feeling blamed by her sister and herself becomes being scolded by her sister regardless of either’s actions.

contexts.japanese: 姉さんにも自分にも、何をしてるんだって責められてる気がして
contexts.english: no matter what she or I do, it ends up with her scolding me.

findings.description: That is why I warned you becomes anyway, it is dangerous.
findings.sourceReading: He reuses his earlier dangerous warning as a strained excuse after hitting his head.
findings.explanation: That is why I warned you becomes anyway, it is dangerous.

contexts.japanese: だから、危ないって、言ったんだ
contexts.english: Anyway, it's dangerous.

findings.description: If Illya dislikes fish becomes a fact that she does.
findings.sourceReading: 魚嫌いでも anticipates a possible objection and designs curry flavor to accommodate it.
findings.explanation: If Illya dislikes fish becomes a fact that she does.

contexts.japanese: イリヤが魚嫌いでも食べられるだろ
contexts.english: Illya doesn't like fish

findings.description: Belief it had not directly killed people becomes lack of a need to kill.
findings.sourceReading: 直接、人間を殺すなんて事はなかった筈だ concerns prior behavior as Shirou understood it.
findings.explanation: Belief it had not directly killed people becomes lack of a need to kill.

contexts.japanese: 直接、人間を殺すなんて事はなかった筈だ
contexts.english: It didn't need to murder them like this.

findings.description: Indiscriminate conduct becomes killing discriminately.
findings.sourceReading: 見境がなくなる asks about losing restraint or distinctions.
findings.explanation: Indiscriminate conduct becomes killing discriminately.

contexts.japanese: 見境がなくなってる
contexts.english: killing discriminately

findings.description: Rin's observation that the scene has not been cleaned becomes a claim that Zouken cannot clean it. Her conclusion that he was absent survives, but its stated evidential basis changes.
findings.sourceReading: Rin points to the unfinished cleanup as evidence that Zouken was absent: he would not have left body parts behind.
findings.explanation: Rin's observation that the scene has not been cleaned becomes a claim that Zouken cannot clean it. Her conclusion that he was absent survives, but its stated evidential basis changes.

contexts.japanese: 後片付けが出来てないでしょ
contexts.english: Because he can't clean this up.

findings.description: Uncertainty about winning the war becomes uncertainty about when it ends.
findings.sourceReading: 勝ち残ったところで evaluates what winning/surviving as victor would accomplish, supporting refusal to initiate fights.
findings.explanation: Uncertainty about winning the war becomes uncertainty about when it ends.

contexts.japanese: 勝ち残ったところでどうなるか判らない
contexts.english: I don't know what's going to happen once the war is over.

findings.description: The shadow being the greater priority becomes another equal concern.
findings.sourceReading: それ以上に explicitly ranks the shadow above Zouken in urgency.
findings.explanation: The shadow being the greater priority becomes another equal concern.

contexts.japanese: それ以上にあの影は放っておけない
contexts.english: we can't ignore the Shadow, either.

findings.description: A private wish formed since choosing Sakura’s side becomes the wish to choose her side.
findings.sourceReading: と決めた時から抱いた makes the earlier decision the onset of the private Grail wish, not the wish’s entire object.
findings.explanation: A private wish formed since choosing Sakura’s side becomes the wish to choose her side.

contexts.japanese: 桜の味方をすると決めた時から抱いた
contexts.english: my selfish desire to be on Sakura's side

findings.description: Fleeing revealing his own attraction becomes making Rin more self-conscious.
findings.sourceReading: Running away would make it look even more as though HE is conscious of Rin, leaving him no excuse.
findings.explanation: Fleeing revealing his own attraction becomes making Rin more self-conscious.

contexts.japanese: そんなコトをしたらますます遠坂を意識しているようで
contexts.english: it'll just make Tohsaka more self-conscious

findings.description: Illya's suggestion that Shirou should have cooked instead becomes a suggestion that he should help mediate while the sisters cook.
findings.sourceReading: Illya says Shirou could have cooked himself as the compromise instead of assigning Rin and Sakura together.
findings.explanation: Illya's suggestion that Shirou should have cooked instead becomes a suggestion that he should help mediate while the sisters cook.

contexts.japanese: 間をとるんだったらシロウが作ればよかった
contexts.english: shouldn't you be there to bridge the gap between them?

findings.description: Not being able to do everything Rin can becomes not being able to do anything as she can.
findings.sourceReading: なんでもできるワケじゃない denies all-capability, not all competence.
findings.explanation: Not being able to do everything Rin can becomes not being able to do anything as she can.

contexts.japanese: 姉さんみたいになんでもできるワケじゃない
contexts.english: I can't do anything like she can.

findings.description: What shaped Shinji becomes something he constructed in his head. The family revelation still overturns his self-image, but the sentence shifts emphasis toward his own mental construction.
findings.sourceReading: The revelation overturns both what Shinji believed and what had shaped him.
findings.explanation: What shaped Shinji becomes something he constructed in his head. The family revelation still overturns his self-image, but the sentence shifts emphasis toward his own mental construction.

contexts.japanese: 彼を形成していたもの
contexts.english: that he'd constructed in his head

findings.description: Unspoken attributed apologies become said sorry and only not necessarily aloud.
findings.sourceReading: 口にこそ出さないが explicitly distinguishes apologies read in her conduct from the actual speech at20.
findings.explanation: Unspoken attributed apologies become said sorry and only not necessarily aloud.

contexts.japanese: 口にこそ出さないが
contexts.english: She didn't necessarily say it out loud

contexts.japanese: ごめんなさい、と
contexts.english: She said, "sorry."

findings.description: Being able to discard brotherly dignity becomes losing dignity.
findings.sourceReading: 兄の尊厳も捨てられた says ignoring him would allow him to abandon the brother-role dignity and its hope.
findings.explanation: Being able to discard brotherly dignity becomes losing dignity.

contexts.japanese: 兄の尊厳も捨てられた
contexts.english: he would have lost his dignity

findings.description: The empty room being equivalent to a facade nameplate becomes unchanged ownership of the door name.
findings.sourceReading: ここは……表札と変わらない compares room to the externally displayed name, explaining its merely formal role.
findings.explanation: The empty room being equivalent to a facade nameplate becomes unchanged ownership of the door name.

contexts.japanese: ここは玄関にかけられた、間桐桜という表札と変わらない
contexts.english: It won't change the fact that her name is the one on the door.

findings.description: Illya eating only the potatoes becomes there having been no potatoes.
findings.sourceReading: She bites sweet-cooked potatoes, and he regrets her taking only potato pieces from the meat-and-potato dish.
findings.explanation: Illya eating only the potatoes becomes there having been no potatoes.

contexts.japanese: 肉じゃがなのにじゃがいもだけをつつかれる
contexts.english: It's too bad that I didn't have any potatoes on hand

contexts.japanese: 甘く煮たじゃがいもを頬ばるイリヤ
contexts.english: Illya is enjoying a mouth full of savory sweet beef stew.

findings.description: An apparent secret ingredient explaining difference becomes an unless exception.
findings.sourceReading: Rin says it differs because something like a hidden seasoning is in it; her uncertainty concerns the ingredient’s character.
findings.explanation: An apparent secret ingredient explaining difference becomes an unless exception.

contexts.japanese: 隠し味らしきものが入ってるから他のとは違う
contexts.english: Unless there's some secret ingredient that makes this one different from the rest.

findings.description: Not like Tohsaka becomes so like Tohsaka.
findings.sourceReading: 遠坂らしくない describes her unusually strained performance compared with normally effortless dismissals.
findings.explanation: Not like Tohsaka becomes so like Tohsaka.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂らしくない
contexts.english: That's so like Tohsaka.

findings.description: Reported treatment as an accident becomes not treating it as an accident.
findings.sourceReading: 事件じゃなく事故 explicitly contrasts criminal incident with accident in the public treatment she reports.
findings.explanation: Reported treatment as an accident becomes not treating it as an accident.

contexts.japanese: 世間じゃ事件じゃなく事故って扱いみたい
contexts.english: They aren't treating it as an accident.

findings.description: Separated blackened patches become bloodstains apart from blackened ground.
findings.sourceReading: 黒ずんだ地面が離れている means the darkened areas are separated from one another, probably through escape attempts.
findings.explanation: Separated blackened patches become bloodstains apart from blackened ground.

contexts.japanese: 黒ずんだ地面が離れている
contexts.english: They're some distance from the blackened ground

findings.description: Unnecessary prior worry becomes having always worried.
findings.sourceReading: 取りこし苦労だった identifies a fear that proves unfounded after learning Sakura smiles with him.
findings.explanation: Unnecessary prior worry becomes having always worried.

contexts.japanese: わたしの取りこし苦労だった
contexts.english: I was always worried about that.

findings.description: A head intrusively worked on by others becomes a head devoted to helping others.
findings.sourceReading: 人の手が入りまくった頭 describes his mind having other people’s intervention throughout, echoing invasive/cooking reconstruction imagery.
findings.explanation: A head intrusively worked on by others becomes a head devoted to helping others.

contexts.japanese: お節介なまでに人の手が入りまくった頭
contexts.english: My useless head, that only knows how to help other people so much it's a nuisance

findings.description: Paired left-arm distress and right-arm loss become the first being drowned out.
findings.sourceReading: The two sides are separately assigned pain/fear and pleasure/loss; 喪失 supplies depletion alongside sensation.
findings.explanation: Paired left-arm distress and right-arm loss become the first being drowned out.

contexts.japanese: 左手は苦痛と恐怖に、右手は快感と喪失に
contexts.english: the discomfort and fear of my left arm is drowned out by the pleasure in my right.

findings.description: Not being dizzy from the strange fantasy becomes it not being a strange delusion.
findings.sourceReading: おかしな妄想にではない negates the cause of dizziness, then identifies fear at genuinely finding the idea fun.
findings.explanation: Not being dizzy from the strange fantasy becomes it not being a strange delusion.

contexts.japanese: おかしな妄想にではない
contexts.english: It isn't some strange delusion.

findings.description: The one person she wishes happy becomes the one person who wishes her happy.
findings.sourceReading: 彼女が幸せになってほしいと願う modifies the person whose happiness SHE wishes, whom she fears ruining for her own happiness.
findings.explanation: The one person she wishes happy becomes the one person who wishes her happy.

contexts.japanese: 彼女が幸せになってほしいと願うただ一人の人間
contexts.english: the one and only person who wants her to become happy.

findings.description: Expecting him to have heard the previous ending becomes asking him about it.
findings.sourceReading: 聞いていよう presumes his knowledge before recounting the end.
findings.explanation: Expecting him to have heard the previous ending becomes asking him about it.

contexts.japanese: 十年前の聖杯戦争の終わりは聞いていよう
contexts.english: Let me ask you something about the end of the war ten years ago.

findings.description: A Grail expected not to adapt becomes Sakura being poorly suited to being a Grail.
findings.sourceReading: “適応しない聖杯” predicates nonadaptation of the planned entity and contrasts its unexpected growth with the decades experiment.
findings.explanation: A Grail expected not to adapt becomes Sakura being poorly suited to being a Grail.

contexts.japanese: “適応しない聖杯”だったはずの桜
contexts.english: despite being poorly suited to being a Holy Grail.

findings.description: Preparing its path to prevent rampage becomes preparing a path for rampage.
findings.sourceReading: 暴れださぬよう is explicit negative purpose in Zouken’s professed damage control.
findings.explanation: Preparing its path to prevent rampage becomes preparing a path for rampage.

contexts.japanese: アレが暴れださぬよう道を整えていた
contexts.english: I simply laid out a path for its rampage.

findings.description: Risk of swallowing the city becomes being intent on swallowing everyone.
findings.sourceReading: 呑み込んでしまいかねん is a feared possibility if current course continues.
findings.explanation: Risk of swallowing the city becomes being intent on swallowing everyone.

contexts.japanese: 呑み込んでしまいかねん
contexts.english: is bent on devouring every person in this city.

findings.description: Must acknowledge responsibility reaches Sakura becomes cannot recognize the sins as anything.
findings.sourceReading: 認めなく、て、は is the broken delivery of must acknowledge, not a simple inability to acknowledge. The object is that guilt extends to Sakura whatever the shadow is.
findings.explanation: Must acknowledge responsibility reaches Sakura becomes cannot recognize the sins as anything.

contexts.japanese: その罪は、桜に及ぶのだと認めなく、て、は
contexts.english: I can't recognize its sins as...

findings.description: Their discovering the meeting being bad for them becomes the meeting being unfair to them.
findings.sourceReading: それを知られるのは……良くはない specifically concerns the girls learning of it, explaining why he must return unnoticed.
findings.explanation: Their discovering the meeting being bad for them becomes the meeting being unfair to them.

contexts.japanese: それを知られるのは遠坂にも
contexts.english: It isn't fair to Tohsaka or the sleeping Sakura.

findings.description: What sustained Shirou becomes something he rejects, instead of something that now rejects him. The change alters the direction of his internal accusation.
findings.sourceReading: What has sustained him would turn against and negate him if he allowed the tragedy to recur.
findings.explanation: What sustained Shirou becomes something he rejects, instead of something that now rejects him. The change alters the direction of his internal accusation.

contexts.japanese: 今までおまえを支えてきたモノが、おまえ自身を否定する
contexts.english: you'd be rejecting everyone and everything that's supported you this far.

findings.description: A failed attempt to turn the lights on becomes never touching the switch.
findings.sourceReading: スイッチ入れてもつかない says they will not light even with the switch on.
findings.explanation: A failed attempt to turn the lights on becomes never touching the switch.

contexts.japanese: スイッチ入れてもつかない
contexts.english: I didn't touch the light switch.

findings.description: The barrier is not certain to activate becomes a categorical denial.
findings.sourceReading: 作動するとは限らない corrects the prior certainty by saying not necessarily, not never.
findings.explanation: The barrier is not certain to activate becomes a categorical denial.

contexts.japanese: 作動するとは限らない
contexts.english: No, we wouldn't.

findings.description: If it is shadow itself becomes a stated fact about its composition.
findings.sourceReading: アレが影そのものなら makes the escape deduction conditional.
findings.explanation: If it is shadow itself becomes a stated fact about its composition.

contexts.japanese: アレが影そのものなら
contexts.english: It's made of shadow

findings.description: Having no way to defeat the shadow directly becomes choosing the most direct method.
findings.sourceReading: 直接倒す手段がないのなら is a conditional lack of a direct means, leading to the obscured action against Sakura.
findings.explanation: Having no way to defeat the shadow directly becomes choosing the most direct method.

contexts.japanese: 直接、あの影を倒す手段がないのなら
contexts.english: The most direct way to defeat it

findings.description: Pain that could blind becomes pain of going blind.
findings.sourceReading: 失明しかねない qualifies the potential severity of numbing pain.
findings.explanation: Pain that could blind becomes pain of going blind.

contexts.japanese: 失明しかねない麻痺痛
contexts.english: The numb pain of going blind

findings.description: An eruption compared more to an explosion than to water becomes a geyser of water. The violent image survives, but the source's contrast disappears.
findings.sourceReading: The red eruption suggests an explosion more than a discharge of water.
findings.explanation: An eruption compared more to an explosion than to water becomes a geyser of water. The violent image survives, but the source's contrast disappears.

contexts.japanese: 吹き出す赤は、放水より爆発を思わせる
contexts.english: The gushing red reminds me of a sudden geyser of water.

findings.description: Others refusing help becomes Sakura refusing to save others.
findings.sourceReading: After nobody helped her, the people who fail to help others naturally cannot expect help themselves: her rationalization of their deaths.
findings.explanation: Others refusing help becomes Sakura refusing to save others.

contexts.japanese: 他人を助けてあげないんだから、他人に助けてもらえないのは当たり前
contexts.english: That I won't save them, so it makes sense that they won't save me, either.

findings.description: Their killings being unavoidable/unsurprising becomes everyone inevitably dying anyway.
findings.sourceReading: 殺されるのは仕方ない is her rationalizing their being killed in retaliation for withholding help.
findings.explanation: Their killings being unavoidable/unsurprising becomes everyone inevitably dying anyway.

contexts.japanese: みんなが殺されるのは仕方ない
contexts.english: they're all going to die anyway.

findings.description: Repeating his promise as the only way to forgive becomes repeated forgiveness itself.
findings.sourceReading: そう繰り返す refers to the just-spoken promise to protect; this repetition is their present means of forgiving each other.
findings.explanation: Repeating his promise as the only way to forgive becomes repeated forgiveness itself.

contexts.japanese: 今はそう繰り返すしか、互いを許す術がなかった
contexts.english: All we can do is forgive each other, over and over.

findings.description: Possible current activities become a completed sequence of all four chores.
findings.sourceReading: たり lists candidate ongoing things Sakura might be doing to explain her absence: washing, cooking, training, laundry.
findings.explanation: Possible current activities become a completed sequence of all four chores.

contexts.japanese: 顔を洗っていたり朝食の準備をしていたり道場で稽古をしていたり庭で洗濯をしていたりする
contexts.english: She must have washed up, made breakfast, trained in the dojo, and did laundry in the backyard.

findings.description: No concern while lying down becomes no concern provided she sleeps enough.
findings.sourceReading: 寝ている分には restricts safety to staying recumbent/resting.
findings.explanation: No concern while lying down becomes no concern provided she sleeps enough.

contexts.japanese: 寝ている分にはなんの心配もいらない
contexts.english: there's nothing to worry about as long as I'm sleeping enough

findings.description: Her magical-energy adequacy must be true becomes putting up with his embarrassment.
findings.sourceReading: そうであってもらわないと困る says it is necessary that the sufficient-energy answer actually hold.
findings.explanation: Her magical-energy adequacy must be true becomes putting up with his embarrassment.

contexts.japanese: そうであってもらわないと困る
contexts.english: so I'll have to put up with it.

findings.description: The switch itself going outside with the gun becomes also needing to remove the fuse.
findings.sourceReading: The correction says the activating switch itself would be outside, not that extraction prevents activation.
findings.explanation: The switch itself going outside with the gun becomes also needing to remove the fuse.

contexts.japanese: 入ってしまうスイッチそのものが外に出る
contexts.english: I need to get the fuse itself out of my head, too.

findings.description: Thawed or even further frozen becomes melted then frozen again.
findings.sourceReading: 氷解したようなさらに凍結したような gives contradictory uncertain impressions of the newly explained hostility.
findings.explanation: Thawed or even further frozen becomes melted then frozen again.

contexts.japanese: 氷解したようなさらに凍結したような
contexts.english: one mystery has been melted, only to be frozen again.

findings.description: Then wouldn’t she have enough stamina becomes she has plenty.
findings.sourceReading: なら...充分にあるんじゃないのか is a puzzled conditional question inferred from expected sufficient magical energy.
findings.explanation: Then wouldn’t she have enough stamina becomes she has plenty.

contexts.japanese: なら、体力だって充分にあるんじゃないのか
contexts.english: She's also got plenty of stamina.

findings.description: Inaction equivalent to assent becomes wanting it to happen.
findings.sourceReading: 肯定と同じ is her equation of nonintervention with affirmation.
findings.explanation: Inaction equivalent to assent becomes wanting it to happen.

contexts.japanese: それは肯定と同じだと思う
contexts.english: that means they wanted it to happen.

findings.description: Made as that kind of Grail becomes made to look human.
findings.sourceReading: そういう風に作られた explains her being a Grail homunculus rather than originally human.
findings.explanation: Made as that kind of Grail becomes made to look human.

contexts.japanese: そういう風に作られたホムンクルス
contexts.english: I'm just a homunculus made to look human.

findings.description: Already taken souls and subsequently greater attraction become stronger force pulling them away.
findings.sourceReading: By the time she noticed Caster/Lancer were taken and the other attraction had become greater, explaining subsequent majority capture.
findings.explanation: Already taken souls and subsequently greater attraction become stronger force pulling them away.

contexts.japanese: 引き寄せる力はそっちの方が強くなってた
contexts.english: Some other force stronger than me pulled them away.

findings.description: A world limited to the two houses becomes examples of closed-off spaces.
findings.sourceReading: この家と間桐の家しか知らない restricts her narrow emotional world to these two houses.
findings.explanation: A world limited to the two houses becomes examples of closed-off spaces.

contexts.japanese: この家と間桐の家しか知らない、閉じきった狭い世界
contexts.english: She's only known closed-off spaces, like the Matou house and mine.

findings.description: The condition for treating Shirou as an enemy changes from Sakura seeing him as one to Rider judging him dangerous. This alters the specific danger Sakura fears from Rider's continuing protection.
findings.sourceReading: Even if Shirou supports Sakura, Sakura's own recognition of him as an enemy would make him an external enemy to be defeated.
findings.explanation: The condition for treating Shirou as an enemy changes from Sakura seeing him as one to Rider judging him dangerous. This alters the specific danger Sakura fears from Rider's continuing protection.

contexts.japanese: 間桐桜が衛宮士郎を敵と認識してしまえば
contexts.english: if she judges him a threat to Sakura.

findings.description: Already too late becomes overdue.
findings.sourceReading: もう手遅れ concedes irreparable lateness while trying not to cause more trouble.
findings.explanation: Already too late becomes overdue.

contexts.japanese: もう手遅れだけど
contexts.english: It's overdue

findings.description: His mistaken reading of her question becomes her belief about his ability.
findings.sourceReading: てっきり...話だと思った is what Shirou had assumed the discussion concerned.
findings.explanation: His mistaken reading of her question becomes her belief about his ability.

contexts.japanese: てっきりアーチャーの腕を使えるかって話だと思った
contexts.english: Does she think I can use Archer's arm already...?

findings.description: Not allowing use becomes not forcing use.
findings.sourceReading: 使わせない prohibits allowing him to use it under any circumstances.
findings.explanation: Not allowing use becomes not forcing use.

contexts.japanese: どんな状況になろうとアーチャーの腕だけは使わせない
contexts.english: No matter what happens, I won't make you use Archer's arm.

contexts.japanese: アーチャーの腕は使わせないけど
contexts.english: We won't make you use Archer's arm

findings.description: Freeing the arm becomes beginning to use it.
findings.sourceReading: 自由にすれば is releasing restraint, whose mere exposure is dangerous separately from actual power use.
findings.explanation: Freeing the arm becomes beginning to use it.

contexts.japanese: この腕を自由にすればどうなるか
contexts.english: if I start trying to use this arm.

findings.description: No need to check becomes need to check thoroughly.
findings.sourceReading: 確認とる必要なかったじゃない is explicit negated necessity, irritated that Illya failed to disclose existing knowledge.
findings.explanation: No need to check becomes need to check thoroughly.

contexts.japanese: いちいち確認とる必要なかったじゃない
contexts.english: we need to thoroughly check that out.

findings.description: Rin’s duty to communicate the proposal becomes asking him.
findings.sourceReading: 伝える is telling/explaining to him because Rin wants him to Project.
findings.explanation: Rin’s duty to communicate the proposal becomes asking him.

contexts.japanese: 伝えるのはリンの役目でしょう
contexts.english: it's your job to ask him.

findings.description: Helping not because of endorsement becomes categorical disagreement.
findings.sourceReading: 決して賛同したからじゃない distinguishes duty as reason for helping from endorsement as reason.
findings.explanation: Helping not because of endorsement becomes categorical disagreement.

contexts.japanese: 決して貴女の方針に賛同したからじゃない
contexts.english: I don't agree with your direction at all.

findings.description: Parallel hypothetical effects become shadow destruction causing their inability to defend.
findings.sourceReading: し/わたしたちだって says shadow would be destroyed AND they too cannot block or dodge if targeted.
findings.explanation: Parallel hypothetical effects become shadow destruction causing their inability to defend.

contexts.japanese: わたしたちだってあんなものを振るわれたら防ぐ事も躱す事もできない
contexts.english: so we can't expect to block or dodge it.

findings.description: Materials matching original as closely as possible becomes as many ingredients as possible.
findings.sourceReading: 出来るだけ本物にそうよう is fidelity criterion, not number of components.
findings.explanation: Materials matching original as closely as possible becomes as many ingredients as possible.

contexts.japanese: 出来るだけ本物にそうように用意
contexts.english: gathering as many ingredients as we can

findings.description: Strengthening an existing object by Projection becomes Strengthening a Projection.
findings.sourceReading: 元からあるものを is the object; 投影で is the means; 強化する the operation.
findings.explanation: Strengthening an existing object by Projection becomes Strengthening a Projection.

contexts.japanese: 元からあるものを“投影”で“強化”する
contexts.english: 'strengthen' a Projection of something that already exists.

findings.description: No complaint if it can defeat Zouken becomes the only way to defeat him.
findings.sourceReading: 臓硯が倒せるなら文句はない is conditional agreement based on usefulness.
findings.explanation: No complaint if it can defeat Zouken becomes the only way to defeat him.

contexts.japanese: 臓硯が倒せるなら文句はない
contexts.english: it's the only way to defeat Zouken.

findings.description: Agreement if it helps becomes a promise to make it work.
findings.sourceReading: それでどうにかなるんなら conditions his assent on the plan offering a way forward.
findings.explanation: Agreement if it helps becomes a promise to make it work.

contexts.japanese: それで、どうにかなるんなら
contexts.english: I'll make it work.

findings.description: Unexpected ease of assent becomes unexpected assent itself.
findings.sourceReading: あっさり言うとは思わなかった specifies how easily she thinks he agreed, despite his narrated struggle and her expected answer.
findings.explanation: Unexpected ease of assent becomes unexpected assent itself.

contexts.japanese: あっさり言うとは思わなかった
contexts.english: I didn't expect you to say that you'd be okay with taking off the shroud.

findings.description: Rin’s prohibition on removing cloth becomes no compulsion to remove it.
findings.sourceReading: 決して外させない means she will never permit his taking the cloth off, unpacking the arm-use ban.
findings.explanation: Rin’s prohibition on removing cloth becomes no compulsion to remove it.

contexts.japanese: 決して聖骸布を外させない
contexts.english: I wouldn't make you take off the shroud.

findings.description: The refusal branch repeats no-permission as no-compulsion.
findings.sourceReading: 使わせない/外させない prohibit use/removal, confirmed by never contemplate removal next.
findings.explanation: The refusal branch repeats no-permission as no-compulsion.

contexts.japanese: 決して聖骸布を外させない
contexts.english: I wouldn't make you take off the shroud.

findings.description: Rewrapping ability gains removing it himself.
findings.sourceReading: 巻き直せる is rewrapping, allowing recovery from accidental loosening; full removal remains forbidden.
findings.explanation: Rewrapping ability gains removing it himself.

contexts.japanese: せめて自分で巻き直せるぐらい
contexts.english: at least take it off and put it back on yourself.

findings.description: Giving extra unsolicited advice becomes a previous needless warning.
findings.sourceReading: 余計な忠告をするね announces the aside she now gives about special Archer/Shirou relation.
findings.explanation: Giving extra unsolicited advice becomes a previous needless warning.

contexts.japanese: 余計な忠告をするねシロウ
contexts.english: It was a needless warning, Shirou.

findings.description: Denial of yielding to happy atmosphere becomes avoiding spoiling the mood.

findings.description: Return attempt opening becomes return completed before fixing hole.
findings.sourceReading: 座に戻ろうとする瞬間 tiny opening stabilized at onset/attempt to return.
findings.explanation: Return attempt opening becomes return completed before fixing hole.

contexts.japanese: 元の“座”に戻ろうとする瞬間
contexts.english: they return to the Throne they came from

findings.description: Unused mana outside the world becomes mana in 'this land,' and its abundance becomes the reason it has not been used. This blurs the distinction between the Grail's external reward and Fuyuki's slowly collected local supply.
findings.sourceReading: The outside contains unused mana in quantities incomparable with those on earth; this explains the immense energy available through the Grail.
findings.explanation: Unused mana outside the world becomes mana in 'this land,' and its abundance becomes the reason it has not been used. This blurs the distinction between the Grail's external reward and Fuyuki's slowly collected local supply.

contexts.japanese: 外側にはまだ誰も使っていない、この地上とは比べ物にならない
contexts.english: Nobody's used it yet, because this land is still suffused in an incomparable amount of mana.

findings.description: Outsider Masters expendable after summoning becomes after founders have own Servants.
findings.sourceReading: 自分たち以外のマスター…サーヴァントさえ呼んでしまえば outsiders only needed to call respective spirits.
findings.explanation: Outsider Masters expendable after summoning becomes after founders have own Servants.

contexts.japanese: 自分たち以外のマスターなんて、サーヴァントさえ呼んでしまえば
contexts.english: As long as they had their own Servants, the other Masters were just obstacles

findings.description: Greater Grail has not itself achieved Third Magic becomes cannot use it.
findings.sourceReading: 成し得た訳ではない denies accomplishment by Grail itself; summoned inherently capableAvenger not system’s achievement.
findings.explanation: Greater Grail has not itself achieved Third Magic becomes cannot use it.

contexts.japanese: 大聖杯自体が第三魔法を成し得た訳ではないわ
contexts.english: the grail itself isn't capable of using the Third Magic.

findings.description: Humanity-defining pride becomes mistreatment as subhuman.
findings.sourceReading: 唯一の誇りが人間以下の彼らを人間たらしめる self/the narrator’s hierarchy and salvific self-definition.
findings.explanation: Humanity-defining pride becomes mistreatment as subhuman.

contexts.japanese: 人間以下である彼らを人間たらしめる唯一の誇り
contexts.english: when they were treated as less than human.

findings.description: Negating all innate functions becomes many functions including extreme emotions.
findings.sourceReading: 機能すべて否定 includes hunger/slaughter/lovehate as innatefunctions, blanket impossiblepurity ideal.
findings.explanation: Negating all innate functions becomes many functions including extreme emotions.

contexts.japanese: 予め人に付属された機能すべてを否定して
contexts.english: rejected the many functions humans were born with, such as hunger, slaughter, and extreme love and hate.

findings.description: All sins knowable to them becomes all crimes known to humanity.
findings.sourceReading: 彼らが知り得る全て localpeoplepossibleknowledge scope.
findings.explanation: All sins knowable to them becomes all crimes known to humanity.

contexts.japanese: 彼らが知り得る全ての罪業を与え
contexts.english: They charged him with every crime known to man

findings.description: Different method becomes wrong method.
findings.sourceReading: 方法は違えど differentkindofsalvation/heroism, peopleview him hero.
findings.explanation: Different method becomes wrong method.

contexts.japanese: 方法は違えど、
contexts.english: The methods might be wrong

findings.description: Command be evil becomes judgment he was evil.
findings.sourceReading: 魔であれと定めた socialmandate constitutedrole.
findings.explanation: Command be evil becomes judgment he was evil.

contexts.japanese: 周りの人間がそいつに魔であれと定めたのだ。
contexts.english: the people around him decided that he was evil anyway.

findings.description: Cannot get past Rider becomes cannot allow her to act.
findings.sourceReading: 俺ではライダーをやり過ごせない states his inability to overcome or evade this obstacle with his current means.
findings.explanation: Cannot get past Rider becomes cannot allow her to act.

contexts.japanese: 俺ではライダーをやり過ごせない。
contexts.english: I can't let Rider do this.

findings.description: Possible future help becomes missed past opportunity.
findings.sourceReading: きっかけさえあれば彼女も力を貸してくれるかもしれない leaves future cooperation possible if an opening arises, conditional on his interpretation being right.
findings.explanation: Possible future help becomes missed past opportunity.

contexts.japanese: それが俺の思い違いでなければ、きっかけさえあれば彼女も力を貸してくれるかもしれない—
contexts.english: Unless I'm imagining it, she might have offered to help me if I'd given her a chance...

findings.description: Rider's departure without returning to Sakura becomes an inability to return to her Master. The English supplies a constraint where the passage reports her course of action.
findings.sourceReading: Rider departs to fight alone, neither returning to Sakura nor relying on Shirou's group, after rejecting his proposed means of saving her.
findings.explanation: Rider's departure without returning to Sakura becomes an inability to return to her Master. The English supplies a constraint where the passage reports her course of action.

contexts.japanese: ……桜の下に帰らず、かといって俺たちに頼る事もなく、ライダーは単身戦いに赴いていった。
contexts.english: ...Rider's going off to fight on her own. She can't return to her Master, nor does she want to rely on us.

findings.description: Visible hypothetical obstruction becomes enacted near collision.
findings.sourceReading: At a glance one can tell entering would immediately meet rock, so an ordinary person would not even try.
findings.explanation: Visible hypothetical obstruction becomes enacted near collision.

contexts.japanese: 中に入ったところですぐに岩にぶつかると一目で判り、まっとうな人間なら入ろうとすら思わない。
contexts.english: When I go inside, I nearly run into a big stone, and it doesn't look big enough to fit a person.

findings.description: Why make the sword for Rin becomes how it was made.
findings.sourceReading: なんで作ってくれたの asks motive for making it for her; she then explains her intent to kill Sakura.
findings.explanation: Why make the sword for Rin becomes how it was made.

contexts.japanese: 「宝石剣。なんで作ってくれたの」
contexts.english: "The Jeweled Sword. How did you make it?"

contexts.japanese: 「なんでって、なんでさ」
contexts.english: "How? Why are you asking?"

findings.description: Rin holding Sakura off becomes settling the score.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou reads her encouragement as come while she can keep Sakura stopped or contained.
findings.explanation: Rin holding Sakura off becomes settling the score.

contexts.japanese: 要するにあいつは、自分が桜を止めておけるうちに来いと、遠まわしに応援してくれたのだ。
contexts.english: In other words, telling me to come before she settles the score with Sakura was her roundabout way of cheering me on.

findings.description: Not beginning as sword-skill contest becomes no such contest at all.
findings.sourceReading: He must first find an opening; the fight does not start from straightforward competition of sword skill.
findings.explanation: Not beginning as sword-skill contest becomes no such contest at all.

contexts.japanese: ……この戦いは、剣技を競うところからなど始まらない。
contexts.english: ...This battle isn't a contest of sword skills at all.

findings.description: Rule-bound reprieve becomes Saber’s decision and approach allowance.
findings.sourceReading: それが決まりです refers to the rule; reprieve lasts until he steps forward.
findings.explanation: Rule-bound reprieve becomes Saber’s decision and approach allowance.

contexts.japanese: 「……それが決まりですから。貴方が前に踏み出すまでは猶予を与えます。
contexts.english: "...Because I decided so. I will give you time to approach me.

findings.description: Shirou’s compulsion to reach Sakura becomes Saber refusing access.
findings.sourceReading: 貴方は桜の下に行くしかない explains why he cannot wait indefinitely and must attack.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s compulsion to reach Sakura becomes Saber refusing access.

contexts.japanese: ですが、それもじき終わる。貴方は桜の下に行くしかない。私が動くまでもなく、貴方の方が耐えられずに仕掛けてくる」
contexts.english: But it will end there. I will not let you go to Sakura. I don't need to move. You will run out of patience and attack me."

findings.description: Shirou’s defensive struggle becomes Saber under his assault.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou is wholly on defense; only his opening attack was allowed, after which he keeps blocking Saber.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s defensive struggle becomes Saber under his assault.

contexts.japanese: 防戦一方。
contexts.english: I have her on the defense.

contexts.japanese: 攻め手が許されたのは初撃のみ、後はひたすらセイバーの剣を防ぐだけ。
contexts.english: I only allowed her to attack during the first exchange, and now Saber can only defend against my assault.

findings.description: Against Sakura alone conditional becomes Sakura is alone.
findings.sourceReading: 逆に桜一人なら gives the conditional contrast: if Rin only faces Sakura.
findings.explanation: Against Sakura alone conditional becomes Sakura is alone.

contexts.japanese: けど、逆に—桜一人なら、遠坂は必ず—
contexts.english: But Sakura's alone, Tohsaka will definitely...

findings.description: Separate lives or fates become sharing a life in sword verse.
findings.sourceReading: 別命 and later 命ヲ別ツ retain separation or parting of life/fate in the two-hero line.
findings.explanation: Separate lives or fates become sharing a life in sword verse.

contexts.japanese: 両雄倶別命
contexts.english: Let Two Great Men Share a Life

contexts.japanese: —両雄、共ニ命ヲ別ツ……！
contexts.english: Neither of us will embrace Heaven. (Let two great men share a life.)

findings.description: Enemy has no further movement becomes boy has nothing else.
findings.sourceReading: Paragraph explains the enemy’s limit and exposed state: she has nothing beyond that defense at this instant.
findings.explanation: Enemy has no further movement becomes boy has nothing else.

contexts.japanese: つまり、その先はない。
contexts.english: I have nothing else.

findings.description: Not sharing one heaven becomes neither person embracing Heaven.
findings.sourceReading: Ruby われら、ともにてんをいだかず invokes mutual noncoexistence under one heaven, alongside the separating-lives base line.
findings.explanation: Not sharing one heaven becomes neither person embracing Heaven.

contexts.japanese: —両雄、共ニ命ヲ別ツ……！
contexts.english: Neither of us will embrace Heaven. (Let two great men share a life.)

findings.description: Those staying at limit versus going beyond become one man’s progression.
findings.sourceReading: 限界に留まったものと、その先に行ったもの contrasts two conditions or parties, naturally Saber versus Shirou in this ending.
findings.explanation: Those staying at limit versus going beyond become one man’s progression.

contexts.japanese: ……限界に留まったものと、その先に行ったもの。
contexts.english: ...He reached his limits, and stepped beyond them.

findings.description: Power to oppose Sakura becomes Sakura possessing power.
findings.sourceReading: The head noun is the power needed to confront Sakura, who possessed extraordinary mana.
findings.explanation: Power to oppose Sakura becomes Sakura possessing power.

contexts.japanese: あの、とんでもない魔力を誇っていた桜に対抗する力。
contexts.english: Um, Sakura has an incredible amount of magical energy.

contexts.japanese: 「今回は諦めろ。イリヤスフィールをこちらで保護すれば、まだ猶予は出来る。間桐桜と話がしたいのなら、彼女に対抗できる力を用意してからだ」
contexts.english: "Give up on her this time. If we can secure Illyasviel, it will buy us more time. If you want to speak to Sakura Matou, do so once you have a way to resist her."

contexts.japanese: ……そんなもの、用意できるとしたら遠坂だけだ。
contexts.english: ...The only one who might be able to do that is Tohsaka.

findings.description: Setting resonance aside becomes hoping that is all.
findings.sourceReading: それはいいが sets the resonance explanation aside before the contingency of fighting Sakura.
findings.explanation: Setting resonance aside becomes hoping that is all.

contexts.japanese: 「判るというよりは共鳴だ。……それはいいが。万が一、間桐桜と戦う事になれば私は撤退する。
contexts.english: "It is more that I resonate with her... I hope that is all. If we should happen to engage Sakura Matou in combat, I will retreat.

findings.description: The thing changing Sakura becomes the thing Sakura is turning into.
findings.sourceReading: The entity inside the Grail causes her transformation, but remains her shadow; priest explicitly denies that materialization means her becoming the Shadow.
findings.explanation: The thing changing Sakura becomes the thing Sakura is turning into.

contexts.japanese: 間桐桜を変貌させているものは聖杯の中にいるモノだが、ソレとてあくまで彼女の影なのだ。
contexts.english: Sakura Matou is turning into the thing inside the Holy Grail, but it is ultimately her own shadow.

contexts.japanese: 「いや。多少の共感はあるだろうが、影の本体は聖杯の中にいる。
contexts.english: "No. They may share feelings with each other to some extent, but the Shadow's main body is inside the Holy Grail.

findings.description: No initial happiness becomes not necessarily born happy.
findings.sourceReading: Character categorically says humans too are not happy from the outset, then explains zero knowledge of happiness.
findings.explanation: No initial happiness becomes not necessarily born happy.

contexts.japanese: 「だが、人間とて初めから幸福である事はない。
contexts.english: "However, humans are not necessarily born happy.

findings.description: Becoming good or evil becomes distinguishing good and evil.
findings.sourceReading: Which branch a human takes, good or evil, depends on learning; responsibility then concerns environment and self.
findings.explanation: Becoming good or evil becomes distinguishing good and evil.

contexts.japanese: 「善か悪か。どちらに別れるかは人間の学習次第だ。
contexts.english: "Our ability to distinguish good and evil depends on our education.

findings.description: Changing Kirei's own way becomes changing Hell's nature.
findings.sourceReading: After calling this his own way of life, Kirei says changing himself is difficult even if Sakura gives birth to Hell. Base 己 and ruby ソレ support the self/way reference.
findings.explanation: Changing Kirei's own way becomes changing Hell's nature.

contexts.japanese: 間桐桜から生まれ出るものが地獄であろうと、己を変える事こそ難しい」
contexts.english: Even if Sakura Matou gives birth to Hell itself, it would be difficult to change its nature."

contexts.japanese: 「—私は今までそのように生きてきた。
contexts.english: "That is how I have always lived.

contexts.japanese: この生き方は私の物だ。
contexts.english: This way of life is my own.

findings.description: Need for Illya's proper form becomes instruction to take it afterward.
findings.sourceReading: Her assuming the original or proper form is necessary for granting the wish; the following instruction concerns waiting for ritual dress.
findings.explanation: Need for Illya's proper form becomes instruction to take it afterward.

contexts.japanese: だが、それにはあの娘に本来の姿になって貰わねばならん。ワシはホムンクルスは管轄外でな。あやつらが正装を整えるまでは好きにさせておけばよい」
contexts.english: But you will need to take it once she reverts to her original form. Homunculi are out of my area of expertise. Let her do what she wants until the dress is ready."

findings.description: Illya's inability to escape her inherited purpose becomes Zouken's refusal to let her escape. The later cooperation lines partly preserve his reasoning, so the change is local rather than a complete removal of it.
findings.sourceReading: The narration presents Zouken's confidence that Illya cannot escape her inherited purpose: even if released, she will cooperate and come to the Grail's heart herself.
findings.explanation: Illya's inability to escape her inherited purpose becomes Zouken's refusal to let her escape. The later cooperation lines partly preserve his reasoning, so the change is local rather than a complete removal of it.

contexts.japanese: 何が起ころうとイリヤスフィールは逃げだせない。
contexts.english: No matter what happens, he will not let Illyasviel escape.

contexts.japanese: あの白い娘は、もはや臓硯が手を放したところで自分から協力する。
contexts.english: That pale girl is willing to cooperate with Zouken, even without his urging.

findings.description: Shirou's two permitted Projection sources become Archer's habits.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou says he can Project only what he personally saw or weapons Archer has previously made; a blueprint and imitated dagger alone are insufficient.
findings.explanation: Shirou's two permitted Projection sources become Archer's habits.

contexts.japanese: 「けどイリヤ。俺は自分で見たものか、アーチャーが作った事のある武器しか投影できない。宝石剣とやらの情報は皆無だ。いくら宝石剣に真似た短剣と元になる設計図があっても、宝石剣は複製できないぞ」
contexts.english: "But Illya, from what I've seen, Archer only Projects specific weapons. I don't have any information about the Jeweled Sword. Even if I have blueprints and a similar example, I can't replicate it."

contexts.japanese: 「分かってるわ。シロウにはまず、わたしの記録に入ってもらう。わたしだって見た事はないけど、わたしの中には宝石剣の記録があるわ。
contexts.english: "I know. I'm going to have you search the records inside me. I haven't personally seen it, but there's a record of the Jeweled Sword inside my mind.

findings.description: Damage beyond the concept of pain becomes mismatched bodily pain perception.
findings.sourceReading: Boy falls into layered revolving pain while self-damage eats him, damage to which even recognition as pain no longer applies.
findings.explanation: Damage beyond the concept of pain becomes mismatched bodily pain perception.

contexts.japanese: 痛みのない、痛みという認識はもはや該当しない自己の損傷に蝕まれながら、何重にも回転する痛みの中に落ちていく。
contexts.english: There's no pain. My pain perception plunges into layers of spinning pain, but it's eroded by damage to my body which doesn't correspond to the pain.

findings.description: The circuit's resemblance to a huge rotating observatory becomes a view of Arizona through a telescope, changing the image used to describe the ritual structure.
findings.sourceReading: The enormous circuit resembles an enormous observation apparatus rotating alone in the Arizona wilderness.
findings.explanation: The circuit's resemblance to a huge rotating observatory becomes a view of Arizona through a telescope, changing the image used to describe the ritual structure.

contexts.japanese: アリゾナの荒野に独りきりで回る、大きな大きな観測装置に酷似している。
contexts.english: It's like I'm looking out across the landscape of Arizona through a huge telescope.

findings.description: Diverting attention to extraneous matters becomes cutting attention away from them.
findings.sourceReading: He gave part of his attention to unnecessary things; because attention was divided, his perceived body halved.
findings.explanation: Diverting attention to extraneous matters becomes cutting attention away from them.

contexts.japanese: 余分な事に意識を割いた。意識を割いたから、体が半分になった。
contexts.english: I cut my consciousness off from the excess. Because I cut my mind, my body becomes half its size.

findings.description: Need to use another Projection becomes should not try.
findings.sourceReading: Boy corrects can manage another to must use it, to save Sakura by a method different from Rin's.
findings.explanation: Need to use another Projection becomes should not try.

contexts.japanese: —いや、使わなくてはいけない。
contexts.english: Not that I should try.

contexts.japanese: これなら、あと一回ぐらいはなんとか投影が使える。
contexts.english: I should be able to manage one more Projection.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂とは違う方法で桜を救う。
contexts.english: I'm going to save Sakura using a different way than Tohsaka.

findings.description: Prepare a trump card before departure becomes save trump card for battle.
findings.sourceReading: Repeated guidance is to prepare the trump card before heading to final battle, then asks why the player failed to do their best.
findings.explanation: Prepare a trump card before departure becomes save trump card for battle.

contexts.japanese: その通り！　最終決戦に向かう時は『切り札』を用意してから行けと、毎回毎回言っているのに何故ベストをつくさないのか！
contexts.english: Exactly! They've told you over and over to save your trump card for the final battle, so why aren't you bringing your best to this fight!?

findings.description: Hierarchy remained until revolt becomes Sakura waited for rebellion time.
findings.sourceReading: Until this present revolt, unhidden takeover aim and her nonresistance made the old hierarchy unproblematic.
findings.explanation: Hierarchy remained until revolt becomes Sakura waited for rebellion time.

contexts.japanese: こうして—少女が老魔術師に反旗を翻すこの時までは。
contexts.english: So... she only had to wait until it was time to raise the flag of rebellion.
