contexts.japanese: 老魔術師は己の目的を隠そうともせず、少女は老魔術師の意向に逆らわなかった。
contexts.english: The old mage never bothered to hide his objective, and the girl could not defy his will.

contexts.japanese: だから問題などなかったのだ。
contexts.english: So there was no problem.

findings.description: Speed enabling disengagement becomes speed contrasted with forced retreat.
findings.sourceReading: Only her superhuman speed enables her to disengage despite receiving Saber's counterattacks.
findings.explanation: Speed enabling disengagement becomes speed contrasted with forced retreat.

contexts.japanese: ……超人的なスピードを誇る彼女だからこそ、セイバーの反撃を受けつつ離脱できる。
contexts.english: She boasts superhuman speed, but she's being forced back by Saber's counterattacks.

findings.description: Ignoring future cost becomes foregone outcome.
findings.sourceReading: Rider gives no thought to afterward while burning all resources to contain Saber.
findings.explanation: Ignoring future cost becomes foregone outcome.

contexts.japanese: 後の事など考えない。
contexts.english: The conclusion seems forgone.

findings.description: Offense preventing Saber attack becomes Saber stopping Rider with attacks.
findings.sourceReading: Rider keeps attacking in order to prevent Saber taking initiative; if Saber attacks both Rider and boy die immediately.
findings.explanation: Offense preventing Saber attack becomes Saber stopping Rider with attacks.

contexts.japanese: ライダーは攻め続ける事で、セイバーの攻撃を防いでいる。
contexts.english: Rider keeps attacking, while Saber stops her with attacks of her own.

contexts.japanese: セイバーが攻撃に転ずれば、自分はおろか主である少年まで瞬殺されるだろう。
contexts.english: Rider knows that she and the boy she calls Master will be killed instantly if Saber goes on the offense.

findings.description: Boy cannot complain becomes Rider is not whining.
findings.sourceReading: Because Rider fights desperately for him, boy says he cannot offer complaints and must fight by his own means.
findings.explanation: Boy cannot complain becomes Rider is not whining.

contexts.japanese: 泣き言はいえない。
contexts.english: She isn't whining.

contexts.japanese: ライダーは決死で戦ってくれている。
contexts.english: Rider is fighting for her life.

contexts.japanese: 俺は　　俺も　　自分にできる事で、たたか、
contexts.english: I     I too    need to do what I can, I can figh—

findings.description: Not actually generated from nothing becomes no longer from nothing.
findings.sourceReading: Apparent ex-nihilo manifestation is explained instead as multiple similarities becoming apparent through expansion.
findings.explanation: Not actually generated from nothing becomes no longer from nothing.

contexts.japanese: 空想は混濁と化しながら法則を持ち、無より生じるソレは無より生じたのではなく拡大する事で浮かび上がる多くの類似。
contexts.english: Fantasy becomes chaos with laws. That which came from nothingness no longer comes from nothingness, and many similarities arise through its expansion.

findings.description: Saber's involuntary staggering becomes a planted stance. The resulting opening for Rider remains, but its physical cause changes.
findings.sourceReading: Saber staggers after deflecting the sword and cannot pursue Rider, creating the two-second opening.
findings.explanation: Saber's involuntary staggering becomes a planted stance. The resulting opening for Rider remains, but its physical cause changes.

contexts.japanese: 放たれた螺旋の剣を弾いたセイバーは、ライダーを追えずにたたらを踏んでいる。
contexts.english: Saber repels my loosed spiral sword and plants her feet instead of pursuing Rider.

findings.description: Petals shattered by black light become petals scattering black light.
findings.sourceReading: Four wings/petals have been shattered by black aurora and scatter as the chamber fills white.
findings.explanation: Petals shattered by black light become petals scattering black light.

contexts.japanese: 黒い極光に打ち砕かれた四枚羽を撒き散らしながら、
contexts.english: Four petals scatter the black light,

findings.description: Broken shield petals become black-light-scattering petals in other branch.
findings.sourceReading: Four petals broken by black aurora scatter before white light wins.
findings.explanation: Broken shield petals become black-light-scattering petals in other branch.

contexts.japanese: 黒い極光に打ち砕かれた四枚羽を撒き散らしながら、
contexts.english: Four petals scatter the black light,

findings.description: Instruction to go and hold Rin's hand becomes Sakura's placement and permission.
findings.sourceReading: After reporting Rin's repeated pleas, Sakura tells Shirou to go beside her and hold her hand.
findings.explanation: Instruction to go and hold Rin's hand becomes Sakura's placement and permission.

contexts.japanese: 「姉さんったら、さっきから先輩に助けを求めてばっかりなんだもの。すぐ傍にいって、手でも握ってあげてくださいね」
contexts.english: "Silly Nee-san. She started begging you for help. I'll put you right next to her, where you can even hold hands."

findings.description: Estimate of recovered strength becomes deliberate recovery for this purpose.
findings.sourceReading: Rider thinks she has recovered sufficient strength to carry the two women.
findings.explanation: Estimate of recovered strength becomes deliberate recovery for this purpose.

contexts.japanese: 安心してください。それだけの体力は回復してきたつもりです」
contexts.english: Be assured, I took the time to recover enough for that very purpose."

findings.description: Irrecoverable body and another day of meaningful self become sluggishness and a worthwhile current day.
findings.sourceReading: Body is beyond saving, but stopping now might preserve meaningful selfhood for about a day; the next line calls this one-day life extension.
findings.explanation: Irrecoverable body and another day of meaningful self become sluggishness and a worthwhile current day.

contexts.japanese: この体は手遅れだけど、ここで止めておけば一日ぐらいは意味を失わずに済む。
contexts.english: This body is sluggish, but if I can stop it all here, this day won't have been for nothing.

contexts.japanese: 一日だけの延命。
contexts.english: A one-day lease on life.

findings.description: Pain cannot stop memory loss becomes he cannot stop both pain and memory loss.
findings.sourceReading: Even the pain of loss cannot halt disappearing memories.
findings.explanation: Pain cannot stop memory loss becomes he cannot stop both pain and memory loss.

contexts.japanese: 失み欠う苦痛も、記憶の消失を止められない。
contexts.english: I can't stop the agony of loss and the disappearance of my memories.

findings.description: Interruption before sword creation becomes before sword use.
findings.sourceReading: He would have his skull smashed before creating Saber's sword if he exposed the Projection opening.
findings.explanation: Interruption before sword creation becomes before sword use.

contexts.japanese: そんな隙を見せれば、セイバーの剣を作る前に頭蓋を砕かれている。
contexts.english: If I give him an opening, he'll pulverize my brain before I can use Saber's sword.

contexts.japanese: 投影には時間を要する。
contexts.english: I need time to do it.

findings.description: Baby has no sin becomes baby cannot commit sins.
findings.sourceReading: The recalled teaching says an infant has no guilt even if evil.
findings.explanation: Baby has no sin becomes baby cannot commit sins.

contexts.japanese: 「—ああ。たとえそれが悪であろうと、赤ん坊に、罪はない、と」
contexts.english: "Yeah. You said that a baby can't commit sins even if it's evil."

findings.description: Unwanted by anyone becomes wanting nothing from anyone.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei denies a being unwanted by anyone, alongside denying congenital evil.
findings.explanation: Unwanted by anyone becomes wanting nothing from anyone.

contexts.japanese: 何者にも望まれぬモノ、生まれながらに悪であるモノなどない。
contexts.english: There is no one who wishes for nothing from anyone, and no one who is born evil.

findings.description: Until birth becomes as soon as birth.
findings.sourceReading: He claims the entity has no grounds for punishment up to the very instant of birth.
findings.explanation: Until birth becomes as soon as birth.

contexts.japanese: アレは誕生するその瞬間まで、罰を受ける謂れはない」
contexts.english: There is no reason that thing should be punished as soon as it is born."

findings.description: Doubt about one's function becomes repeated doubt about existence.
findings.sourceReading: After the question about existence, he argues that not doubting one's designed function cannot be evil.
findings.explanation: Doubt about one's function becomes repeated doubt about existence.

contexts.japanese: だが自らの存在に何の疑問も持たなければ、アレは善だ。なにしろそのように望まれたモノ。自らの機能に疑いを持たぬのであれば、それが悪である筈がない」
contexts.english: But if it has no doubts whatsoever about its own existence, it would be good. After all, that is what was wished of it. Something which does not question its own existence cannot possibly be evil."

findings.description: No wish returning benefit to oneself becomes no wish to return to oneself.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou has no wish whose satisfaction returns something to himself; Kirei's opposite yet similar desire concerns himself.
findings.explanation: No wish returning benefit to oneself becomes no wish to return to oneself.

contexts.japanese: 自身に還る望みを持たぬおまえと対極に位置する、同質の願望だ」
contexts.english: It is a wish of the same nature, yet the antithesis to you, who has no wish to return to yourself.

contexts.japanese: ソイツが出て来たところで、アンタに返るものなんてないんだろう。なのに、どうして」
contexts.english: You're not going to get anything out of it being born. So why?"

findings.description: If I confess this becomes sentiment caused by having confessed.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei admits that his motive also involves sentiment.
findings.explanation: If I confess this becomes sentiment caused by having confessed.

contexts.japanese: 「……ふん。それにな、告白すれば感傷でもある。
contexts.english: "...Hmph. I should say, I feel sentimental having confessed this.

findings.description: Acquiring only a death-bearing way of life becomes killing anything he acquired.
findings.sourceReading: What he gained was only a way of living that brings death; next he cannot abandon that one possession.
findings.explanation: Acquiring only a death-bearing way of life becomes killing anything he acquired.

contexts.japanese: そうして得たものは死を運ぶという生き方のみ。
contexts.english: His life brought only death to anything he obtained.

contexts.japanese: なら—その、たった一つだけ在った生き方を、どうしてここで放棄る事が出来るだろう。
contexts.english: If it's the only way he ever lived, how could he ever abandon it now?

findings.description: Body beyond saving and another day of meaningful self become sluggishness and worthwhile current day.
findings.sourceReading: Stopping now could preserve meaningful selfhood for about one day although body is already beyond saving; next calls it one-day extension.
findings.explanation: Body beyond saving and another day of meaningful self become sluggishness and worthwhile current day.

contexts.japanese: この体は手遅れだけど、ここで止めておけば一日ぐらいは意味を失わずに済む。
contexts.english: This body is sluggish, but if I can stop it all here, this day won't have been for nothing.

contexts.japanese: 一日だけの延命。
contexts.english: A one-day lease on life.

findings.description: Right-hand biting pain unable to stop memory loss becomes boy unable to stop agony of loss and memories.
findings.sourceReading: Even pain from biting fingers of right hand cannot stop disappearing memory.
findings.explanation: Right-hand biting pain unable to stop memory loss becomes boy unable to stop agony of loss and memories.

contexts.japanese: 右手の指を食べる痛みも、記憶の消失を止められない。
contexts.english: I can't stop the agony of loss and the disappearance of my memories.

contexts.japanese: 自分が自分のままでいる事に、指を食うほど執着している。
contexts.english: I bite my fingers to remind myself that I'm still me.

findings.description: New miracle's application of earlier far-seeing magecraft omitted.
findings.sourceReading: She says the new act is an application of magecraft/far-seeing shown before, though this time impressive.
findings.explanation: New miracle's application of earlier far-seeing magecraft omitted.

contexts.japanese: 前に見せた魔術の応用だけど、今度のはすごいんだよ。
contexts.english: Last time, I showed you how to see far away with magecraft, but this time, it'll be really amazing!

findings.description: Small remaining reach to sky becomes momentary enacted arm lift.
findings.sourceReading: Sky is just a little farther, reachable merely by extending arm, before he realizes there is no power left and sinks.
findings.explanation: Small remaining reach to sky becomes momentary enacted arm lift.

contexts.japanese: ほんの少し、ただ腕を伸ばすだけで、空へ抜ける。
contexts.english: For just a moment, I lift my arm up and reach into the sky.

contexts.japanese: この体には、一欠片の魔力も残っていない。
contexts.english: There isn't a single bit of power left in this body.

contexts.japanese: 彼女が救ってくれた命が、沈んでいく。
contexts.english: The life she saved is sinking.

contexts.japanese: 手を伸ばす。
contexts.english: I reach out.

findings.description: Pendant enabling hand extension becomes guarantee of external rescue conditional on reach.
findings.sourceReading: Tiny pendant has just one breath of mana; insufficient for much, but helps him extend his hand.
findings.explanation: Pendant enabling hand extension becomes guarantee of external rescue conditional on reach.

contexts.japanese: 何の役にも立たない、けれど、手を伸ばすぐらいは助けてくれる、小さな小さなペンダント。
contexts.english: It's completely useless, but the small, small pendant will make sure that someone saves me if I reach out with my hand.

contexts.japanese: ほんの一呼吸分の魔力。
contexts.english: One breath of magical energy.

findings.description: Almost cliff-like slope becomes mostly descending small cliffs.
findings.sourceReading: Pathless mountain sometimes even requires descent over rock almost like a sheer cliff; ほとんど modifies cliff likeness, not frequency.
findings.explanation: Almost cliff-like slope becomes mostly descending small cliffs.

contexts.japanese: 山には獣道さえなく、ほとんど絶壁じみた岩肌を降りる事さえあった。
contexts.english: There aren't even any game trails out here, and we mostly have to drop down small cliffs and rock walls.

findings.description: Rin holding Sakura off becomes Rin settling score.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou takes encouragement as telling him to arrive while Rin can still keep Sakura held off.
findings.explanation: Rin holding Sakura off becomes Rin settling score.

contexts.japanese: 要するにあいつは、自分が桜を止めておけるうちに来いと、遠まわしに応援してくれたのだ。
contexts.english: In other words, telling me to come before she settles the score with Sakura was her roundabout way of cheering me on.

findings.description: Hypothetical worldwide mage drain becomes actual gathering to use reserve.
findings.sourceReading: Even all mages worldwide gathering and drawing freely would not exhaust store.
findings.explanation: Hypothetical worldwide mage drain becomes actual gathering to use reserve.

contexts.japanese: 世界中の魔術師がここに集まって、好き勝手魔力をくみ上げようと尽きない貯蔵量。
contexts.english: an inexhaustible resource that mages from around the world gather here to use.

findings.description: Humans' need to play becomes victim lives empty until Sakura plays with them.
findings.sourceReading: Ruby reads crushing as playing: humans find daily life boring and meaningless without play and suffer thirst without drinking. Sakura uses normal human needs to normalize her crushing and swallowing.
findings.explanation: Humans' need to play becomes victim lives empty until Sakura plays with them.

contexts.japanese: 人間は潰していないと毎日がつまらなくて意味がないし、飲まないと渇いて苦しいでしょう？
contexts.english: Humans live such boring, pointless lives before I play with them. And I get thirsty, too.

contexts.japanese: 「ええ。だって、人を潰すのも呑み込むのも変わらないもの。
contexts.english: "Yes. After all, crushing people isn't any different from swallowing them.

contexts.japanese: ほら、だから同じ。姉さんと変わらない。わたしは当たり前のように、みんながしているコトをするだけです」
contexts.english: See? I'm just like you, Nee-san. I'm just doing what everyone else does."

findings.description: Feet covering green becomes feet wreathed in green.
findings.sourceReading: Semantic ruby says 私の足は緑を覆う: feet are subject of covering green.
findings.explanation: Feet covering green becomes feet wreathed in green.

contexts.japanese: Es erzählt—Mein Schatten nimmt Sie！」
contexts.english: Es erzählt... (Let my voice carry far....) Mein Schatten nimmt sie...! (Let my feet be wreathed in green...!)"

findings.description: Sakura's attrition attack assigned to Rin.
findings.sourceReading: Even if Sakura continues attacking until Rin's stamina ends, cave collapse afterward means Sakura loses.
findings.explanation: Sakura's attrition attack assigned to Rin.

contexts.japanese: 仮に、遠坂凛の体力が尽きるまで攻め続けたとしても、その後に待つものは洞窟の崩壊なのだ。
contexts.english: Even if Rin were to attack until her physical strength failed her, the cave would collapse after.

contexts.japanese: このまま徒に戦いを続けては間桐桜の敗北となる。
contexts.english: Continuing this vain battle would mean failure for Sakura.

findings.description: Self-defeating continued action becomes comprehension strangling her.
findings.sourceReading: Despite knowing attacks are pointless and strangle her own prospects, Sakura keeps screaming.
findings.explanation: Self-defeating continued action becomes comprehension strangling her.

contexts.japanese: 無意味と知りながら、自らの首を絞めると理解していながら、間桐桜は叫び続ける。
contexts.english: Sakura screams, knowing it's pointless, the comprehension wringing her neck.

findings.description: Crying girl/shadow clinging toward Rin becomes shadows clinging to the crying girl.
findings.sourceReading: Rin silently cuts down the crying, imploring girl with shadow ruby; image overlays pleading Sakura and her approaching shadow.
findings.explanation: Crying girl/shadow clinging toward Rin becomes shadows clinging to the crying girl.

contexts.japanese: 泣いて縋ってくる少女を、彼女は無言で斬り伏せる。
contexts.english: Rin cuts away the shadows clinging to the crying girl.

findings.description: Sakura nearly refusing combat becomes Sakura denied a proper fight.
findings.sourceReading: Overwhelmed by sister, girl was on point of refusing the fight before despair renews curses.
findings.explanation: Sakura nearly refusing combat becomes Sakura denied a proper fight.

contexts.japanese: 姉に圧され、戦いを拒否しかけていた少女は、絶望と共に呪いを具現化させていく。
contexts.english: Driven back by her sister and denied even a proper fight, the girl materializes more curses in her despair.

findings.description: Qualities Sakura wanted Rin to have become things Sakura never had.
findings.sourceReading: Continuing address to Rin: you lack even fragment of what I wanted you to possess, yet insist you alone remain clean.
findings.explanation: Qualities Sakura wanted Rin to have become things Sakura never had.

contexts.japanese: 持っていて欲しかったものを一欠片も持たないクセに、　自分だけはキレイなままだと言い張って—！
contexts.english: I've never had a single thing I wanted, but you just keep on insisting on how clean you are...!

contexts.japanese: わたしのコトなんて好きでも嫌いでもないクセに、
contexts.english: You don't care about me at all.

findings.description: Settling postponed decision becomes earlier determination to keep holding out.
findings.sourceReading: Rin now firms the decision she had postponed, ending wait for Shirou at limit.
findings.explanation: Settling postponed decision becomes earlier determination to keep holding out.

contexts.japanese: 先延ばしにしていた決意を固める。
contexts.english: She's been determined to hold out as long as possible.

contexts.japanese: 限界まで衛宮士郎を待とうとしたが、これ以上は延ばせない。
contexts.english: She waited for Shirou Emiya until the last possible moment, but she can't go on any longer.

findings.description: Critical moment realization becomes judgment that this was best thing to do.
findings.sourceReading: In the crucial last moment she suddenly realizes she cannot kill Sakura up close.
findings.explanation: Critical moment realization becomes judgment that this was best thing to do.

contexts.japanese: ようするにさっきの瞬間、ここ一番っていう時に気付いてしまった。
contexts.english: In that last moment, she just felt that this was the best thing to do.

contexts.japanese: 間桐桜を間近で見た途端、自分には桜を殺せないなー、などと、当たり前のように感じてしまった。
contexts.english: Once she saw Sakura up close, she felt like, "I can't kill Sakura, huh..."

findings.description: Everything was there becomes everywhere she went wrong.
findings.sourceReading: After asking where error occurred she realizes everything she wanted was present right before her.
findings.explanation: Everything was there becomes everywhere she went wrong.

contexts.japanese: 全部あった。
contexts.english: Everywhere.

contexts.japanese: ……何処で、間違えてしまったのか。
contexts.english: ...Where did I go wrong?

contexts.japanese: あんなに欲しかったものが、本当はすぐ目の前にあった。
contexts.english: I wanted it so badly, but it was right in front of me all along.

findings.description: Rejecting her present self becomes a past deed.
findings.sourceReading: こうしている自分 continues the object of Sakura's rejection: herself in this state, then her bloodied/blackened self and connected shadow.
findings.explanation: Rejecting her present self becomes a past deed.

contexts.japanese: こうしている自分。
contexts.english: She did this.

contexts.japanese: 桜は拒んでいる。
contexts.english: She's in denial.

contexts.japanese: 遠坂の血に濡れた自分、黒く染まった自分、自分に繋がったあの黒い影を、半狂乱になりながら、全力で憎んでいる。
contexts.english: In a near-craze, she hates herself with all her heart—herself for soaking in Tohsaka's blood, herself for being corrupted, herself for connecting to the Shadow.

findings.description: Threatened refusal to restrain herself becomes inability.
findings.sourceReading: わたしだって我慢しません threatens that she too will stop restraining herself if he comes closer.
findings.explanation: Threatened refusal to restrain herself becomes inability.

contexts.japanese: 先輩、先輩がそれ以上近寄るなら、わたしだって我慢しません。先輩に殺される前に、わたしが先輩を殺しちゃうんだから……！」
contexts.english: I-if you come any closer, I won't be able to hold it back. I'll kill you before you can kill me...!"

contexts.japanese: 今のは桜が、自分の意志で俺を押しのけようとしたものだ。
contexts.english: Sakura did it out of her own will, to push me away.

findings.description: Answering why he advances becomes denial that the threatened event will happen.
findings.sourceReading: どうしても何もない dismisses her why-question and repeats his already stated purpose: take her out and save Rin.
findings.explanation: Answering why he advances becomes denial that the threatened event will happen.

contexts.japanese: 「どうしても何もない。桜をここから連れ出して、遠坂を助ける。さっきそう言っただろう、桜」
contexts.english: "That won't happen at all. I'm going to get you out of here and save Tohsaka. I already told you that, Sakura."

contexts.japanese: 「どうして言うこと聞いてくれないんですか……！？
contexts.english: "Why won't you do what I ask you to!?

findings.description: Hope that the strike will constitute punishment becomes a comparison with final punishment.
findings.sourceReading: これが、桜に下される罰になるように is a wish/purpose: may this become the punishment imposed on Sakura.
findings.explanation: Hope that the strike will constitute punishment becomes a comparison with final punishment.

contexts.japanese: これが、桜に下される罰になるように。
contexts.english: Like this is going to be her final punishment.

contexts.japanese: 「帰ろう桜。—そんなヤツとは縁を切れ」
contexts.english: "Let's go home, Sakura. Cut your ties with that guy."

findings.description: Obsession keeping him in the world becomes obsession alone remaining intact.
findings.sourceReading: Only through that obsession he still remains in this world.
findings.explanation: Obsession keeping him in the world becomes obsession alone remaining intact.

contexts.japanese: ただ、その執念だけで、未だこの世に留まっていた。
contexts.english: Only its obsession is still intact.

contexts.japanese: マキリ臓硯。魂をこの世に留める本体を潰された老魔術師は、その執念だけでこの世界に残留していた。
contexts.english: Zouken Makiri. The old mage, his main body anchoring his soul having been crushed, clings to this world by his obsession alone.

findings.description: Tiny remaining distance compared with centuries becomes distant goal and wasted centuries.
findings.sourceReading: The distance is merely that little, dust-like when compared with his five hundred years, yet impossibly far for this body.
findings.explanation: Tiny remaining distance compared with centuries becomes distant goal and wasted centuries.

contexts.japanese: そう、死ぬ訳にはいかない。崩れる体が恨めしい。苦しいのは苦しい。とにかく苦しい。苦しいだけの五百年だった。苦しいだけの人生だった。それ故に永遠を求めて何がわるい。苦しんだ苦しんだ、満たされないまま苦しんだ、何も残せぬまま消えるなど出来るものか、苦しいまま死ぬなど出来るものか、目の前には聖杯が開いている、ならば我が望みを聞くがいい、問われれば答えてやろう、我が望みはシニタクナイ、あそこまで、あの崖を登れば願いが叶う、願いが叶うというのにこの体ではたどり着けぬ、たったあれだけの距離、この五百年を顧みれば塵にも等しい、たったあれだけの距離が、なぜ、なぜこんなにも遠いのか—！！！！
contexts.english: Yes, I must not die. Damn this rotting body. It's painful, so painful. Too painful. Five hundred years of pain. My whole life has been pain. Why fault me for seeking eternity? I suffered and suffered, never fulfilled, so how can I disappear without leaving anything behind? How can I die in agony? The Holy Grail is open before me. So listen to my wish, ask and I shall answer. My wish is that I DON'T WANT TO DIE, I need to get there, my wish will come true if I climb that cliff, it'll grant my wish but I can't reach it with this body, it's so far away, these last five centuries have been for nothing, it's so far away, why oh why is it so far away—!?!?!?

findings.description: Repeated endured defeats become foreknown future defeat.
findings.sourceReading: Though repeatedly beaten down and repeatedly realizing this body cannot attain it, he could not give up while alive.
findings.explanation: Repeated endured defeats become foreknown future defeat.

contexts.japanese: 幾たび打ちのめされ、何度この身では届かないと悟りながらも、生きている限りは諦められなかった。
contexts.english: He knew he would suffer defeat and that he would not attain it in this body, but he never gave up as long as he lived.

findings.description: Wish to overturn youthful grief becomes result of never overcoming it.
findings.sourceReading: He wanted to overturn the immature grief seen in youth, even by remaking himself.
findings.explanation: Wish to overturn youthful grief becomes result of never overcoming it.

contexts.japanese: 自身を作り変えても、若い頃に見た未熟な悲嘆を覆したかった。
contexts.english: Even when he remade himself, he never overcame the laments of his youth.

findings.description: Questions about the oath and its object become statements that an oath existed.
findings.sourceReading: What did you swear? Whom did you swear to protect? Internal questions summon the particular remembered commitment.
findings.explanation: Questions about the oath and its object become statements that an oath existed.

contexts.japanese: 何を誓った。
contexts.english: You swore an oath.

contexts.japanese: おまえは、誰を守ると誓ったんだ。
contexts.english: You swore to protect someone.

findings.description: Questions about cost become unspecified loss assertions.
findings.sourceReading: What did you lose? What did you lose for that purpose? Again an internal question about the chosen price.
findings.explanation: Questions about cost become unspecified loss assertions.

contexts.japanese: その為におまえは何を失った。
contexts.english: You lost something for that purpose.

findings.description: Missing an opportunity becomes letting Kirei go.
findings.sourceReading: ここを逃したら refers to losing this final chance, explicit この奇跡、この好機.
findings.explanation: Missing an opportunity becomes letting Kirei go.

contexts.japanese: これが最後、ここを逃したら本当に後がない、この奇跡、この好機に、残った命を全てつぎ込む—！
contexts.english: This is the end, if I let him go there's no future, I need to put everything I have left into this miracle, this chance...!

findings.description: Casual choice mistakes become rescue in a lighthearted tone.
findings.sourceReading: 軽い気持ちの modifies 選択ミス: decisions made casually lead to mistakes from which remix dojo saves player.
findings.explanation: Casual choice mistakes become rescue in a lighthearted tone.

contexts.japanese: 軽い気持ちの選択ミスから貴方を救う、タイガー道場リミックスだよー！
contexts.english: Welcome to Tiger Dojo Remixed, where we save you from your bad decisions in a lighthearted tone!

findings.description: Inclusive affection cutoff becomes exclusive.
findings.sourceReading: Illya affection 4 or lower blocks True; source also says even one extra Projection is too much.
findings.explanation: Inclusive affection cutoff becomes exclusive.

contexts.japanese: ぶっちゃけ、わたしの好感度が４以下だったり、投影を一回でも多く使ってるとトゥルーには行けないのでしたー！
contexts.english: To be blunt, if my affection level is below 4 or you use too many Projections, you can't reach the True ending!

findings.description: Taiga's boast that Illya has finally noticed her tyranny becomes Taiga announcing her own realization. This changes the speaker relationship that completes the joke.
findings.sourceReading: After Illya calls her overbearing, Taiga triumphantly asks whether Illya has finally noticed, thirty-nine episodes in.
findings.explanation: Taiga's boast that Illya has finally noticed her tyranny becomes Taiga announcing her own realization. This changes the speaker relationship that completes the joke.

contexts.japanese: うむ、三十九回目にしてようやく気づいたかっ！
contexts.english: And I finally realized now that we're at the 39th episode!

contexts.japanese: そーなんだー。ネタバレとよく違いが分からないけど、とにかく師しょー横暴だー。
contexts.english: Uh-huh, okay. I don't know how that's different from a spoiler, but your house, your rules, Master.

findings.description: Unbearable casualties become shadow's limited capacity.
findings.sourceReading: Two successive days of hundred-person-scale harm would be intolerable for people/speaker.
findings.explanation: Unbearable casualties become shadow's limited capacity.

contexts.japanese: 「そうね。百人単位の被害なんて、二日続けておきたらたまらないもの」
contexts.english: "Yeah. It probably can't keep causing hundreds of victims for more than a couple of days in a row."

findings.description: Confrontation upon successful Projection becomes weapon deciding whether they win.
findings.sourceReading: 成功次第臓硯と決着をつける: as soon as Projection succeeds, move to settling conflict with Zouken.
findings.explanation: Confrontation upon successful Projection becomes weapon deciding whether they win.

contexts.japanese: で、成功次第臓硯と決着をつける。これ以上犠牲者は増やせない。あの影がなんであれ、臓硯を倒せば聖杯戦争は終わる。得体の知れないあの影も、そうなったら消えるでしょ」
contexts.english: It's going to decide whether we win against Zouken. I'm not going to let any more innocent people get hurt. I have no idea what the Shadow is, but the Holy Grail War will end once we take out Zouken. That should cause the Shadow to disappear too."

findings.description: Sick Sakura worrying about pale caregiver becomes Rin doing Shirou a favor.
findings.sourceReading: If his face is pale/ringed, even Sakura receiving care will feel obliged to worry about him.
findings.explanation: Sick Sakura worrying about pale caregiver becomes Rin doing Shirou a favor.

contexts.japanese: ……まったく、嘘だと思うなら鏡を見てきなさい。顔面蒼白で目にクマ作ってたら、看病される桜だって気を遣うわ」
contexts.english: ...If you think I'm lying, go take a look in the mirror. You're deathly pale and got rings around your eyes like a raccoon. I'm doing you a favor by taking care of Sakura."

findings.description: Resentment at being bested becomes practice until satisfied.
findings.sourceReading: She wants practice because she cannot bear remaining on losing end of Rider encounter.
findings.explanation: Resentment at being bested becomes practice until satisfied.

contexts.japanese: おまえ、単にやられっぱなしじゃ気が済まないから練習したいだけだろ」
contexts.english: You just wanna practice on me until you're satisfied!"

findings.description: Disbelief in existence becomes hope no such person exists.
findings.sourceReading: そんなものがいるとは思えない says he cannot think such main source exists.
findings.explanation: Disbelief in existence becomes hope no such person exists.

contexts.japanese: ……そんなものがいるとは思えない。
contexts.english: ...I hope nobody like that exists.

findings.description: Possible casualties and risky draining become certain deaths and certain attack.
findings.sourceReading: 犠牲者が出るかも and 奪いかねない warn victims may occur and she could drain passersby, as school incident.
findings.explanation: Possible casualties and risky draining become certain deaths and certain attack.

contexts.japanese: 「犠牲者が出るかもね。学校でわたしを襲った時みたいに、目に付いた人から魔力を奪いかねないわ。
contexts.english: "More people will die. She'll suck up the magical energy from anyone around her, just like when she attacked me at school.

findings.description: Settling her own Grail existence becomes settling unspecified things in Grail capacity.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura went to settle 自分自身, herself as Holy Grail, despite fear of death, protecting Shirou.
findings.explanation: Settling her own Grail existence becomes settling unspecified things in Grail capacity.

contexts.japanese: 「そう。けどシロウ。サクラが一人で外に出たのは、シロウに見られたくなかったからだよ。サクラはシロウを守る為に、怖いけど、死にたくないけど、聖杯である自分自身に決着をつけにいったの。
contexts.english: "Okay. But Shirou, Sakura left on her own because she didn't want you to see her. She did it to protect you. She's scared and she doesn't want to die, but she wants to settle things on her own, as a Holy Grail.

findings.description: Unwilling to kill becomes afraid to kill.
findings.sourceReading: Even so is killing Sakura something you dislike/refuse, she asks.
findings.explanation: Unwilling to kill becomes afraid to kill.

contexts.japanese: それでも—サクラを殺すのはイヤなの、シロウ？」
contexts.english: Are you still afraid to kill her, Shirou?"

findings.description: Supplies awaiting simultaneous medicine delivery become contrast with taking drug along.
findings.sourceReading: Had planned to carry pitcher/nightclothes together with medicine; because of that they remain undelivered, and temperature not yet measured.
findings.explanation: Supplies awaiting simultaneous medicine delivery become contrast with taking drug along.

contexts.japanese: 薬と一緒に持っていこう、と思っていたので水差しと寝巻きもまだ渡していないし、今朝は熱も計っていない。
contexts.english: At first she was going to take the drug with her, but she still hasn't given Sakura the water pitcher and pajamas, nor taken her temperature.

findings.description: Easy catch if running becomes urgent requirement.
findings.sourceReading: Anyway if she runs she can immediately catch up.
findings.explanation: Easy catch if running becomes urgent requirement.

contexts.japanese: ともあれ、走ればすぐに追いつける。
contexts.english: Anyway, she needs to catch up to him right away.

findings.description: Shirou helping Sakura and Sakura going alone become Rin helping Shirou and Shirou going alone.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura couldn't resolve it alone, so that guy tried to help; yet she went alone to resolve it after all. Conversation concerns Rider holding Rin until Sakura returns.
findings.explanation: Shirou helping Sakura and Sakura going alone become Rin helping Shirou and Shirou going alone.

contexts.japanese: 「—ほんとに頭きた。一人じゃ出来ないからあいつが助けようとしたのに、結局、一人で解決しにいくなんてね」
contexts.english: "I'm so annoyed. I was trying to help him because he can't do this on his own, but he's going to end up trying anyway."

findings.description: Success credited as already achieved becomes future final success.
findings.sourceReading: This ritual's success was possible only because Shirou was here, Zouken's malicious credit for present result.
findings.explanation: Success credited as already achieved becomes future final success.

contexts.japanese: そう、ワシは感謝しておるよ衛宮士郎。此度の儀はおぬしがいてこその成功だった。
contexts.english: I thank you, Shirou Emiya. The ritual will finally succeed thanks to you.

findings.description: Acquiring the key becomes unlocking the gate. This concerns the ritual's predicted progression and belongs outside this character dossier.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken predicts taking Archer's soul from the girl and seizing the key that leads to the gate.
findings.explanation: Acquiring the key becomes unlocking the gate. This concerns the ritual's predicted progression and belongs outside this character dossier.

contexts.japanese: アインツベルンの聖杯。あの小娘が取り込んだアーチャーの魂を取り込み、門に至る鍵を奪う。
contexts.english: The Einzbern Grail. Once she absorbs that little girl and the Archer she took, Sakura will unlock the gate.

findings.description: Prior offense prompting Rin to guard Illya becomes Sakura needing caution toward Illya.
findings.sourceReading: Even otherwise Sakura already has one previous offense, so guarding Illya is natural for Rin.
findings.explanation: Prior offense prompting Rin to guard Illya becomes Sakura needing caution toward Illya.

contexts.japanese: 「まあね。わたしには士郎と違って、アンタを助ける理由がないもの。いよいよとなったらイリヤを攫いに来るのは明白でしょ。そうでなくても一度前科があるんだから、イリヤを見張るのは当然よ」
contexts.english: "Pretty much. Unlike Shirou, I don't have any reason to save you. It was obvious that you'd come to take Illya once things started rolling. Even if you didn't, you had plenty of reason to be cautious of her."

findings.description: Already too late from outset becomes never ready.
findings.sourceReading: No question of too late now: everything was already too late when Sakura reached for Illya.
findings.explanation: Already too late from outset becomes never ready.

contexts.japanese: 手遅れも何もない。
contexts.english: She was never ready to begin with.

contexts.japanese: そもそも間桐桜がイリヤスフィールに手を伸ばした時点で、もう、何もかもが手遅れだった。
contexts.english: From the moment Sakura reached for Illya, it was already over.

findings.description: Too lenient becomes too easy.
findings.sourceReading: Merely draining and neutralizing her would be 甘い, too soft/lenient in Sakura's self-persuasion to kill.
findings.explanation: Too lenient becomes too easy.

contexts.japanese: 魔力を奪って無力化したぐらいじゃ甘い。
contexts.english: It would be too easy to simply neutralize her by taking her energy.

findings.description: Must stop old man becomes Sakura cannot stop.
findings.sourceReading: She must stop the old man who made her Master even at cost of mutual destruction.
findings.explanation: Must stop old man becomes Sakura cannot stop.

contexts.japanese: 自分をマスターにしたあの老人を、刺し違えてでも止めなくてはいけない。
contexts.english: She can't stop, even if she and the old man who turned her into a Master end up killing each other.

findings.description: He should know becomes I know.
findings.sourceReading: Despite grandfather surely knowing she is here, he doesn't appear; next of course he is aware confirms omitted subject.
findings.explanation: He should know becomes I know.

contexts.japanese: 「っ……知ってる、筈なの、に……！」
contexts.english: "I know...but...!"

contexts.japanese: そう、気付いていない筈がない。
contexts.english: Of course he's aware.

findings.description: All interpretations directing killing become for whatever reason.
findings.sourceReading: Corrupted vortex has human-killing direction through every interpretation.
findings.explanation: All interpretations directing killing become for whatever reason.

contexts.japanese: その時点で、聖杯の中身は“何か”に汚染されていた。無色の筈の力は、あらゆる解釈をもって人間を殺す方向性を持った『渦』になっていたのだ」
contexts.english: At the time, the Holy Grail's contents had been contaminated by something. Its power, which should have been colorless, had for whatever reason transformed into a vortex bent on killing humans."

findings.description: Previous-war corruption attached to later Grail use becomes use in previous war.
findings.sourceReading: Her connection formed when using the Grail that had been contaminated in previous war; 前回の戦いで modifies 汚染された within object noun phrase.
findings.explanation: Previous-war corruption attached to later Grail use becomes use in previous war.

contexts.japanese: ……いや、前回の戦いで汚染された聖杯を使用した時点で、彼女はとうに契約していたのだ。
contexts.english: ...No, the moment someone used the corrupted Holy Grail in the previous war, her contract was signed.

contexts.japanese: なにしろ前回の戦いでこの世に漏れた“触覚”を体に埋め込まれ、魔術回路として育てられた人間だ。間桐桜が聖杯として門を開けば開くほど、中にいるモノと一体化していくだろう。
contexts.english: In the last war, its sense of touch, which leaked into this world, was embedded into her body, and she was raised to have it serve as her Magic Circuits. The more Sakura Matou opens the gate as a Holy Grail, the more she will merge with the thing within her.

findings.description: Know conclusion becomes tell me conclusion.
findings.sourceReading: Internal demand 結論を知れ follows 結論を言え: know conclusion as well as get it stated, before boy confronts feared implications.
findings.explanation: Know conclusion becomes tell me conclusion.

contexts.japanese: 結論を知れ。
contexts.english: Tell me the conclusion.

contexts.japanese: 結論を言え。
contexts.english: Get to the point.

findings.description: The English dates implantation to the last war. The Japanese dates the leakage to that war and leaves the implantation date unstated.
findings.sourceReading: The previous war dates the leakage of what was subsequently implanted in Sakura. The sentence does not independently date implantation.
findings.explanation: The English dates implantation to the last war. The Japanese dates the leakage to that war and leaves the implantation date unstated.

contexts.japanese: なにしろ前回の戦いでこの世に漏れた“触覚”を体に埋め込まれ、魔術回路として育てられた人間だ。間桐桜が聖杯として門を開けば開くほど、中にいるモノと一体化していくだろう。
contexts.english: In the last war, its sense of touch, which leaked into this world, was embedded into her body, and she was raised to have it serve as her Magic Circuits. The more Sakura Matou opens the gate as a Holy Grail, the more she will merge with the thing within her.

findings.description: Even ending war cannot reset becomes nearing war-end prevents reset.
findings.sourceReading: Even if Grail War ends now, she cannot be restored because already the shadow.
findings.explanation: Even ending war cannot reset becomes nearing war-end prevents reset.

contexts.japanese: 彼女は既にあの影そのものだ。もはや聖杯戦争が終わったところで、彼女を元に戻す事はできん」
contexts.english: She is already the Shadow itself. Now that the Holy Grail War is in its final days, she will be unable to return to her former self."

findings.description: Kirei's argument shifts from predicting a child's future criminality to accusing it of its parent's crimes. The change concerns his analogy, not Shirou's stated principles.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei asks whether a criminal's son is certain to become a criminal, making prenatal killing the consequence of that prediction.
findings.explanation: Kirei's argument shifts from predicting a child's future criminality to accusing it of its parent's crimes. The change concerns his analogy, not Shirou's stated principles.

contexts.japanese: それともなにか？　おまえは犯罪者の息子は間違いなく犯罪者になるとでも言うのか？　それ故に、生まれる前に殺してしまえと？」
contexts.english: Or are you saying that you would condemn the child of a criminal and accuse it of the same crimes? Would you execute it before it is even born?"

findings.description: Defend only after birth becomes defend to achieve birth.
findings.sourceReading: Only when entity born as life will he defend it; before delivery Sakura refusal respected.
findings.explanation: Defend only after birth becomes defend to achieve birth.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯の中にあるモノ。それが生命として誕生した時のみ、ソレを擁護する。出産の前に間桐桜が子を拒むのであらば、そちらの意思を尊重しよう」
contexts.english: I protect that which is within the Holy Grail, so that it may be born. If its mother rejects her child before it is born, then I will respect her wishes."

findings.description: Control within seconds becomes holding control for seconds, impossibility becomes miracle.
findings.sourceReading: Gaining Grail control within merely seconds is madness; alone boy cannot accomplish it under any circumstances.
findings.explanation: Control within seconds becomes holding control for seconds, impossibility becomes miracle.

contexts.japanese: それだけではない。わずか数秒で聖杯を制御するなど狂気の沙汰だ。おまえ一人では、どうあっても成しえない奇跡だぞ」
contexts.english: That's not all. It would be a mind-shattering task to control the Holy Grail for even a few seconds. Such a feat would be a miracle for you alone."

findings.description: Even without her will becomes regardless of her feelings alone.
findings.sourceReading: No matter if taking lives wasn't her own will, in boy's inward punitive reasoning.
findings.explanation: Even without her will becomes regardless of her feelings alone.

contexts.japanese: 本人の意思でなかろうと関係ない。
contexts.english: It doesn't matter how she alone feels about it.

findings.description: Perpetrator must be punished becomes victims entitled to witness punishment.
findings.sourceReading: Whatever reasons, offender must be punished; then equally valuable return will appease those deprived.
findings.explanation: Perpetrator must be punished becomes victims entitled to witness punishment.

contexts.japanese: どんな理由があろうと、加害者は罰せられなくてはならない。
contexts.english: No matter what the circumstances were, the victims deserve to see some kind of punishment.

findings.description: Humanity expanding limits becomes Kiritsugu loving more than anyone.
findings.sourceReading: He loved humans reaching higher/farther/broader, endlessly opening limits; made self evil for their sake.
findings.explanation: Humanity expanding limits becomes Kiritsugu loving more than anyone.

contexts.japanese: より高く、より遠く、より広く。際限なく限界を切り開く人間を愛し、その為に、自身を絶対の悪とした。
contexts.english: His love for humanity was higher, further, and broader than any other. That is why he turned himself into absolute evil.

findings.description: Kiritsugu's suffering displeases Kotomine in the Japanese. The English instead says it makes Kiritsugu unhappy, removing one specific source of Kotomine's resentment.
findings.sourceReading: Kotomine finds both Kiritsugu's existence and his anguish offensive, continuing his comparison between what Kiritsugu could abandon and what he himself never possessed.
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu's suffering displeases Kotomine in the Japanese. The English instead says it makes Kiritsugu unhappy, removing one specific source of Kotomine's resentment.

contexts.japanese: ヤツの存在はあまりにも不愉快だった。ヤツの苦悩は明らかに不快だった。
contexts.english: I found his existence extremely unpleasant. His suffering clearly made him unhappy.

findings.description: As if correct human conduct becomes conceded correct conduct.
findings.sourceReading: Kiritsugu recovered discarded feeling as if this were right human way.
findings.explanation: As if correct human conduct becomes conceded correct conduct.

contexts.japanese: そこまでして切り捨てるというのなら、初めから持たねばよい。だというのにヤツは苦悩を持ち、切り捨てた後でさえ拾い上げた。それが人間の正しい営みだというように」
contexts.english: If he was going to abandon everything, then he never should have had it to begin with. Yet, he suffered and abandoned things, only to pick them up again. Even though it was the right, human thing to do."

findings.description: Surprise despite lack of self becomes fixation caused by lack of self.
findings.sourceReading: No concept of self, yet surprisingly such boy attached to a single life; then revises toward all lives.
findings.explanation: Surprise despite lack of self becomes fixation caused by lack of self.

contexts.japanese: おまえには自分という概念がない。だがそのおまえが、まさか一つの命に拘るとはな。いや、それとも—」
contexts.english: You have no concept of self. That is why you obsess over a single life. Or perhaps..."

findings.description: Not gradually going wrong becomes gradual craziness all along.
findings.sourceReading: She realizes it wasn't gradually going wrong, next asserts broken from outset.
findings.explanation: Not gradually going wrong becomes gradual craziness all along.

contexts.japanese: 「—なんだ。少しずつおかしくなってたんじゃないんだ」
contexts.english: "...Oh. Looks like I've been slowly going crazy all along."

contexts.japanese: 「—見てください先輩。わたし、最初から壊れてたんです」
contexts.english: "Look, Senpai. I've always been broken."

findings.description: Someone speaks to girl becomes girl speaking to someone else.
findings.sourceReading: There is something addressing girl, then Zouken voice behind.
findings.explanation: Someone speaks to girl becomes girl speaking to someone else.

contexts.japanese: その少女に語りかけるものがある。
contexts.english: There's someone else she's speaking to, as well.

contexts.japanese: 「—多くの人間を殺したな、桜」
contexts.english: "...You've killed many people, Sakura."

findings.description: Present imagined defeats become promised future victories matching old fantasies.
findings.sourceReading: She defeats those who threatened her within present imagination; next joy in imagined acts.
findings.explanation: Present imagined defeats become promised future victories matching old fantasies.

contexts.japanese: 少女は自らを脅かし続けたモノたちを想像の中で倒していく。
contexts.english: She'll defeat everyone who's threatened her, just as she always imagined.

contexts.japanese: そのイメージ、想像上の行為だけで歓喜に満たされる。
contexts.english: The thought alone fills her with unexpected joy.

findings.description: Present normal conversation becomes a conditional future restoration.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou tries to maintain that Sakura is unchanged: she is thus talking properly to him as usual, before her refusal interrupts.
findings.explanation: Present normal conversation becomes a conditional future restoration.

contexts.japanese: こうして、ちゃんと俺と話をして、いつも通り—
contexts.english: So if we can just talk, she'll go back to—

contexts.japanese: 桜は桜のままだ。
contexts.english: Sakura is still Sakura.

findings.description: Denial of a cause becomes a not-yet absorption event.
findings.sourceReading: His paralysis is not because he was overwhelmed by her enormous magical energy; the next sentences identify her intent to kill him as its cause.
findings.explanation: Denial of a cause becomes a not-yet absorption event.

contexts.japanese: その膨大すぎる魔力に呑まれた訳じゃない。
contexts.english: I haven't been swallowed by this titanic magical energy yet.

contexts.japanese: 体を凍らせるのはただ一つ。
contexts.english: There's only one reason I can't move:

contexts.japanese: 桜は本気で—俺に、殺意を向けていた。
contexts.english: Sakura's boundless bloodlust is directed at me.

findings.description: The English states that Sakura is no longer holding back where the Japanese presents that as an explanation the narrator is considering. Both versions call Rider's action a betrayal.
findings.sourceReading: The shadow covers the courtyard; the narrator conjectures that Rider's betrayal may have made Sakura become serious.
findings.explanation: The English states that Sakura is no longer holding back where the Japanese presents that as an explanation the narrator is considering. Both versions call Rider's action a betrayal.

contexts.japanese: ……ライダーの裏切りで本気になったのか、桜から広がる影は中庭を覆い尽くす。
contexts.english: Sakura shrouds the entire yard in darkness. She isn't holding back anymore, after Rider's betrayal.

findings.description: Internally writhing tinnitus becomes worms causing ordinary ringing ears.
findings.sourceReading: She experiences a tinnitus/ringing that writhes within her body; pathological internal sound image.
findings.explanation: Internally writhing tinnitus becomes worms causing ordinary ringing ears.

contexts.japanese: 体内で蠢く耳鳴りがする。
contexts.english: All their squirming in her body starts to make her ears ring.

findings.description: Excluding last night's activity as cause becomes not tired at bedtime.
findings.sourceReading: A lot happened yesterday, but he thinks fatigue isn't due to last night's events, with embarrassed hesitation.
findings.explanation: Excluding last night's activity as cause becomes not tired at bedtime.

contexts.japanese: たしかに昨日は色々あったが、別に、その、昨夜のことで疲れたワケじゃないと思う。
contexts.english: A lot happened yesterday, but I didn't go to bed particularly exhausted.

findings.description: The English changes a warning that silence could cause irreparable harm into an expectation that speaking will change things. This belongs in a review of Shirou's decision to warn Illya.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou expects irreparable consequences unless he tells Illya about both dangers.
findings.explanation: The English changes a warning that silence could cause irreparable harm into an expectation that speaking will change things. This belongs in a review of Shirou's decision to warn Illya.

contexts.japanese: 間桐臓硯の暗躍と、あの、正体不明の影についても話しておかないと、取り返しのつかない事になるだろう。
contexts.english: I have a feeling that everything will change once I bring up Zouken's schemes and that unknown Shadow.

findings.description: Rin prioritizing Shirou while he guides becomes her doing him a favor.
findings.sourceReading: As long as he serves as guide, Rin will give his plan priority; taking her keeps her from challenging Illya independently.
findings.explanation: Rin prioritizing Shirou while he guides becomes her doing him a favor.

contexts.japanese: けどまあ、案内をする分には、遠坂は俺を優先してくれる。
contexts.english: Still, Tohsaka's doing me a favor by letting me guide her.

contexts.japanese: 放っておけばイリヤに戦いを挑む遠坂だが、ここで連れて行くと言えば、遠坂は大人しくしてくれるのだ。
contexts.english: If I let her go, she might fight Illya, but if she comes with me, then she'll behave.

findings.description: Their shared pursuit becomes a claim that they were fated to meet. The individual wishes survive, and this change belongs to Zouken's relationship with the skull-masked Assassin.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken says their related aims explain their current joint pursuit: bodily immortality for him and an enduring name for Assassin.
findings.explanation: Their shared pursuit becomes a claim that they were fated to meet. The individual wishes survive, and this change belongs to Zouken's relationship with the skull-masked Assassin.

contexts.japanese: 「ああ、大事だとも！　我が望みは不老不死、こやつの望みも永劫に刻まれる自身の名でな。我らは同じ目的の為、こうして邁進しておるという訳だ」
contexts.english: "Yes, I do! My wish is for immortality, and he desires a name that will be remembered for eternity. We were fated to meet because our goals are the same."

findings.description: Zouken's claim that shared order no longer holds becomes a claim that he follows a universal law. This changes the reasoning by which he excuses sacrificing others for survival.
findings.sourceReading: Zouken says that no sustaining order of interconnection can hold under humanity's destructive greed, then uses inevitable collapse to excuse breaking step himself.
findings.explanation: Zouken's claim that shared order no longer holds becomes a claim that he follows a universal law. This changes the reasoning by which he excuses sacrificing others for survival.

contexts.japanese: そこに、もはや連鎖すべき法則など成り立たぬ。いずれ破綻するのであれば、ワシ一人が足並みを崩したところで誰にも異論は挟ませぬわ……！」
contexts.english: I am merely following a law that governs us all. If we are all destined for ruin in the end, then who can criticize me for walking out of step with the masses...!?"

findings.description: Kirei questions whether Sakura is worth Shirou's life. The English instead questions whether sacrifice exhausts what she means to him, changing the provocation.
findings.sourceReading: Having called life-sacrificing devotion beautiful, Kirei questions whether Sakura is worth that much to Shirou.
findings.explanation: Kirei questions whether Sakura is worth Shirou's life. The English instead questions whether sacrifice exhausts what she means to him, changing the provocation.

contexts.japanese: あの娘は衛宮士郎にとって、果たしてそれだけの価値があるのかどうか」
contexts.english: I wonder if that is all the girl really means to you."

contexts.japanese: 「—そうか。命を捧げるほどの献身は美しいがな。
contexts.english: "I see. Self-sacrifice is indeed a beautiful ideal.

findings.description: Many Noble Phantasms exceeding the sword in craftsmanship becomes few being able to rival it.
findings.sourceReading: Numerous Noble Phantasms surpass the sword in fine modeling and skilled ironwork; its superiority lies elsewhere.
findings.explanation: Many Noble Phantasms exceeding the sword in craftsmanship becomes few being able to rival it.

contexts.japanese: 造型の細やかさ、鍛え上げられた鉄の巧みさで言えば、上回る宝具は数あろう。
contexts.english: Few Noble Phantasms can rival its elegant design and fine worksmanship.

findings.description: A sword outside nonhuman craft becomes not a work of mankind.
findings.sourceReading: The sword relies neither on myth nor on inhuman/nonhuman art; it is forged from human thought alone.
findings.explanation: A sword outside nonhuman craft becomes not a work of mankind.

contexts.japanese: 神話に寄らず、人ならざる業にも属さず、ただ想いだけで鍛え上げられた結晶だからこそ—あの剣は空想の身で、最強の座に在り続ける。
contexts.english: Neither a relic of myth nor a work of mankind, it is a crystallization crafted from our feelings alone—a sword of pure fantasy, sitting at the apex.

findings.description: A broken helm implying prior head injury becomes an opportunity to inflict head damage.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou infers that because the helm was broken, Saber must already have sustained some damage to the head, and chooses that point.
findings.explanation: A broken helm implying prior head injury becomes an opportunity to inflict head damage.

contexts.japanese: 兜を砕かれた、という事は頭部になんらかのダメージを負っている筈だ。
contexts.english: Now that her helmet is broken, I should be able to do some damage if I go for the head.

findings.description: Illya's sudden emergence from listlessness becomes a loss of enthusiasm. Her hostility toward Sakura is still visible, so the error primarily concerns Illya's changing mood.
findings.sourceReading: Illya's immediately preceding listlessness abruptly disappears as she glares at Sakura.
findings.explanation: Illya's sudden emergence from listlessness becomes a loss of enthusiasm. Her hostility toward Sakura is still visible, so the error primarily concerns Illya's changing mood.

contexts.japanese: さっきまでの元気のなさは何処にいったのか、イリヤは一変して桜を睨んだ。
contexts.english: Illya glares at Sakura, all of her earlier enthusiasm gone.

findings.description: The English treats Saber becoming Zouken's Servant as established and leaves only the mechanism unknown. The Japanese leaves the relationship itself uncertain.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou does not know whether Saber has become Zouken's Servant; only her hostility is established.
findings.explanation: The English treats Saber becoming Zouken's Servant as established and leaves only the mechanism unknown. The Japanese leaves the relationship itself uncertain.

contexts.japanese: あの“黒い影”がなんなのか、セイバーが臓硯のサーヴァントになったのかも判らない。
contexts.english: I have no idea what that black Shadow is, nor how Saber became Zouken's Servant.

findings.description: Thinking about how to save Sakura becomes postponing concern for himself. The surrounding English still establishes her urgent need for help.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou directs his present thinking toward how to defeat Zouken and obtain the Grail before Sakura collapses.
findings.explanation: Thinking about how to save Sakura becomes postponing concern for himself. The surrounding English still establishes her urgent need for help.

contexts.japanese: 悩むのならその方法だ。
contexts.english: I can worry about myself after that.

findings.description: The refusal branch repeats the presupposition that Saber became Zouken's Servant.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou does not know whether Saber entered a contract with Zouken.
findings.explanation: The refusal branch repeats the presupposition that Saber became Zouken's Servant.

contexts.japanese: あの“黒い影”がなんなのか、セイバーが臓硯のサーヴァントになったのかも判らない。
contexts.english: I have no idea what that black Shadow is, nor how Saber became Zouken's Servant.

findings.description: Shirou realizing the condition's implication becomes Rider noticing his inability to answer.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou could not answer because he himself had noticed what Rider's no-matter-what condition points toward.
findings.explanation: Shirou realizing the condition's implication becomes Rider noticing his inability to answer.

contexts.japanese: 答えを言えなかったのは、気付いてしまったからだ。
contexts.english: She noticed that I couldn't give her a clear answer.

findings.description: The Japanese says Shirou suffered an injury independently of Sakura’s wish. The English explicitly says she hurt him. This adds an agent to the clause without settling the wider cause of the injury.
findings.sourceReading: 彼女の願いとは関係なく separates the actual injury from her earlier wish; 衛宮士郎は傷を負った does not explicitly name Sakura as the actor who inflicted it.
findings.explanation: The Japanese says Shirou suffered an injury independently of Sakura’s wish. The English explicitly says she hurt him. This adds an agent to the clause without settling the wider cause of the injury.

contexts.japanese: 彼女の願いとは関係なく、衛宮士郎は傷を負った。
contexts.english: And now, she'd hurt Shirou Emiya in a way that had nothing to do with her wish.

findings.description: No meaningful difference between incapacitating and life-threatening injury becomes both events actually happening.
findings.sourceReading: Sakura realizes that wishing for injury sufficient to confine him and confronting a life-threatening wound are not safely separable categories: injury can mean this.
findings.explanation: No meaningful difference between incapacitating and life-threatening injury becomes both events actually happening.

contexts.japanese: その二つに違いなどない。
contexts.english: Both of these things actually happened.

findings.description: Pain and attempted activation become alternatives.
findings.sourceReading: Even ordinary magical-energy circulation will cause both pain in the left arm and recoil as it tries to activate.
findings.explanation: Pain and attempted activation become alternatives.

contexts.japanese: だが安心はするなよ。魔術行使をせずとも、生きている限り魔力は肉体に通るものだ。その度に左腕には痛みと、起動しようとする反動が起きるだろう。
contexts.english: But do not be complacent. Magical energy runs through your body even when you aren't using magecraft. It may cause your left arm to react with pain or activation.

findings.description: Remaining Masters uniformly lacking Servants and the outcome being decided becomes victory being close because few Servants remain.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei says the surviving Masters are gathered without Servants, so the result is effectively settled.
findings.explanation: Remaining Masters uniformly lacking Servants and the outcome being decided becomes victory being close because few Servants remain.

contexts.japanese: 残されたマスターがこうもそろってサーヴァントがいない状態では、もはや勝敗はついただろう」
contexts.english: Victory is close, with so few Servants remaining, despite this assembly of Masters."

findings.description: The Grail answering its holder's wishes becomes the Grail responding to its own wishes.
findings.sourceReading: The Grail is only a machine that answers the user's own desire and manufactures acceptable answers to the user's questions.
findings.explanation: The Grail answering its holder's wishes becomes the Grail responding to its own wishes.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯は己が望みに応えるだけのもの。
contexts.english: The Holy Grail should respond to its own wishes.

findings.description: A wish fulfilling the self becomes a person fulfilling their own wish.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei distinguishes ordinary pleasures from a wish that realizes or fulfills the self; if the person realizes it by their own means, that does not save them.
findings.explanation: A wish fulfilling the self becomes a person fulfilling their own wish.

contexts.japanese: そのようなものは食事と同じだ。願いとは自身を叶えるもの。だが自ら願いを叶えては、人間は救われん」
contexts.english: It is no different from a meal. One should make one's own wishes come true. But this cannot save a human."

findings.description: Meeting paternal expectations becomes merely appeasing them.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei's inability to love his father and his fulfillment of his father's expectations are separate matters.
findings.explanation: Meeting paternal expectations becomes merely appeasing them.

contexts.japanese: 父を愛せない事と、父の期待に応える事は別の問題だ。
contexts.english: That he could not love his father and was only appeasing his expectations was a separate matter.

findings.description: The voices of common sense, morality and justice judging evil become Kirei's own conclusion.
findings.sourceReading: Conventional authorities—common sense, moral instruction and justice—collectively declare that such evil should not exist.
findings.explanation: The voices of common sense, morality and justice judging evil become Kirei's own conclusion.

contexts.japanese: それらが全て、悪は在ってはならぬモノと断定する。
contexts.english: He concluded that such evil could not, should not exist.

findings.description: Something that should not exist becomes something that cannot exist.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei asks why a thing must be produced if it ought not be allowed to exist.
findings.explanation: Something that should not exist becomes something that cannot exist.

contexts.japanese: 有ってはならぬモノならば、なぜ、そんなモノが生み出されねばならないのか。
contexts.english: If such a person could not exist, then why was he born anyway?

findings.description: Blessing whatever seeks birth becomes blessing the Grail for trying to give birth.
findings.sourceReading: Whatever the Grail may be, Kirei blesses the thing that is attempting to be born; he defines this as his vocation.
findings.explanation: Blessing whatever seeks birth becomes blessing the Grail for trying to give birth.

contexts.japanese: 聖杯がなんであれ、生まれ出でようとするモノを祝福する。それが私の仕事だからな」
contexts.english: No matter what the Holy Grail may be, I bless it for trying to give birth. That is my task."

findings.description: Shirou wondering whether family rivalry explains Illya becomes asserting it must.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou speculates that the Einzbern and Makiri families may be on bad terms.
findings.explanation: Shirou wondering whether family rivalry explains Illya becomes asserting it must.

contexts.japanese: 「イリヤ、桜とは初対面のくせになんであんなにつっかかるんだろう。やっぱりアインツベルンとマキリって仲が悪いのかな」
contexts.english: "Why is Illya being so gruff with her when it's their first time meeting? The Einzberns and Makiris must not get along."

findings.description: Honoring Archer's words at the relevant choice becomes doing whatever Archer says.
findings.sourceReading: Illya tells Shirou to return immediately to the choice and properly keep Archer's words, specifically the protective instruction governing this escape.
findings.explanation: Honoring Archer's words at the relevant choice becomes doing whatever Archer says.

contexts.japanese: シロウはすぐに選択肢に戻って、ちゃあんとアーチャーの言葉を守るコト！
contexts.english: Shirou, go back to the last decision and do what Archer says!

findings.description: Shirou not believing appearance is his reason becomes not being influenced on purpose.
findings.sourceReading: He does not think he is simply fooled by Illya's looks, but admits that his hesitation itself proves her appearance affects him.
findings.explanation: Shirou not believing appearance is his reason becomes not being influenced on purpose.

contexts.japanese: 自分ではそんな気はしないが、躊躇っている時点であの子の外見に影響されているんだから。
contexts.english: It's not like I'm doing it on purpose, but maybe what she looks like is getting to me.

findings.description: Shirou recognizing the man's withdrawal as normal becomes agreeing that the man is not wrong.
findings.sourceReading: The man moves away; Shirou thinks that distancing is the natural outcome and that his own death panic was abnormal.
findings.explanation: Shirou recognizing the man's withdrawal as normal becomes agreeing that the man is not wrong.

contexts.japanese: そう、それが当然だ。
contexts.english: I can't say he's wrong.

findings.description: Shirou saying he would not visit Kirei even if asked becomes rejecting Kirei's stated reasons.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou says he came solely with a question and otherwise would not come to Kirei's place even if someone begged him.
findings.explanation: Shirou saying he would not visit Kirei even if asked becomes rejecting Kirei's stated reasons.

contexts.japanese: 「—そんな訳ないだろ。単に聞きたい事があるから来ただけだ。そうでもなけりゃ、頼まれたっておまえの所になんて来るもんか」
contexts.english: "I don't intend to. I'm just here to ask you a question. Like I'd come just for the reasons you gave."

findings.description: Crawling fugitives become petitioners shot after turning their backs.
findings.sourceReading: Kiritsugu made pleading Masters crawl, then put a gun to the skulls of those trying to flee and pulled the trigger.
findings.explanation: Crawling fugitives become petitioners shot after turning their backs.

contexts.japanese: ヤツは的確であり、周到であり、蛮勇であり、無情だった。敵にかける情けなどない。殺すと決めればただ殺した。サーヴァントを屠り、助けを請うマスターを這わせ、逃げようとする頭蓋に銃口を当てて引き金を引いた。殺した後の感慨もない。強さを誇る優越も、消えた弱者への罪悪もない」
contexts.english: He was precise, meticulous, predatory, and ruthless. He had no mercy for his enemies. Once he decided to kill someone, they would die. He butchered Servants and allowed their Masters to beg for their lives only to pull the trigger once their backs were turned. He felt nothing after each kill. He felt neither pride in his own dominance nor guilt for the fallen."

findings.description: A causal explanation is invented after Kirei calls Kiritsugu the clearest evil.
findings.sourceReading: If ruthlessness constitutes evil, Kirei says no one in the previous war was a more obvious evil than Kiritsugu.
findings.explanation: A causal explanation is invented after Kirei calls Kiritsugu the clearest evil.

contexts.japanese: 「そうだな。もし今回の戦いに切嗣がいるのなら、おまえが最も嫌悪するマスターになっただろう。非情だという事が悪になるのなら、前回の戦いで最も判りやすい悪は、あの男をおいて他にはなかったのだから」
contexts.english: "Let me put it another way. If Kiritsugu was part of this war, he would be the worst possible Master for you to face. If you consider ruthlessness a form of evil, then he would have been the most obvious source of evil in the last war. He had nothing else, after all."

findings.description: Refusing a separate killer persona becomes adopting one.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei says Kiritsugu could easily have prepared a separate 'cold-blooded' personality, but likely believed such a person could neither reach nor deserve the Grail.
findings.explanation: Refusing a separate killer persona becomes adopting one.

contexts.japanese: “冷徹である”という異なる人格さえ用意すれば容易いものを、そんな人間では聖杯に届かない、届く価値がないと信じたのだろう」
contexts.english: One so easily changed by magical suggestion or merely hardening their heart would not have been worthy of obtaining the grail. That must have been his belief. So he adopted the identity of a killer through and through.

findings.description: The old families' comparison becomes Kirei's comparison of families.
findings.sourceReading: Makiri and Einzbern apparently regarded Kirei and Kiritsugu as the same kind, although the two saw each other as natural enemies.
findings.explanation: The old families' comparison becomes Kirei's comparison of families.

contexts.japanese: 「当然だ。ヤツと私は両極に位置していた。私とあの男は生まれついての仇敵だ。マキリやアインツベルンには同類として映ったらしいが、私たちは共に、互いを天敵だと認識していた」
contexts.english: "Naturally. We stood at opposite extremes. We were born to be each other's nemeses. You might compare us to the Makiris and the Einzberns, but we both understood each other as natural enemies."

findings.description: Shirou's two extremes and ordinary wounded human become avoidance versus embracing humanity.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou asks whether Kirei is different: neither one who suffers no wounds nor one who has nothing but wounds, but an ordinary human who is wounded when cut; is priesthood the difference from Kiritsugu?
findings.explanation: Shirou's two extremes and ordinary wounded human become avoidance versus embracing humanity.

contexts.japanese: 「……じゃあ、アンタは違うのか。傷を負わないのでもなく、傷しかないのでもない。斬られれば傷を負う、まっとうな人間だって。アンタは神父だから、そこが切嗣とは違うと……？」
contexts.english: "...And you're different? He was someone who avoided getting hurt. While you say you were hurt, as you took a path embracing humanity. Being a priest made you different from Kiritsugu...?"

findings.description: Turning comedy into tragedy becomes substituting ugliness with either comedy or tragedy.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei says humans forget even their own ugliness and replace comedy with tragedy; over time an evil-buried hero is recast as a victim.
findings.explanation: Turning comedy into tragedy becomes substituting ugliness with either comedy or tragedy.

contexts.japanese: ……まあ、自らの醜ささえ忘れ喜劇を悲劇にすり替えるのが人間だ。悪として葬られた英雄も、時が経てば被害者として扱われ純粋悪ではなくなってしまう」
contexts.english: ...It is, well, human to forget our own ugliness and substitute it with comedy or tragedy. With time, even reviled heroes are eventually treated as victims, and cease to be seen as pure evil."

findings.description: Growth untouched by human hands becomes growth thanks only to human involvement.
findings.sourceReading: The paradoxical being is created by humans yet grows without any human hand entering or shaping the process.
findings.explanation: Growth untouched by human hands becomes growth thanks only to human involvement.

contexts.japanese: ……人が生み出したモノでありながら、決して人の手が混ざらず成長するモノ。その矛盾こそがあらゆる抑止の圧力を免除される“世界の敵”である」
contexts.english: ...They are something created by humans, and grow only thanks to human involvement. That contradiction is what exempts these enemies of the world from the corrective forces that would otherwise eliminate them."

findings.description: The rarity of pure Anti-Heroes becomes an exception from the preceding account.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei qualifies that there are scarcely any pure Anti-Heroes, then says such a thing does not exist and is only a human wish.
findings.explanation: The rarity of pure Anti-Heroes becomes an exception from the preceding account.

contexts.japanese: 「……もっとも、純粋な反英雄などそうはいない。
contexts.english: "...Of course, this does not apply to pure Anti-Heroes.

findings.description: Changing one's decision for a belief becomes willing oneself into personal change.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei says he could not, as Kiritsugu could, change his will or decision for the sake of what he believed.
findings.explanation: Changing one's decision for a belief becomes willing oneself into personal change.

contexts.japanese: 「そうだ。私は衛宮切嗣のように、信じる物の為に意思を変える、などという事はできなかった。まあ目的が違うのだから比べるべくもないのだが」
contexts.english: "Well, unlike Kiritsugu, I could never do anything like will myself into changing for something I believe in. Though our objectives were different, so you can hardly compare us."

findings.description: A comparison to a brutal historical age becomes Einzbern's own thousand-year killing campaign.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei invokes the old age when atrocities could pass under the banner of reclaiming the Holy Land, then says Einzbern's unbroken medieval persistence exceeds the human domain.
findings.explanation: A comparison to a brutal historical age becomes Einzbern's own thousand-year killing campaign.

contexts.japanese: 一千年だぞ？　聖地奪還という使命を盾に殺して殺して殺し尽くすなどという異次元の蛮行がまかり通った昔、中世より連綿と続いた、人の領域など逸脱した狂気の沙汰だ。
contexts.english: One thousand years. In the name of their quest, they have killed and killed and killed, committing atrocities beyond imagination, clinging to their inhuman madness since the Middle Ages.

findings.description: A collective will that normally fades within a decade becomes a goal forgotten decades after inception.
findings.sourceReading: Even a group's will is forgotten and worn away on a scale of ten years; Einzbern repeated that span many times without once straying.
findings.explanation: A collective will that normally fades within a decade becomes a goal forgotten decades after inception.

contexts.japanese: 「故にアインツベルンの魔術師は魔の領域さえ突破している。十年単位ですら忘却され消耗する集団の意思を、その何倍も繰り返したあげくただの一度も道を誤らなかった怪物ども。
contexts.english: "The Einzbern mages have gone beyond the realm of mere evil. Over the centuries, those monsters have never once strayed from their dogged pursuit of a shared goal that was forgotten only decades from its inception.

findings.description: Obsession no human can confront becomes obsession not just anyone can possess.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou has no words because an obsession lasting centuries is not something a human being can stand against or confront.
findings.explanation: Obsession no human can confront becomes obsession not just anyone can possess.

contexts.japanese: 何百年もの間続く執念なんて、それは人が対峙できるものではないからだ。
contexts.english: Not just anyone can obsess over a single goal for hundreds of years.

findings.description: Kirei's refusal to condemn the betrayal becomes a claim that it lacked malice.
findings.sourceReading: Kirei says Kiritsugu betrayed Einzbern, but he will not denounce that act as inhumane.
findings.explanation: Kirei's refusal to condemn the betrayal becomes a claim that it lacked malice.

contexts.japanese: 「そう落ち込むな。衛宮切嗣はアインツベルンを裏切ったが、それを非道となじる事はない。
contexts.english: "Don't look so downtrodden. Kiritsugu Emiya may have betrayed the Einzberns, but it was not out of malice.

findings.description: Descending to the intersection becomes returning to it.
findings.sourceReading: After circling the residential area, they descend to the intersection.
findings.explanation: Descending to the intersection becomes returning to it.

contexts.japanese: 住宅地を一通り回って交差点に降りる。
contexts.english: After doing a circuit of the neighborhoods, we return to the intersection.

findings.description: A body that will not move and a mind that issues no command become a body disobeying its mind.
findings.sourceReading: His body will not move, and his head will not tell it what to do next: both thought and action are arrested.
findings.explanation: A body that will not move and a mind that issues no command become a body disobeying its mind.

contexts.japanese: なのに体は動かず、頭は次の行動を命じてくれない。
contexts.english: But now, my body won't listen to my brain.

contexts.japanese: なのに体は動かず、頭は次の行動を命じてくれない。
contexts.english: But now, my body won't listen to my brain.

findings.description: The victim not surviving if they remain still becomes doubt that the pair can help.
findings.sourceReading: Saber says that if things continue this way, the attacked person will not be saved, despite not knowing what happened.
findings.explanation: The victim not surviving if they remain still becomes doubt that the pair can help.

contexts.japanese: 「悲鳴が止みました。感じ取れる気配も消えかけています。何が起きたかは判りませんが、このままでは襲われた者は助からないでしょう」
contexts.english: "The scream stopped. The presence we sensed is fading. I don't know what just happened, but I doubt we'll be able to help whoever was attacked."

findings.description: Shinto being easier for a hostile Master to operate in becomes easier for Shirou to deal with them there.
findings.sourceReading: Shirou chooses Shinto because a Master planning something dangerous would find it easier to act there than in Miyama.
findings.explanation: Shinto being easier for a hostile Master to operate in becomes easier for Shirou to deal with them there.

contexts.japanese: 「新都に行こう。物騒な事を企んでいるマスターがいるとしたら、深山より新都の方がやりやすいだろうからな」
contexts.english: "Let's go to Shinto. If any of the Masters is up to no good, then it'll be easier to deal with them there."

findings.description: Shirou's skill failing to match his plan becomes a shared failure to account for his skill.
findings.sourceReading: Saber says Shirou's action itself was right; if there was a shortcoming, only his ability failed to keep pace with his idea.
findings.explanation: Shirou's skill failing to match his plan becomes a shared failure to account for his skill.

contexts.japanese: 「いえ、マスターの行動自体は正しい。失点があるとしたら、シロウの技量が考えに付いてこなかっただけでしょう。
contexts.english: "No, Master, your actions were correct. If a mistake was made, it was that we failed to account for your skill level.

findings.description: Shinji's use of people to summon spectators disappears.
findings.sourceReading: Shinji says he called people there because he wanted to see Servants fight.
findings.explanation: Shinji's use of people to summon spectators disappears.

contexts.japanese: 「ほら、戦わせてみようぜ衛宮。僕はサーヴァント同士の戦いが見たくて人を呼んだんだ。おまえだってマスターだろ？　なのにぶるぶる震えてさ、そんなんじゃそこの女と変わらないじゃないか！」
contexts.english: "C'mon, show me what you got, Emiya. I went to all this trouble because I want to see Servants fight. Aren't you a Master? What are you shaking in your boots for? Makes you no different from that 'girl' there!"

findings.description: Shinji's excuse that killing Saber would be unavoidable becomes praise of Rider as unstoppable. Rider still obeys his order in the next sentence.
findings.sourceReading: Shinji claims compliance with his grandfather's instructions and excuses killing Shirou's Servant as something unavoidable.
findings.explanation: Shinji's excuse that killing Saber would be unavoidable becomes praise of Rider as unstoppable. Rider still obeys his order in the next sentence.

contexts.japanese: 爺さんの言いつけは守ったんだ、衛宮のサーヴァントを始末するぐらい不可抗力さ！」
contexts.english: I've followed Grandpa's orders! You're unstoppable enough to take out Emiya's Servant!"

findings.description: Shinji not running to wounded Rider becomes running to her.
findings.sourceReading: Shinji screams without going over to Rider, whose abdomen has been cut and who is badly wounded.
findings.explanation: Shinji not running to wounded Rider becomes running to her.

contexts.japanese: 腹を裂かれ、深手を負ったライダーに駆け寄ることなく慎二が叫ぶ。
contexts.english: Shinji runs over to Rider and screams at her. She's sprawled on the ground, her belly cut open.

findings.description: A death-premised command moving Rider becomes her death growing more certain.
findings.sourceReading: Rider's body moves in response to an order premised on her death: die while taking Saber with her.
findings.explanation: A death-premised command moving Rider becomes her death growing more certain.

contexts.japanese: —死を前提とした命令に、ライダーの体が動く。
